descriptionHtml:
Riptide Technology is seeking a Senior Database Design Engineer (Level V) to support cutting-edge Research and Development (R&D), Data Analysis, and Cloud Migration initiatives in a hybrid role at the Naval Research Laboratory (NRL) in Washington, D.C.

This Subject Matter Expert (SME) will lead the design, implementation, and operations of high-performance database infrastructures—spanning PostgreSQL and future recommended technologies—to support critical, ongoing programs within the Naval Center for Spacecraft Technology (NCST). This database architecture handles massive volumes of multi-source event data, supports data fusion, and is actively transitioning toward modern Cloud architectures.

We are seeking a seasoned Database Design Engineer and Architect who possesses full-spectrum software development capabilities. While you must understand traditional database administration, your primary focus is engineering future-state data models, designing tracking algorithms, managing data migration strategies, and deploying resilient cloud/on-premise database ecosystems.

Core Responsibilities:

  • 1. Database Architecture, Administration, & Modernization
    • PostgreSQL Enterprise Management: Implement, manage, and tune PostgreSQL RDBMS (including modern PostgreSQL versions, pgAdmin, psql, and enterprise monitoring consoles). Expertly install Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), PostgreSQL software, and manage workloads across bare metal servers, High Availability (HA) clusters (e.g., Patroni, repmgr), and high-performance database appliances
    • Advanced PostgreSQL Security & Optimization: Configure and utilize advanced native PostgreSQL features including Row-Level Security (RLS), native declarative partitioning, custom indexing (GIN, GiST, BRIN), and connection pooling via complex SQL and PL/pgSQL programming
    • Database Migration & Planning: Research, engineer, and establish transition paths for shifting legacy relational data stores to PostgreSQL instances within the IC and DoD Cloud data layers. Support data engineering by defining and implementing complex object models (e.g., Unified Object Model, Generalized Entity Model) within cloud environments
    • Infrastructure & OS Management: Support a hybrid suite of virtualized systems and bare metal servers running Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Rocky Linux, Community Enterprise OS (CentOS), and limited Windows environments
  • Algorithm Development, Data Fusion, & Tracking
    • Multi-INT & Geolocation Tracking: Develop, modify, and enhance data fusion and geographic tracking algorithms utilizing PostGIS and spatial indexing for multiple situational awareness data types (GEOINT, SIGINT, OSINT). Optimize track correlation, tracker algorithm performance, and database-level alerting/alarming capabilities (e.g., LISTEN/NOTIFY, triggers)
    • Algorithm Review & Long-Term Trending: Perform continuous algorithm analysis, query performance measurement, and long-term trending while data remains active. Detect, document, and report anomalies to the Government lead
    • Data Tagging & Characterization: Research and develop automated electronic emission pattern data tagging methodologies
  • Data Ingestion, Archiving, & Cloud Integration
    • Cloud & Web Architecture: Build and maintain system architectures hosting maritime data feeds, schedule information, and web extractor software across hardware suites, IC/DoD Clouds, or commercial Government clouds such as Amazon Web Services (AWS/RDS/Aurora). Lead systems engineering efforts for transitioning existing capabilities into evolving cloud ecosystems
    • Data Archiving & Query Web Services: Implement long-term online data archives capable of indexing multi-domain positions (maritime, airborne, land, space) and metadata using JSONB and spatial extensions. Integrate Open Source Schedule data and build queryable web services to retrieve historical archives
    • Operations & Maintenance: Provide Echelon 2 Operations and Maintenance (O&M) support for existing tactical and strategic data feeds
  • UI/Widget Integration & Object Production (OBP)
    • Widget Suite Prototyping: Design and engineer user interface prototypes and underlying data access web services to integrate analysis capabilities within the Ozone Widget Framework (OWF) or equivalent presentation frameworks
    • Object Management as a Service / OMAAS: Implement an Object-Based Production approach that delivers aggregated real-world object profiles (vessels, airplanes, facilities) in a collaborative regional/worldwide service framework. Develop advanced object aggregation algorithms to support R&D
  • Systems Engineering & Lifecycle Support
    • Systems Assessment: Perform technical and engineering data analyses on system functionality, survivability, and performance to solve critical design deficiencies. Run short-term engineering analyses and quick-reaction studies
    • Documentation & Training: Prepare training documentation and instruct operators on data analysis products, supporting program deliveries, demonstrations, and high-level customer presentations
    • Configuration Management: Participate in system capability reviews, modify existing application codebases, and maintain rigorous baseline control by archiving all software modifications in a CM database
    • Infrastructure Upkeep: Support and enhance network technology implementations, handle routine equipment maintenance, manage system access via account creation scripts, and connect with Local/Wide Area Networks utilizing thin-client architectures


Required Qualifications:

  • Education: Minimum B.S. Degree in Mathematics, Engineering, or Computer Science
  • Certifications: Required to meet DoD 8570/8140 Information Assurance Technical (IAT) Level II requirements
  • Software Development Methodologies: 12+ years of experience applying software development methodologies and practices, including traditional structured programming as well as object-oriented programming techniques and broad utilization of current software development tools within numerous environments
  • Relational Database Engineering: 12+ years of experience with relational database planning, design, development, testing, installation, and maintenance of complex technical software systems utilizing PostgreSQL
  • Spatial Database Architecture: 4+ years of strong proficiency in spatial databases, specifically PostGIS and advanced geospatial indexing/querying within PostgreSQL
  • Engineering Breadth: Database engineers must possess the full spectrum of skills required for the development of complex software systems. This includes experience in all aspects of software development supporting complex Multi-INT processing from initial planning and design to final installation and maintenance
  • Enterprise Computing & Design: Enterprise computing and architecture design capability for ground-based analysis systems, to include system information modeling and PostgreSQL database design
  • System Integration: Ability to incorporate system architecture using enterprise design, business process modeling (BPM), workflow implementation, and web-based/semantics-based development methodologies
  • Multi-Modal Data Fusion: Proven experience designing and implementing scalable PostgreSQL databases to ingest, integrate, and synthesize highly disparate, multi-source data feeds / Multi-INT fusion products (structured data streams, high-volume ingestion, raw telemetry, and imagery) to deliver mission-critical insights to tactical field operators and end-users in low-latency environments
  • Mission Domain Knowledge: Leverage knowledge of terrestrial and space surveillance methodologies, sensor technologies and capabilities, and the ability to envision new modes of operation via an evolutionary development process
  • SDLC Consultation: Experience in producing technical and user documentation, training and system orientation, and consulting with related development teams throughout the software development life cycle
  • Security Clearance: This position requires US Citizenship and an active DoD Top Secret/SCI clearance


Equivalent Spatial Technologies Reference

  • Candidates who possess 4+ years of experience in any of the following alternative spatial environments are highly encouraged to apply and will be considered equivalent:
    • Cloud Data Warehouses: Google BigQuery GIS, Amazon Redshift Spatial, Snowflake Geospatial
    • Relational Alternatives: Oracle Spatial & Graph, Microsoft SQL Server Spatial, MySQL Spatial
    • NoSQL / Search Spatial: Elasticsearch (Geo-shape/Geo-point), MongoDB Geospatial
    • Big Data Frameworks: Apache Sedona (GeoSpark), GeoMesa, Databricks Mosaic


Desired Qualifications:

    • Experience & Certifications: 5+ years of hands-on PostgreSQL administration, maintenance, and development experience. A PostgreSQL Professional Certification (or AWS/Azure Cloud Database Certification) is a strong plus, though equivalent production experience is highly valued
    • AI & Multi-Model Technology Strategy: Proven ability to evaluate, recommend, and architect next-generation data technologies to modernize legacy workflows. Experience assessing and integrating AI-ready extensions (such as pgvector for semantic search and RAG pipelines) and multi-model graph databases (specifically ArangoDB) alongside core relational systems
    • Team Collaboration: Proven track record collaborating within multi-disciplinary engineering environments, interfacing effectively with infrastructure, security, application development, AI/ML engineers, functional leads, and product/operational managers
    • Distributed & Hybrid Architectures: Experience designing, deploying, and maintaining multi-node PostgreSQL clusters, high-availability (HA) setups, and cloud-based configurations (e.g., AWS RDS/Aurora, Azure Database for PostgreSQL), as well as planning interoperability with distributed graph clusters like ArangoDB
    • High-Scale Data Processing: Expertise maintaining and scaling large, high-velocity datasets, specifically spatiotemporal (PostGIS) architectures, large time-series datasets, streaming event logs, and complex entity-relationship graphs
    • Massive Data Ingestion & Pipelines: Mastery of high-volume bulk loading, parallel data ingestion techniques, and ETL/ELT optimization strategies to feed both operational PostgreSQL databases and downstream AI/graph analytics engines
    • Advanced Data Security: Deep understanding of enterprise security models across relational and graph stores, including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Row-Level Security (RLS), multi-level secure access controls, and data security labeling/classification schemas
    • Performance Engineering & Lifecycle Maintenance: Strong skills in proactive database maintenance, routine patching, backup/recovery, performance tuning, and query profiling using tools such as pgBench, EXPLAIN ANALYZE, Dynatrace, and native PostgreSQL statistics


Riptide Technology, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer ensuring no employee or prospective employee will be discriminated against based on race, color, national origin, age, religion, disability status, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information or marital status with regards to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion or rehiring.

Job Title: Oracle Database Developer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2 - [Not open to C2C or 1099]

Salary Range: $115,000–$165,000 Annually

Experience Required: 4+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card holders, EAD holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. Bright Vision Technologies is unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

Bright Vision Technologies is seeking a Oracle Database Developer to implement, configure, integrate, or support enterprise platforms and business applications. The work combines process understanding, technical or functional configuration, testing, integration, documentation, and user support. The successful candidate will apply practical expertise in Oracle Database, SQL, PL/SQL, packages, procedures, indexing, query tuning, and database operations, work with cross-functional teams, and contribute to reliable, maintainable solutions through the delivery lifecycle.

  • Plan and execute unit, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing.
  • Support deployments, user adoption, issue resolution, and continuous process improvement.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience Required: typically 4+ years in a related professional role; exact threshold must match the approved requisition.
  • Practical experience with the role-specific technology stack: Oracle Database, SQL, PL/SQL, packages, procedures, indexing, query tuning, and database operations.
  • Experience implementing, developing, administering, or supporting the enterprise platform identified in the job title.
  • Strong understanding of relevant business processes and the platform’s core capabilities.
  • Experience gathering requirements, configuring or developing solutions, and documenting decisions.
  • Knowledge of integrations, data flows, testing, and production support.
  • Ability to work with business users, technical teams, and external partners.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Additional hands-on depth in Oracle Database, SQL, PL/SQL, packages, procedures, indexing, query tuning, and database operations.
  • Experience with cloud services, automation, and modern delivery practices relevant to the project.
  • Familiarity with secure development, accessibility, governance, or regulatory requirements where applicable.

descriptionHtml:
Why This Is An Exciting Role

As a Database Engineer - Entry level at Boeing Intelligence and Analytics, you responsibilities will include:

  • Providing technical expertise for database design, development, implementation, information storage and retrieval, data flow and analysis
  • Developing relational and/or Object-Oriented databases, database parser software, and database loading software
  • Developing a database structure that fits into the overall architecture of the system under development and has to make trades among data volumes, number of users, logical and physical distribution, response times, retention rules, security and domain controls.
  • Working primarily at the front end of the lifecycle-requirements through system acceptance testing and Initial Operational Capability (IOC)
  • Developing requirements from a project’s inception to its conclusion for a particular business and Information Technology (IT) subject matter area (i.e., simple to complex systems)
  • Assisting with recommendations for, and analysis and evaluation of systems improvements, optimization, development, and/or maintenance efforts
  • Translating a set of requirements and data into a usable document by creating or recreating ad hoc queries, scripts, and macros; updates existing queries, creates new ones to manipulate data into a master file; and builds complex systems using queries, tables, Open Database Connectivity and database storage and retrieval using Cloud methodologies

What Makes BI&A Different

As a fully owned subsidiary of The Boeing Company, BI&A offers an optimal mix of a small company environment with exceptional opportunities supported by a large corporation.

Every day, Boeing Intelligence & Analytics supports global missions by building and delivering intelligence, analytics, and cyber solutions that enable users to advance national security. From hardware and software engineering solutions to analytics that keep this nation safe, we create value that meets users’ needs. With vibrant partnerships and innovative approaches, we serve the Intelligence Community through innovation and vision. We have provided our customers with the tools needed to counter evolve global and cyber threats, and to improve wartime decision-making.

  • Our talented employees bring software development, systems engineering, and advanced analytics expertise.
  • We offer numerous prime contract opportunities with customers headquartered in Maryland, Virginia, and the District of Columbia, as well as subcontract opportunities that align with our areas of focus and additional opportunities nationwide through our parent company.
  • We have current open positions on awarded programs across diverse customer sets and are anticipating upcoming contract awards with a 5-year life cycle and an additional 5 option years.
  • Our diverse portfolio allows our employees to move to other projects and teams as they gain further proficiency in their current skill set and learn new skill sets along the way.
  • We offer hands-on access to cutting-edge technologies and a culture of technical excellence.

Experience And Qualifications

To be eligible for this demanding position, the ideal candidate should demonstrate the following experience and qualifications:

Required Education And Years Of Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline from an accredited college or university is required
  • Two years of additional DBE experience may be substituted for a Bachelor’s degree

Required Qualifications

  • Active TS/SCI with Polygraph Clearance
  • Experience supporting the database design, development, implementation, information storage and retrieval, data flow and analysis activities
  • Knowledge of the analysis and evaluation of system improvements, optimization, development and/or maintenance efforts
  • Knowledge of development of long and short-term requirements for database administration and design

Telework/Remote Availability: Telework/Remote work currently not authorized

Work Location(s): Annapolis Junction, MD

Summary Pay Range

Please note that the information shown below is a general guideline only. Pay is based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

$70,000 - $90,000

Job Description


As a Development Database Administrator, you’ll build database solutions that help complex digital products respond quickly and reliably.


The Sports Platform and PAM & MarTech teams within our Technology department develop low-latency data and database solutions for our website, app, member, and regulatory platforms. As a Development Database Administrator, you’ll develop database code, provide architectural guidance, and help improve the quality of database delivery across our products.


SQL Server supports the current platform, while Google Spanner and Kafka underpin newer services. You’ll translate product requirements into practical, well-performing solutions across complex, high-concurrency systems processing more than 1,000 transactions each second. This is a software development role focused on building, testing, tuning, and maintaining database systems at scale.


This role is included in our hybrid work from home policy.


The salary range for this role is between $85,000 and $135,000.


Qualifications

  • Extensive experience in database development using SQL Server or comparable relational technologies
  • Hands-on experience with managed databases, including Google Spanner, Cosmos DB, or DynamoDB
  • Strong knowledge of distributed systems and event-driven architectures
  • Demonstrated experience developing database solutions for high-concurrency, high-throughput environments
  • Proven ability to monitor, tune, and troubleshoot database performance
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and deliverables independently
  • Methodical approach to resolving complex database and performance issues


Additional Information

  • Develop high-performing database systems for our sports platform
  • Translate product requirements into practical solutions with development and testing teams
  • Write robust SQL functions, procedures, and scripts
  • Apply query analysis and tuning techniques to optimize database code across the department
  • Address day-to-day support and performance issues across database services
  • Drive improvements and maintenance across data and database systems
  • Conduct functional and performance testing to assess code quality and performance
  • Provide guidance, feedback, and support to junior developers
  • Create and maintain clear technical documentation

descriptionHtml:
Overview

Design the data foundation behind mission-critical geospatial systems.

Join Esri`s Professional Services organization and partner with Defense and Intelligence customers to design, implement, secure, and optimize enterprise database environments supporting geospatial applications.

You`ll bring deep database engineering expertise to complex customer environments, working across database architecture, performance, automation, security, high availability, disaster recovery, cloud database technologies, and spatial data. You`ll also advise customers on database design, migration, and integration approaches throughout the engagement lifecycle.

Esri has a Relocation Assistance Program and can provide support with relocating to the Washington DC area for this position.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable, secure, enterprise database environments
  • Configure and maintain database platforms
  • Develop high availability, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery strategies
  • Monitor and optimize database performance
  • Implement database security and access controls
  • Automate database loading, maintenance, and monitoring
  • Support database migration and integration initiatives
  • Apply geospatial concepts including spatial data types and spatial indexing
  • Advise customers on enterprise database best practices

Requirements

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in database design, administration, and optimization for Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or SAP HANA
  • Demonstrated experience with database design principles, data loading techniques, backup and recovery solutions, performance monitoring and tuning, database maintenance, and security
  • Scripting skills in SQL and Python for automation and data workflows
  • Experience with cloud-based database solutions (such as AWS RDS, Azure SQL Database)
  • Understanding of geospatial concepts such as spatial data types, coordinate systems, and spatial indexing
  • Ability to clearly communicate complex technical concepts to technical peers and non-technical project managers or customers
  • US citizenship with Active or Current (within 2 years of active) Top Secret Security Clearance with SCI eligibility
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, mathematics, GIS, or related STEM field

Recommended Qualifications

  • Experience with ArcGIS Enterprise geodatabases
  • Knowledge of integrating GIS with other enterprise systems
  • CompTIA Security + certification
  • One or more industry-standard IT certifications (such as Esri, Microsoft, Amazon, PostgreSQL, Oracle)
  • Master's degree in computer science, mathematics, GIS or related STEM field

Total RewardsEsri’s competitive total rewards strategy includes industry-leading health and welfare benefits: medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance for employees (and their families), 401(k) and profit-sharing programs, minimum accrual of 80 hours of vacation leave, twelve paid holidays throughout the calendar year, and opportunities for personal and professional growth. Base salary is one component of our total rewards strategy. Compensation decisions and the base range for this role take into account many factors including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs.

Who We Are

The program is on fire for cyber. In support of our customer, members of the team are responsible for providing full lifecycle support including analysis, design, development, integration, testing, procurement, deployment, security, training and sustainment for collection and antenna systems.

WHY JOIN US

Your Health, Your Wealth, Your Life

Our flexible schedules, competitive pay and comprehensive benefits enable you to live a healthy, fulfilling life at and outside of work.

Learn more about Lockheed Martin’s competitive and comprehensive benefits package.

We support our employees, so they can support our mission.

Designs, develops, builds, analyzes, evaluates and installs database management systems to include database modeling and design, relational database architecture, metadata and repository creation and configuration management. Uses data mapping, data mining and data transformational analysis tools to design and develop databases. Determines data storage and optimum storage requirements. Prepares system requirements, source analysis and process analyses and design throughout the database implementation.

Basic Qualifications

Familiarity with relational and non-relational databases to include but not limited to Oracle, Postgres, Mongo and Redis. Experience with SQL and the associated tools (SQL Developer, etc…)

Support the development of long and short-term requirements for database administration and design.

No demonstrated experience is required. Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline from an accredited college or university is required. Five (5) years of DBE experience may be substituted for a bachelor's degree.

Experience with Elasticsearch

As a Software Engineer at Applied Materials, you’ll dive deep into ground-breaking technologies—like machine learning and AI—to craft novel software solutions that solve our customers’ high-value problems. Our Software Engineers are responsible for designing, prototyping, developing, and debugging software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices to ensure quality and functionality. You'll develop software documentation and test procedures, troubleshoot software problems, and communicate with internal customers to understand project requirements. As part of our team, you'll contribute your expertise in intricate systems, deciphering code, and anticipating software behaviors to ensure Applied remains the leader in the semiconductor and display sectors.

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated Software Engineer with 4-6 years of experience in database development, performance optimization, and data-intensive applications. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Oracle and PostgreSQL databases, along with experience working with time-series databases such as KDB+/q. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, optimizing, and maintaining scalable database solutions that support high-volume transactional and analytical workloads.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain database solutions using Oracle and PostgreSQL.
  • Develop complex SQL queries, PL/SQL procedures, functions, packages, and triggers.
  • Design and optimize database schemas, data models, and indexing strategies for performance and scalability.
  • Work with time-series databases such as KDB+ to store, process, and analyze large volumes of time-based data.
  • Monitor database performance and implement tuning strategies to improve query execution and system efficiency.
  • Troubleshoot database issues, identify bottlenecks, and implement corrective actions.
  • Develop and maintain data ingestion, ETL, and data synchronization processes.
  • Collaborate with software engineering teams to integrate database solutions into enterprise applications.
  • Implement database security, backup, recovery, and high-availability solutions.
  • Participate in code reviews, system design discussions, and production support activities.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation for database architectures and operational procedures.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
  • 4-6 years of hands-on experience with Oracle and PostgreSQL databases.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and database performance tuning.
  • Experience developing PL/SQL packages, procedures, functions, and database objects.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL administration, query optimization, indexing, and replication.
  • Experience working with time-series databases such as KDB+/q or similar platforms.
  • Strong understanding of relational database concepts, data modeling, and database design.
  • Experience with database migration, backup, recovery, and troubleshooting.
  • Knowledge of Linux/Unix environments and scripting languages.
  • Familiarity with source control systems such as Git.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with high-volume data processing and real-time analytics platforms.
  • Knowledge of distributed systems and scalable database architectures.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
  • Familiarity with data streaming technologies and messaging frameworks.
  • Experience supporting mission-critical enterprise applications.

Skills

  • Oracle Database
  • PostgreSQL
  • KDB+/q (Time-Series Database)
  • SQL & PL/SQL
  • Database Performance Tuning
  • Data Modeling
  • Query Optimization
  • Replication & High Availability
  • ETL/Data Integration
  • Linux/Unix
  • Git

This individual will perform development, analysis, testing, debugging, documentation, implementation, and maintenance of interfaces to support the Enterprise Data Warehouse and related applications. They will consult with other technical resources and key departmental users on solutions and best practices. They will monitor performance and effectiveness of the data warehouse and recommend changes as appropriate.

Job Description

At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

Database Engineer - Entry Level

Why This is an Exciting Role:

As a Database Engineer - Entry level at Boeing Intelligence and Analytics, you responsibilities will include:


  • Providing technical expertise for database design, development, implementation, information storage and retrieval, data flow and analysis
  • Developing relational and/or Object-Oriented databases, database parser software, and database loading software
  • Developing a database structure that fits into the overall architecture of the system under development and has to make trades among data volumes, number of users, logical and physical distribution, response times, retention rules, security and domain controls.
  • Working primarily at the front end of the lifecycle-requirements through system acceptance testing and Initial Operational Capability (IOC)
  • Developing requirements from a project’s inception to its conclusion for a particular business and Information Technology (IT) subject matter area (i.e., simple to complex systems)
  • Assisting with recommendations for, and analysis and evaluation of systems improvements, optimization, development, and/or maintenance efforts
  • Translating a set of requirements and data into a usable document by creating or recreating ad hoc queries, scripts, and macros; updates existing queries, creates new ones to manipulate data into a master file; and builds complex systems using queries, tables, Open Database Connectivity and database storage and retrieval using Cloud methodologies


What Makes BI&A Different:

As a fully owned subsidiary of The Boeing Company, BI&A offers an optimal mix of a small company environment with exceptional opportunities supported by a large corporation.

Every day, Boeing Intelligence & Analytics supports global missions by building and delivering intelligence, analytics, and cyber solutions that enable users to advance national security. From hardware and software engineering solutions to analytics that keep this nation safe, we create value that meets users’ needs. With vibrant partnerships and innovative approaches, we serve the Intelligence Community through innovation and vision. We have provided our customers with the tools needed to counter evolve global and cyber threats, and to improve wartime decision-making.


  • Our talented employees bring software development, systems engineering, and advanced analytics expertise.
  • We offer numerous prime contract opportunities with customers headquartered in Maryland, Virginia, and the District of Columbia, as well as subcontract opportunities that align with our areas of focus and additional opportunities nationwide through our parent company.
  • We have current open positions on awarded programs across diverse customer sets and are anticipating upcoming contract awards with a 5-year life cycle and an additional 5 option years.
  • Our diverse portfolio allows our employees to move to other projects and teams as they gain further proficiency in their current skill set and learn new skill sets along the way.
  • We offer hands-on access to cutting-edge technologies and a culture of technical excellence.

To be eligible for this demanding position, the ideal candidate should demonstrate the following experience and qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline from an accredited college or university is required

descriptionHtml:
About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

Peraton has an immediate opening for a Jr./Mid-level Software & Database Engineer who will join our team at the White Sands Complex in Las Cruces, NM. Your role in this position will be to serve as a core technical contributor responsible for building, enhancing, and maintaining modern software and data systems. This role combines full lifecycle software engineering with deep database expertise across Oracle and PostgreSQL environments. The engineer will collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop resilient applications, design high-performance schemas, troubleshoot system issues, and ensure reliable data integration across mission-critical platforms.

Core Responsibilities

  • Perform systems modeling, simulation, and analysis to create effective telemetry, tracking, and command software solutions.
  • Design, develop, troubleshoot, and analyze software that interfaces with hardware systems.
  • Customize third-party applications and maintain libraries, documentation, and manuals.
  • Provide first-level support to customers and communicate technical status updates to leadership.
  • Design and maintain server-side logic using Oracle PL/SQL and PostgreSQL PL/pgSQL.
  • Develop scalable relational schemas, manage migrations, and support new software feature deployments.
  • Conduct performance tuning using Oracle AWR/ASH, TKPROF, and PostgreSQL EXPLAIN ANALYZE.
  • Support database modernization and migration efforts across Oracle and PostgreSQL.
  • Optimize integration between applications and databases, including connection pooling and data access layers.

#HIRE4SENSE

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, mathematics or related technical field and 5 years of relative experience; Master's degree and 3 years of experience.
  • Security clearance - this position requires the candidate to be able to obtain a DoD Secret security clearance and to maintain the clearance thereafter.
  • You must be a US Citizen and show proof of citizenship.
  • Must be able to maintain ability to access government worksite.
  • 2+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • 3-5+ years of hands-on database engineering or backend development working with Oracle and PostgreSQL.
  • Proficiency writing advanced logic in Oracle PL/SQL and PostgreSQL PL/pgSQL.
  • Experience supporting SDLC processes within Agile/Scrum environments and managing database objects via Git.
  • Security clearance - this position requires the candidate to be able to obtain a DoD Secret security clearance and to maintain the clearance thereafter.
  • You must be a US Citizen and show proof of citizenship.
  • Must be able to maintain ability to access government worksite.

Preferred & Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience with OpenVMS, Linux, or Windows operating systems.
  • Experience working with SQL databases and object-oriented languages such as Ada, C++, or Java.
  • Familiarity with schema migration tools.
  • Cloud-hosted database experience.
  • Strong scripting skills in Python, Bash, or shell environments.
  • Understanding of database replication technologies (GoldenGate, PostgreSQL streaming replication).
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in team environments and interact with customers.

Details

Target Salary Range: $80,000 - $128,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

Application Statements: The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate's own.

Position Summary


We are seeking a hands-on database developer with expertise in both high-performance T-SQL on SQL Server and building on a data platform. The successful candidate will own stored procedures and data-movement processes that support enterprise applications, collaborate closely with backend development teams, and lead initiatives to adopt advanced enterprise data solutions. This role involves daily coding as well as establishing best practices and standards for the team.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain stored procedures, functions, views, and triggers on Microsoft SQL Server.
  • Develop and manage complex T-SQL scripts for data movement, including ETL/ELT processes, batch loads, and incremental data synchronization.
  • Optimize query performance through indexing, execution plan analysis, and resolving issues such as blocking, deadlocks, and long-running jobs.
  • Maintain database schema changes, deployment scripts, and version control using CI/CD pipelines.
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and auditability of database code.
  • Collaborate with the .NET backend team to translate application requirements into well-designed database objects and data-access patterns.
  • Review and improve data-access code from application sources such as Entity Framework, Dapper, and ADO.NET.
  • Participate in sprint planning, design reviews, and code reviews as part of the engineering team.
  • Support enterprise data platform adoption by building and establishing reference architectures, connection patterns, and reusable templates.
  • Build and deploy enterprise data solutions, including semantic modeling and sample queries, to facilitate business user access.
  • Prototype and implement additional AI-related capabilities on the data platform, such as vector search and model serving.
  • Work with business stakeholders to identify high-impact use cases and evaluate outcomes.

Why This Opportunity May Be Appealing


This role offers the chance to work at the forefront of enterprise data innovations within a collaborative environment. You will have the opportunity to lead impactful projects, influence core data architecture, and work with cutting-edge tools and platforms. The position also provides professional growth in a high-demand skill set, supporting a variety of data initiatives across the organization.

Dexian stands at the forefront of Talent + Technology solutions with a presence spanning more than 70 locations worldwide and a team exceeding 10,000 professionals. Oracle PL/SQL Developer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Oracle PL/SQL Developer

Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)

Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2

Salary Range: $120,000–$180,000 Annually

Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Oracle PL/SQL Developer to design, develop, and optimize enterprise database solutions supporting high-volume transactional systems, financial applications, regulatory reporting, and mission-critical business operations. This role focuses on building scalable PL/SQL applications, optimizing complex SQL queries, developing database objects, and ensuring high availability and performance across large Oracle environments.

You will work closely with application developers, database administrators, data architects, QA engineers, and business analysts to build efficient database solutions that support enterprise applications, cloud modernization initiatives, and data integration platforms. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in Oracle Database technologies, advanced PL/SQL programming, query optimization, and performance tuning while maintaining high standards for data integrity, security, and reliability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain complex PL/SQL packages, stored procedures, functions, triggers, and database objects supporting enterprise applications.
  • Develop highly optimized SQL queries for large transactional and analytical databases.
  • Design scalable database schemas, indexing strategies, partitioning models, and performance optimization techniques.
  • Build ETL processes and database integration components for enterprise data movement and synchronization.
  • Develop batch processing jobs and automated database workflows supporting business-critical operations.
  • Analyze execution plans, identify SQL bottlenecks, and optimize database performance for high-volume systems.
  • Collaborate with application development teams to design efficient database access patterns and API integrations.
  • Implement database security, auditing, role-based access controls, and data encryption standards.
  • Develop database migration scripts, deployment packages, and release automation processes.
  • Perform database code reviews, troubleshoot production issues, and resolve complex data integrity problems.
  • Support database modernization initiatives involving Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Azure, or AWS.
  • Participate in Agile development activities, architecture reviews, and production support rotations.

Required Skills

  • Six or more years of professional experience developing enterprise Oracle database solutions.
  • Strong expertise in Oracle PL/SQL including packages, stored procedures, functions, cursors, triggers, collections, exceptions, and dynamic SQL.
  • Advanced SQL development skills with complex joins, Common Table Expressions (CTEs), analytical functions, window functions, and query optimization.
  • Extensive experience with Oracle Database 12c, 19c, or newer enterprise environments.
  • Strong understanding of Oracle indexing, partitioning, materialized views, execution plans, and optimizer statistics.
  • Experience optimizing high-volume OLTP and OLAP database workloads.
  • Hands-on experience with Oracle SQL Developer, TOAD, SQL*Plus, or similar Oracle development tools.
  • Experience developing ETL processes and integrating Oracle databases with external systems.
  • Familiarity with Oracle Data Pump, RMAN, and database migration methodologies.
  • Experience working with Oracle Advanced Queuing (AQ), Scheduler, and database jobs.
  • Experience integrating Oracle databases with Java, .NET, Python, or REST-based enterprise applications.
  • Strong understanding of database normalization, data modeling, and relational database design principles.
  • Experience using Git, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or CI/CD pipelines for database deployment automation.
  • Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and performance tuning skills.
  • Experience working in Agile Scrum development environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Database Services or Autonomous Database.
  • Familiarity with Oracle Exadata, RAC (Real Application Clusters), and Data Guard environments.
  • Experience with Oracle GoldenGate, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), or Oracle SOA Suite.
  • Knowledge of Oracle APEX application development.
  • Experience developing financial, healthcare, insurance, retail, or government enterprise applications.
  • Familiarity with cloud migration strategies from on-premises Oracle databases to OCI, Azure, or AWS.
  • Experience with shell scripting, Python, or PowerShell for database automation.
  • Knowledge of enterprise data warehousing and dimensional modeling concepts.
  • Oracle Database Administration or Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) certifications are highly desirable.
  • Experience supporting highly regulated environments requiring auditability, compliance, and data governance.

Project Environment

You will be joining an enterprise data engineering and application modernization team responsible for supporting mission-critical Oracle database platforms serving multiple business units. Current initiatives include:

  • Enterprise financial transaction processing systems
  • Healthcare claims and patient management platforms
  • Insurance policy administration and billing systems
  • Large-scale ERP and supply chain applications
  • Cloud migration of Oracle databases to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
  • Regulatory reporting and compliance data platforms
  • Enterprise data integration and batch processing solutions
  • High-availability Oracle environments supporting millions of daily transactions
  • Performance optimization and modernization of legacy PL/SQL applications

This is a hands-on engineering role where you will contribute to database architecture, PL/SQL development, SQL optimization, cloud migration, production support, and continuous improvement of enterprise Oracle platforms.

How To Apply

Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to Harry@bvteck.com or contact us at (908) 676-4399. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.

- Implement database security, auditing, role-based access controls, and data encryption standards. 
- Develop database migration scripts, deployment packages, and release automation processes. 
- Perform database code reviews, troubleshoot production issues, and resolve complex data integrity problems. 
- Support database modernization initiatives involving Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Azure, or AWS. 
- Participate in Agile development activities, architecture reviews, and production support rotations. 

Required Skills



- Six or more years of professional experience developing enterprise Oracle database solutions. 
- Strong expertise in Oracle PL/SQL including packages, stored procedures, functions, cursors, triggers, collections, exceptions, and dynamic SQL. 
- Advanced SQL development skills with complex joins, Common Table Expressions (CTEs), analytical functions, window functions, and query optimization. 
- Extensive experience with Oracle Database 12c, 19c, or newer enterprise environments. 
- Strong understanding of Oracle indexing, partitioning, materialized views, execution plans, and optimizer statistics. 
- Experience optimizing high-volume OLTP and OLAP database workloads. 
- Hands-on experience with Oracle SQL Developer, TOAD, SQL*Plus, or similar Oracle development tools. 
- Experience developing ETL processes and integrating Oracle databases with external systems. 
- Familiarity with Oracle Data Pump, RMAN, and database migration methodologies. 
- Experience working with Oracle Advanced Queuing (AQ), Scheduler, and database jobs. 
- Experience integrating Oracle databases with Java, .NET, Python, or REST-based enterprise applications. 
- Strong understanding of database normalization, data modeling, and relational database design principles. 
- Experience using Git, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or CI/CD pipelines for database deployment automation. 
- Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and performance tuning skills. 
- Experience working in Agile Scrum development environments. 

Preferred Qualifications



- Experience working with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Database Services or Autonomous Database. 
- Familiarity with Oracle Exadata, RAC (Real Application Clusters), and Data Guard environments. 
- Experience with Oracle GoldenGate, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), or Oracle SOA Suite. 
- Knowledge of Oracle APEX application development. 
- Experience developing financial, healthcare, insurance, retail, or government enterprise applications. 
- Familiarity with cloud migration strategies from on-premises Oracle databases to OCI, Azure, or AWS. 
- Experience with shell scripting, Python, or PowerShell for database automation. 
- Knowledge of enterprise data warehousing and dimensional modeling concepts. 
- Oracle Database Administration or Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) certifications are highly desirable. 
- Experience supporting highly regulated environments requiring auditability, compliance, and data governance. 

Project Environment

You will be joining an enterprise data engineering and application modernization team responsible for supporting mission-critical Oracle database platforms serving multiple business units. Current initiatives include:



- Enterprise financial transaction processing systems 
- Healthcare claims and patient management platforms 
- Insurance policy administration and billing systems 
- Large-scale ERP and supply chain applications 
- Cloud migration of Oracle databases to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) 
- Regulatory reporting and compliance data platforms 
- Enterprise data integration and batch processing solutions 
- High-availability Oracle environments supporting millions of daily transactions 
- Performance optimization and modernization of legacy PL/SQL applications 

This is a hands-on engineering role where you will contribute to database architecture, PL/SQL development, SQL optimization, cloud migration, production support, and continuous improvement of enterprise Oracle platforms.

At Accora, we foster and embrace a distinct set of values that we live by and instill in all aspects of our organization: dedication, commitment, partnership, trust, and recognition. We have incorporated these values into successful delivery for our customers since 1988. Accora believes in ensuring its employees feel deeply connected to Accora, recognizing successes and hard work, and providing continuous opportunities to learn and grow. Our people are entrepreneurial thinkers who combine mindset, vision, and experience to drive value – not only for us as an organization, but also for the clients we support. We promote a collaborative culture with our clients, and with each other, as one team working towards a common vision. We’d love you to join our team!

Workplace: Ashburn, VA

Job Summary

Accora Federal is looking for a Database Developer to join a collaborative team of database developers and administrators supporting a large, complex application development program. This role focuses on designing, developing, and maintaining database structures, as well as managing and optimizing data within enterprise-scale environments.

This position offers the opportunity to work in a dynamic, Agile environment while expanding expertise across modern data platforms, cloud technologies, and advanced data engineering practices.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain database structures to support application development initiatives
  • Create, modify, and optimize complex SQL queries in high-volume, complex data environments
  • Perform data profiling, cleansing, transformation, and reporting activities
  • Develop and maintain ETL processes and data staging solutions
  • Write and manage DDL, DML, and DCL statements to support database operations
  • Troubleshoot performance issues and implement query tuning and optimization strategies
  • Support data migration, validation, and pipeline development within AWS environments
  • Develop automation scripts using Python to support database and data processing tasks
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and clients to design data solutions within technical and business constraints
  • Utilize version control tools (e.g., Git) to manage code and database changes
  • Monitor and support system performance using tools such as CloudWatch, Kibana, and Dynatrace
  • Continuously evaluate and adopt new tools and technologies to improve data solutions

Education And Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field
  • 5+ years of experience in database development roles

Required Skills

  • Strong experience with: Data profiling, cleansing, and ETL processes, writing and optimizing complex SQL queries, query tuning and performance optimization, and database programming (DDL, DML, DCL).
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL database development
  • Experience developing Python scripts for automation or data processing
  • Experience with Git or other version control systems
  • Working knowledge of AWS services, including Data migration and validation, data pipelines, monitoring tools (CloudWatch, Kibana, Dynatrace).
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills
  • Ability to quickly learn new tools and technologies
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical teams and clients

Desired Skills

  • Experience with database administration (DBA) functions
  • Experience working in Agile environments and using tools such as Jira
  • Willingness and ability to learn DB2 if not currently proficient

Security Clearance

  • Willing and eligible to obtain a CBP public Trust.

Physical & Work Environment Requirements

Employees must be able to perform the essential functions of this position, with or without accommodation.

  • Ability to remain stationary for extended periods while working at a computer.
  • Frequently operate standard office equipment, including computers and telephones.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in person, by telephone, video conference, and email.
  • Occasionally move about the office and lift up to 20 pounds.
  • Ability to work the assigned schedule with regular and reliable attendance.
  • Ability to travel up to 10% as required.

Our team of cleared professionals specializes in Agile DevSecOps, Cloud Migration and Modernization, Data Science and Analytics, Human Capital Management, Operations and Enablement, Application Transformation, All-Source Intelligence, Geospatial Production, Engineering and Integrated Services, and Cybersecurity.

Our service extends through federal, state, and local Government, the private sector, and higher education. Some of our notable clients include the Department of Homeland Security, U.S. Customs and Border Protection, the U.S. Senate, the U.S. Courts, the U.S. Census Bureau, the U.S. Navy, and more.

Accora’s 401(k) plan is available to all employees and includes a company matching contribution.

Accora has launched several programs to focus on employee engagement, wellness, and assistance. These include:

  • The Accora Cares program: 30/60/90-day wellness check-ins, personal development, financial management, and stress management seminars, and more
  • A formal mentorship program
  • Job shadowing and cross-training opportunities
  • Brand Ambassador program
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) - Access to various support resources to include counseling, legal guidance, financial planning, and more
  • Monthly team-building events

Green Expert Technology (GreenXT) is seeking a SQL Developer to join our team to to provide RCOH SQL developer support for the SUPSHIP Newport News RCOH Team.

As the RCOH SQL developer, you will be responsible for providing Structured Query Language (SQL) support services to SUPSHIPNN RCOH project teams and ensuring interoperability across legacy and modern data platforms.

About GreenXT

GreenXT is comprised of technical and business leaders. We hire intelligent, hardworking, and dedicated people who not only possess the desire to learn and improve their skills but want to contribute to the design and development of innovative solutions that address the Navy’s greatest technological challenges. We hired each of our employees because we believe they are exceptional, have the ability to excel at their job, and will contribute positively to GreenXT.

GreenXT’s business office strives to be the most efficient and effective business office supporting our customers. Our personnel aspire to become leaders through organized, rigorous, and diligent efforts. GreenXT employees are always looking to help one another succeed. We look out for each other and cross-train so that the product we deliver is one that we’re confident in and proud of. We strongly believe in growth and providing our workforce with career development opportunities to help everyone achieve their goals.

We take pride in our support of the United States Navy. We never forget that the work we do is ultimately in support of America’s warfighter and serving those who serve. The idea that our hard work can help make their jobs easier, assist them to defend our nation, and can help ensure they return home safely to their loved ones motivates us every day, and we hope that you join us on that mission!

Responsibilities

  • Maintain, enhance, develop, and troubleshoot issues/bugs in existing Access applications and vintage Microsoft Access “accdb” databases.
  • Responsible for maintaining and administering SQL Server databases, including backups, tuning, modifying existing tables/queries, security, and managing user accounts.
  • Design, develop, repair, and optimize SQL database-driven applications while ensuring strict compliance with data integrity and Cybersecurity requirements.
  • Work closely with Contracting Officers, Planning Manager(s), and application users to ensure required functionality of existing code, evaluate/recommend software solutions, and develop new features.
  • Convert Access SQL statements into SQL server syntax, design GUI forms in Access, and debug code using VBA.
  • Improve the security features of Access applications and assist SUPSHIP with the Authority to Operate (ATO) process when necessary.
  • Incorporate software versioning and utilize software version control systems for existing applications.


Requirements

  • Active DoD Secret Level Security Clearance is required for this position
  • Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited university
  • Minimum of ten years of relevant experience with working as a member of a multifunctional team.
  • Working knowledge of MS SQL Server (12.0 and above) and vintage Microsoft Access “accdb” databases. Working knowledge of software version control system(s).
  • Strong knowledge of MS Excel, Access, PowerPoint, and Outlook. Ability to design forms (GUI) and debug code (VBA) in Access.
  • Must possess Security+ or equivalent certification. SQL server certification.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and problem-solving abilities.


Desired Qualifications:

  • Project/Program Management experience
  • Working knowledge of AWS


Job Benefits

  • Competitive Pay and PTO
  • 11 Paid Holidays
  • 401(k) with Matching
  • Medical and Dental Insurance
  • Life and Disability Insurance

About Us

CDK Global is a leading provider of cloud-based software to dealerships and Original Equipment Manufacturers (“OEMs”) across automotive and related industries. The Company’s cloud-based, software as a service (“SaaS”) platform enables dealerships to manage their end-to-end business operations including the acquisition, sale, financing, insuring, repair, and maintenance of vehicles. By automating and streamlining critical workflows, the integrated platform of modern solutions enables dealers to sell and service more vehicles by creating simple and convenient experiences for customers and improves their financial and operational performance.

Position Summary

We are looking for an Associate Database Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team. This is a hands-on database development role focused on designing, implementing, reviewing, optimizing, and supporting database solutions that power critical business applications. Working alongside software engineers, architects, and platform teams, you will help build and evolve database schemas, stored procedures, queries, and data access patterns across Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL environments.

This role is ideal for someone early in their career who enjoys solving technical problems, working with data, and learning how modern applications scale. You will contribute to database design decisions, support application development initiatives, improve performance and reliability, and help ensure database changes are delivered safely and efficiently within AWS-hosted environments. While operational support is part of the role, this is primarily a database engineering and development position rather than a traditional database administration (DBA) role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain database objects, including tables, views, stored procedures, functions, and scripts.
  • Partner with application development teams to design scalable and efficient data models.
  • Review proposed database changes for quality, performance, maintainability, and adherence to standards.
  • Analyze and optimize SQL queries, indexes, and execution plans to improve application performance.
  • Support database deployments and schema changes through established release processes.
  • Troubleshoot database-related application issues and assist in root cause analysis.
  • Participate in code reviews and database design discussions.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation for database solutions and standards.
  • Assist with data migrations, integrations, and modernization initiatives.
  • Contribute to database monitoring, reliability improvements, and operational support activities.
  • Collaborate with teams across engineering, product, and operations to deliver high-quality solutions.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related field.
  • 0-2 years of experience in software development, database development, or related technical roles.
  • Foundational knowledge of relational database concepts and SQL.
  • Exposure to Microsoft SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL through coursework, internships, projects, or professional experience.
  • Understanding of database design principles, normalization, indexing, and data modeling.
  • Familiarity with source control systems such as Git.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Eagerness to learn and grow within a collaborative engineering environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing SQL queries, stored procedures, or database-backed applications.
  • Familiarity with AWS services and cloud-native application architectures.
  • Exposure to CI/CD tools and automated deployment practices.
  • Understanding of application performance tuning and troubleshooting.
  • Experience working in Agile software development environments.

What Success Looks Like

  • Delivers high-quality database changes that meet functional and performance requirements.
  • Contributes to application scalability, reliability, and maintainability through sound database design.
  • Works effectively with software engineering teams to solve data-related challenges.
  • Continuously develops technical expertise in SQL Server, PostgreSQL, AWS, and modern engineering practices.

Level: Associate (0-2 Years Experience)

Description

Sanmina Corporation (Nasdaq: SANM) is a global powerhouse in integrated manufacturing solutions serving the fastest growing segments of the global Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) market. We are a global engine providing the end-to-end manufacturing backbone for the world's most essential and innovative brands. Whether it's autonomous vehicles, life-saving medical tech, next-gen aerospace, or AI/cloud infrastructure - our integrated solutions don’t just meet standards—they redefine them.

At SCI Technology, a Sanmina Company, we serve those who serve by delivering innovative, trusted and comprehensive products and services that meet and exceed the unique needs of the Defense and Aerospace sector. From avionics to tactical and airborne communications, counter-UAS, integrated manufacturing and cradle-to-grave product life cycle support, we deliver high-reliability solutions that keep service members connected and protected in the field.

Our heritage dates to 1961, as an early supplier to the space program in Huntsville, Alabama. Today, SCI offers a complete range of Defense & Aerospace solutions through our three business segments – Products, Systems Build, and Life Cycle Services. It’s SCI summed up - ALL WE DO to serve those who serve.

Join the Oracle Applications team at Sanmina Corporation to drive the ongoing development, optimization, and support for the SCI Defense and Aerospace division. We are looking for a Senior Oracle PL/SQL Developer to design, develop, and troubleshoot core database modules and system interfaces, collaborating closely with analysts, project managers, and cross-functional developers.

What You'll Do

  • Application Development: Design, develop, and maintain complex database objects—including Stored Procedures, Functions, Packages, and Triggers—using SQL and PL/SQL.
  • System Integration: Develop and support robust system interfaces; design and maintain materialized views for data replication in distributed environments.
  • Collaboration & Documentation: Coordinate with project managers and analysts to gather specifications for core modules, draft technical design documents, and document processes for effective evaluation.
  • Performance Optimization: Monitor existing PL/SQL packages and stored procedures, recommending tuning strategies for business process improvements where needed.
  • Troubleshooting & Support: Act as a technical point of contact to troubleshoot user-reported issues and ensure efficient transitions of technical designs to application developers.
  • SDLC Management: Participate in all phases of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) from analysis to design, testing, and implementation, ensuring timely delivery against aggressive deadlines.

What You'll Bring

  • Education & Experience: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent experience with at least 5 years of proven experience as an Oracle PL/SQL Developer, ideally in a manufacturing, defense, or aerospace environment.
  • Core Technologies: Experience in Oracle Relational Database Management Systems (RDBMS) and application development using Oracle 11g/10g/6i.
  • Database Programming: Hands-on experience in SQL, PL/SQL, SQLPLUS, SQLLOADER, and TOAD (or SQL Developer).
  • Advanced PL/SQL: Experience with table triggers, bulk collections, and analytical functions.
  • Oracle Supplied Packages: Working knowledge of DBMS_SQL, DBMS_JOB, and UTL_FILE.
  • Database Architecture: Ability to create and modify Tables, Views, Constraints, and Indexes.

How To Stand Out

  • Data Warehousing & ETL: Familiarity with data warehouse concepts, Extract-Transform-Load processes, and data migration.
  • Scripting: Proficiency in Unix/Linux shell scripting, Python, or Java.
  • Legacy Oracle: Experience with Oracle Forms (6i) and Oracle Reports (6i).

Why Join Us? At Sanmina, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. Your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

Sanmina provides equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

  • 1157 or asylee under 8 U.S.C.

Requisition Id 17431

Overview:

We seek an experienced Senior Oracle Database Administrator (DBA)/Developer for the Neutrons Systems Engineering and Support group to design, maintain and optimize our Oracle database environment. The Neutron Systems Engineering and Support group provides technical expertise and computing support to Neutron Science Directorates (NScD) and the Neutron Upgrades Project Office (NUPO). NScD operates the High Flux Isotope Reactor (HFIR) and the Spallation Neutron Source (SNS), the world’s most powerful pulsed accelerator-based neutron source.

As a DBA/developer, you are responsible for a deep administrative expertise with strong development skills making it ideal for someone who can architect reliable data solutions while collaborating closely with our end users, application developers, and infrastructure teams.

This position reports directly to the Neutron Systems Engineering and Support group lead, in the Research Computing Support Division (RSCD) at Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL).

What We're Looking For:

A self-motivated professional who takes ownership of database reliability and application delivery, communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and brings a continuous improvement mindset to everything they do.

Major Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Install, configure, patch, and upgrade Oracle Database environments (19c/26ai preferred) in both standalone and Oracle Database Appliance environments.
  • Design, develop, and optimize PL/SQL stored procedures, functions, packages, triggers, and views.
  • Design, develop, and deploy low-code web applications using Oracle APEX, including custom themes, interactive reports, forms, and REST-enabled data services.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate requirements into functional APEX applications.
  • Manage APEX workspaces, application security, and user access controls.
  • Integrate APEX applications with external systems via RESTful web services and Oracle REST Data Services (ORDS).
  • Maintain and upgrade APEX environments across development, test, and production instances.
  • Perform capacity planning, performance tuning, and query optimization using tools such as AWR, ADDM, and Explain Plan.
  • Manage backup and recovery strategies using RMAN; ensure RPO/RTO targets are met.
  • Implement and maintain Oracle Data Guard, RAC, and/or ASM environments.
  • Monitor database health, availability, and security; respond to and resolve incidents.
  • Develop and enforce database standards, naming conventions, and change management procedures.
  • Collaborate with developers to review schema designs, indexing strategies, and data models.
  • Support data migrations and integrations.
  • Participate in on-call rotation for critical database support, as needed.
  • Deliver ORNL’s mission by aligning behaviors, priorities, and interactions with our core values of Impact, Integrity, Teamwork, Safety, and Service. Promote equal opportunity by fostering a respectful workplace – in how we treat one another, work together, and measure success.

Basic Qualifications:

  • A BS in information technology, information systems, computer science, computer engineering, business, science, or a related field of study and a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience required for consideration. An overall combination of equivalent education and experience may be considered.
  • 5+ years of Oracle DBA/Developer experience in a production enterprise environment.
  • Strong proficiency in PL/SQL development and SQL tuning.
  • Hands-on experience with Oracle RAC, Data Guard, ASM, and RMAN.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining production applications in Oracle APEX (version 22.x or later preferred).
  • Proficiency with ORDS for REST API development and deployment.
  • Familiarity with APEX security models, session state, and authentication schemes.
  • Solid understanding of Oracle security best practices (roles, privileges, auditing, TDE).
  • Experience with Oracle 19c or later.
  • Familiarity with Linux/Unix system administration in a database context.
  • Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) or equivalent certification.
  • Experience with APEX plug-ins, Universal Theme customization, and JavaScript/CSS extensions.
  • Oracle APEX certification or demonstrated portfolio of delivered APEX applications.
  • Exposure to DevOps practices and tools (Git, CI/CD pipelines, Ansible).
  • Knowledge of complementary databases (PostgreSQL, SQL Server) a plus.
  • Experience working at a high energy physics facility or DOE lab.

Special Requirements:

  • Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  • For employment at Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL), a Real ID compliant form of identification will be required. Additionally, ORNL is subject to Department of Energy (DOE) access restrictions. All employees must also be able to obtain and maintain a federal Personal Identity Verification (PIV) card as mandated by Homeland Security Presidential Directive 12 (HSPD-12) and Department of Energy (DOE) Order 473.1A, which requires a favorable post-employment background investigation.
  • To obtain this credential, new employees must successfully complete and pass a Federal Tier 1 background check investigation. This investigation includes a declaration of illegal drug activities, including use, supply, possession, or manufacture within the last year. This includes marijuana and cannabis derivatives, which are still considered illegal under federal law, regardless of state laws.

About ORNL:

As a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) Office of Science national laboratory, ORNL has an impressive 80-year legacy of addressing the nation’s most pressing challenges. Our team is made up of over 7,000 dedicated and innovative individuals! Our goal is to create an environment where a variety of perspectives and backgrounds are valued, ensuring ORNL is known as a top choice for employment. These principles are essential for supporting our broader mission to drive scientific breakthroughs and translate them into solutions for energy, environmental, and security challenges facing the nation.

ORNL offers competitive pay and benefits programs to attract and retain individuals who demonstrate exceptional work behaviors. The laboratory provides a range of employee benefits, including medical and retirement plans and flexible work hours, to support the well-being of you and your family. Employee amenities such as on-site fitness, banking, and cafeteria facilities are also available for added convenience.

Other benefits include the following: Prescription Drug Plan, Dental Plan, Vision Plan, 401(k) Retirement Plan, Contributory Pension Plan, Life Insurance, Disability Benefits, Generous Vacation and Holidays, Parental Leave, Legal Insurance with Identity Theft Protection, Employee Assistance Plan, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, Wellness Programs, Educational Assistance, Relocation Assistance, and Employee Discounts.

This position will remain open for a minimum of 5 days after which it will close when a qualified candidate is identified and/or hired.

We accept Word (.doc, .docx), Adobe (unsecured .pdf), Rich Text Format (.rtf), and HTML (.htm, .html) up to 5MB in size. Resumes from third party vendors will not be accepted; these resumes will be deleted and the candidates submitted will not be considered for employment.

If you have trouble applying for a position, please email ORNLRecruiting@ornl.gov.

ORNL is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants, including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans, are encouraged to apply. UT-Battelle is an E-Verify employer.
