Description

ReaderLink. We Link. Publishers. Books. Retailers. Customers.

We are North America’s largest book distributor, with over 70,000 customer store locations. We move over 325,000,000 books annually and work with over 700 retailers and 500 publishers. If you want to end every day knowing that you helped deliver a book to readers across America, let’s talk. We are recruiting for a SQL Server Developer role based out of our corporate headquarters in Oak Brook, Illinois.

The SQL Server Developer will develop and support SQL Server database solutions, ETL/ELT processes, and enterprise data warehouse initiatives. This role requires strong SQL development and data integration skills to deliver reliable and scalable data solutions. The position will also assist with SQL Server administration, provide backup DBA support as needed, and have opportunities to work with Databricks and modern cloud data platforms.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize SQL Server stored procedures, views, functions, and advanced T-SQL solutions.
  • Design, develop, and support ETL/ELT processes for enterprise data integration and transformation.
  • Build and maintain data ingestion, incremental load, reconciliation, data validation, and data quality processes.
  • Independently analyze, solve, and correct data, ETL, and database-related issues, providing end-to-end problem resolution.
  • Maintain database objects, schema changes, and scripts using version control systems such as Azure DevOps.
  • Follow established team standards. For any gap, recommend new or updated standards and proactively identify areas for improvement.
  • Document and update technical documentation, operational procedures, and support runbooks when appropriate.
  • Take ownership, support, and follow-through of assigned deliverables, adjusting well to changes in priority.
  • Demonstrate a willingness and commitment to learn.
  • Develop accurate estimates of effort and timelines.
  • Ensure that all assignments are completed accurately and within approved delivery schedules.
  • Support enterprise data warehouse development, including dimensional modeling, reporting solutions, and data integration initiatives.
  • Assist with query tuning, performance optimization, and schema refinement.
  • Support Databricks data engineering initiatives, including data pipeline development, testing, and deployment activities.

We’re hiring a SQL Engineer to support a highly visible, data‑driven application that powers analytics and reporting across the organization. In this role, you’ll write complex queries, shape data for dashboards, optimize performance at scale, and deliver high‑quality datasets that stakeholders rely on every day. Our primary development team operates out of Gaithersburg, MD, but innovation doesn’t stop there. We’re able to support onsite engineers in Alexandria, VA; Chantilly, VA; Aurora, CO; St. Louis, MO; and Tucson, AZ, giving top talent multiple paths to join the mission.

And while the requisition requirements may seem standard fair, the position is not; as it will join a high performing team that is changing the way digital engineering and mission operations intelligence is enabled for our customer.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High Impact: Your work directly supports a widely used application that drives real-time decision-making
  • High Visibility: Partner with engineering teams and key stakeholders across programs
  • Career Growth: Expand your expertise in large-scale data systems, performance optimization, and advanced SQL engineering

Requisition Id 17431

Overview

We seek an experienced Senior Oracle Database Administrator (DBA)/Developer for the Neutrons Systems Engineering and Support group to design, maintain and optimize our Oracle database environment. The Neutron Systems Engineering and Support group provides technical expertise and computing support to Neutron Science Directorates (NScD) and the Neutron Upgrades Project Office (NUPO). NScD operates the High Flux Isotope Reactor (HFIR) and the Spallation Neutron Source (SNS), the world’s most powerful pulsed accelerator-based neutron source.

As a DBA/developer, you are responsible for a deep administrative expertise with strong development skills making it ideal for someone who can architect reliable data solutions while collaborating closely with our end users, application developers, and infrastructure teams.

This position reports directly to the Neutron Systems Engineering and Support group lead, in the Research Computing Support Division (RSCD) at Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL).

What We're Looking For

A self-motivated professional who takes ownership of database reliability and application delivery, communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and brings a continuous improvement mindset to everything they do.

Major Duties/Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, patch, and upgrade Oracle Database environments (19c/26ai preferred) in both standalone and Oracle Database Appliance environments.
  • Design, develop, and optimize PL/SQL stored procedures, functions, packages, triggers, and views.
  • Design, develop, and deploy low-code web applications using Oracle APEX, including custom themes, interactive reports, forms, and REST-enabled data services.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate requirements into functional APEX applications.
  • Manage APEX workspaces, application security, and user access controls.
  • Integrate APEX applications with external systems via RESTful web services and Oracle REST Data Services (ORDS).
  • Maintain and upgrade APEX environments across development, test, and production instances.
  • Perform capacity planning, performance tuning, and query optimization using tools such as AWR, ADDM, and Explain Plan.
  • Manage backup and recovery strategies using RMAN; ensure RPO/RTO targets are met.
  • Implement and maintain Oracle Data Guard, RAC, and/or ASM environments.
  • Monitor database health, availability, and security; respond to and resolve incidents.
  • Develop and enforce database standards, naming conventions, and change management procedures.
  • Collaborate with developers to review schema designs, indexing strategies, and data models.
  • Support data migrations and integrations.
  • Participate in on-call rotation for critical database support, as needed.
  • Deliver ORNL’s mission by aligning behaviors, priorities, and interactions with our core values of Impact, Integrity, Teamwork, Safety, and Service. Promote equal opportunity by fostering a respectful workplace – in how we treat one another, work together, and measure success.

Basic Qualifications

  • A BS in information technology, information systems, computer science, computer engineering, business, science, or a related field of study and a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience required for consideration. An overall combination of equivalent education and experience may be considered.
  • 5+ years of Oracle DBA/Developer experience in a production enterprise environment.
  • Strong proficiency in PL/SQL development and SQL tuning.
  • Hands-on experience with Oracle RAC, Data Guard, ASM, and RMAN.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining production applications in Oracle APEX (version 22.x or later preferred).
  • Proficiency with ORDS for REST API development and deployment.
  • Familiarity with APEX security models, session state, and authentication schemes.
  • Solid understanding of Oracle security best practices (roles, privileges, auditing, TDE).
  • Experience with Oracle 19c or later.
  • Familiarity with Linux/Unix system administration in a database context.
  • Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) or equivalent certification.
  • Experience with APEX plug-ins, Universal Theme customization, and JavaScript/CSS extensions.
  • Oracle APEX certification or demonstrated portfolio of delivered APEX applications.
  • Exposure to DevOps practices and tools (Git, CI/CD pipelines, Ansible).
  • Knowledge of complementary databases (PostgreSQL, SQL Server) a plus.
  • Experience working at a high energy physics facility or DOE lab.

Special Requirements

  • Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  • For employment at Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL), a Real ID compliant form of identification will be required. Additionally, ORNL is subject to Department of Energy (DOE) access restrictions. All employees must also be able to obtain and maintain a federal Personal Identity Verification (PIV) card as mandated by Homeland Security Presidential Directive 12 (HSPD-12) and Department of Energy (DOE) Order 473.1A, which requires a favorable post-employment background investigation.
  • To obtain this credential, new employees must successfully complete and pass a Federal Tier 1 background check investigation. This investigation includes a declaration of illegal drug activities, including use, supply, possession, or manufacture within the last year. This includes marijuana and cannabis derivatives, which are still considered illegal under federal law, regardless of state laws.

About ORNL

As a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) Office of Science national laboratory, ORNL has an impressive 80-year legacy of addressing the nation’s most pressing challenges. Our team is made up of over 7,000 dedicated and innovative individuals! Our goal is to create an environment where a variety of perspectives and backgrounds are valued, ensuring ORNL is known as a top choice for employment. These principles are essential for supporting our broader mission to drive scientific breakthroughs and translate them into solutions for energy, environmental, and security challenges facing the nation.

ORNL offers competitive pay and benefits programs to attract and retain individuals who demonstrate exceptional work behaviors. The laboratory provides a range of employee benefits, including medical and retirement plans and flexible work hours, to support the well-being of you and your family. Employee amenities such as on-site fitness, banking, and cafeteria facilities are also available for added convenience.

Other benefits include the following: Prescription Drug Plan, Dental Plan, Vision Plan, 401(k) Retirement Plan, Contributory Pension Plan, Life Insurance, Disability Benefits, Generous Vacation and Holidays, Parental Leave, Legal Insurance with Identity Theft Protection, Employee Assistance Plan, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, Wellness Programs, Educational Assistance, Relocation Assistance, and Employee Discounts.

This position will remain open for a minimum of 5 days after which it will close when a qualified candidate is identified and/or hired.

We accept Word (.doc, .docx), Adobe (unsecured .pdf), Rich Text Format (.rtf), and HTML (.htm, .html) up to 5MB in size. Resumes from third party vendors will not be accepted; these resumes will be deleted and the candidates submitted will not be considered for employment.

If you have trouble applying for a position, please email ORNLRecruiting@ornl.gov.

ORNL is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants, including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans, are encouraged to apply. UT-Battelle is an E-Verify employer.

- Monitor database health, availability, and security; respond to and resolve incidents.

- Collaborate with developers to review schema designs, indexing strategies, and data models.
- Support data migrations and integrations.
- Participate in on-call rotation for critical database support, as needed.
- Deliver ORNL’s mission by aligning behaviors, priorities, and interactions with our core values of Impact, Integrity, Teamwork, Safety, and Service. Promote equal opportunity by fostering a respectful workplace – in how we treat one another, work together, and measure success.

- A BS in information technology, information systems, computer science, computer engineering, business, science, or a related field of study and a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience required for consideration. An overall combination of equivalent education and experience may be considered.
- 5+ years of Oracle DBA/Developer experience in a production enterprise environment.
- Strong proficiency in PL/SQL development and SQL tuning.
- Hands-on experience with Oracle RAC, Data Guard, ASM, and RMAN.
- Hands-on experience building and maintaining production applications in Oracle APEX (version 22.x or later preferred).
- Proficiency with ORDS for REST API development and deployment.
- Familiarity with APEX security models, session state, and authentication schemes.
- Solid understanding of Oracle security best practices (roles, privileges, auditing, TDE).
- Experience with Oracle 19c or later.
- Familiarity with Linux/Unix system administration in a database context.
- Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills.

Preferred Qualifications



- Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) or equivalent certification.
- Experience with APEX plug-ins, Universal Theme customization, and JavaScript/CSS extensions.
- Oracle APEX certification or demonstrated portfolio of delivered APEX applications.
- Exposure to DevOps practices and tools (Git, CI/CD pipelines, Ansible).
- Knowledge of complementary databases (PostgreSQL, SQL Server) a plus.
- Experience working at a high energy physics facility or DOE lab.

Special Requirements



- Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
- For employment at Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL), a Real ID compliant form of identification will be required. Additionally, ORNL is subject to Department of Energy (DOE) access restrictions. All employees must also be able to obtain and maintain a federal Personal Identity Verification (PIV) card as mandated by Homeland Security Presidential Directive 12 (HSPD-12) and Department of Energy (DOE) Order 473.1A, which requires a favorable post-employment background investigation.
- To obtain this credential, new employees must successfully complete and pass a Federal Tier 1 background check investigation. This investigation includes a declaration of illegal drug activities, including use, supply, possession, or manufacture within the last year. This includes marijuana and cannabis derivatives, which are still considered illegal under federal law, regardless of state laws.

About ORNL

As a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) Office of Science national laboratory, ORNL has an impressive 80-year legacy of addressing the nation’s most pressing challenges. Our team is made up of over 7,000 dedicated and innovative individuals! Our goal is to create an environment where a variety of perspectives and backgrounds are valued, ensuring ORNL is known as a top choice for employment. These principles are essential for supporting our broader mission to drive scientific breakthroughs and translate them into solutions for energy, environmental, and security challenges facing the nation.

ORNL offers competitive pay and benefits programs to attract and retain individuals who demonstrate exceptional work behaviors. The laboratory provides a range of employee benefits, including medical and retirement plans and flexible work hours, to support the well-being of you and your family. Employee amenities such as on-site fitness, banking, and cafeteria facilities are also available for added convenience.

Other benefits include the following: Prescription Drug Plan, Dental Plan, Vision Plan, 401(k) Retirement Plan, Contributory Pension Plan, Life Insurance, Disability Benefits, Generous Vacation and Holidays, Parental Leave, Legal Insurance with Identity Theft Protection, Employee Assistance Plan, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, Wellness Programs, Educational Assistance, Relocation Assistance, and Employee Discounts.

This position will remain open for a minimum of 5 days after which it will close when a qualified candidate is identified and/or hired.

Job Description Summary

The Developer DBA will support application development, database engineering, data integration, analytics enablement, and operational database activities for the GrantSolutions platform. This role is responsible for designing, developing, testing, maintaining, and optimizing Oracle database solutions, including PL/SQL packages, procedures, functions, triggers, ETL processes, data migration scripts, and performance-tuned database objects.

The Developer DBA will work closely with application developers, architects, DevOps engineers, data engineers, Product Owners, Scrum teams, business stakeholders, and Federal partners to support mission-critical applications and modernization initiatives. The ideal candidate will be a self-starter with strong analytical and problem-solving skills who can quickly understand complex application data models, independently drive solutions, and deliver high-quality database solutions in an Agile environment.

This role will also support AI-enabled engineering initiatives by applying approved AI-assisted development and automation tools to improve productivity, code quality, documentation, testing, troubleshooting, and software delivery outcomes.

What You Will Do

We are seeking a highly motivated Developer DBA with strong Oracle SQL and PL/SQL expertise, ETL development experience, and cloud data platform knowledge to support application modernization, database development, systems integration, analytics, and operational support activities.

  • Design, develop, and support Oracle database solutions, including packages, stored procedures, functions, triggers, views, materialized views, and sequences, ensuring high performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Develop, enhance, and optimize SQL and PL/SQL code to support application functionality, reporting, system integrations, and business operations.
  • Create and maintain database migration scripts, schema updates, release deployment packages, and automated database deployment processes.
  • Design, build, and support ETL workflows, data transformation processes, validation frameworks, and batch data processing solutions.
  • Analyze and interpret complex data models, database schemas, enterprise data flows, ERDs, and data mappings to support business and application requirements.
  • Develop and support cloud-based data integration, reporting, and analytics solutions using AWS technologies such as Amazon Redshift, Amazon S3, Amazon RDS, and related services.
  • Build and maintain data integration pipelines using Matillion ETL and other enterprise data integration platforms.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve database issues, data quality concerns, application integration challenges, and performance bottlenecks across environments.
  • Perform database performance tuning and optimization using execution plans, indexing strategies, partitioning, optimizer statistics, and Oracle diagnostic and monitoring tools.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers, architects, DevOps engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable and reliable data solutions.
  • Participate in Agile development activities, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily standups, code reviews, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Contribute to DevSecOps and CI/CD initiatives by implementing automated testing, deployment, monitoring, and compliance practices for database solutions.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, including database designs, data mappings, interface specifications, operational procedures, and support guides.
  • Develop and support database unit testing, regression testing, data validation testing, and automated test support for SQL, PL/SQL, ETL, and data migration changes.
  • Support production operations, release deployments, incident troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and post-deployment validation for mission-critical database and application components.
  • Leverage approved AI-powered development tools to accelerate SQL and PL/SQL development, code review, troubleshooting, documentation, testing, and knowledge-sharing activities.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to apply AI and intelligent automation to database development, data engineering, deployment, monitoring, operational support, and engineering productivity.
  • Support data governance, security, privacy, and compliance requirements by implementing least-privilege access, auditability, encryption-aware data handling, and controls aligned with Federal standards such as FISMA, NIST, and FedRAMP where applicable.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging database, cloud, AI, and data engineering technologies and recommend improvements that enhance platform capabilities and team productivity.

What You Will Need

  • Must be able to OBTAIN and MAINTAIN a Federal or DoD "PUBLIC TRUST"; candidates must obtain approved adjudication of their PUBLIC TRUST prior to onboarding with Guidehouse. Candidates with an ACTIVE PUBLIC TRUST or SUITABILITY are preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience in Oracle database development, database engineering, ETL development, data integration, or related software engineering roles.
  • Strong experience in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL development, including packages, procedures, functions, triggers, views, materialized views, sequences, complex queries, performance tuning, and Oracle development tools such as SQL Developer and SQL*Loader.
  • Proven ability to design, develop, optimize, troubleshoot, and maintain database solutions supporting enterprise and mission-critical applications.
  • Experience designing and implementing ETL solutions, data transformation processes, batch processing frameworks, and data migration initiatives.
  • Experience with AWS data and cloud services, including Amazon Redshift, Amazon RDS, Amazon S3, and related analytics and integration technologies.
  • Experience with Matillion ETL or similar cloud-native data integration, orchestration, and data pipeline platforms.
  • Strong understanding of relational database architecture, logical and physical data modeling, ERDs, normalization, indexing, query optimization, transaction management, and referential integrity.
  • Experience analyzing and supporting complex enterprise application databases, schemas, and data models.
  • Experience developing or supporting database unit tests, regression tests, data validation checks, and deployment verification activities.
  • Experience supporting production releases, operational incidents, defect triage, root-cause analysis, and post-release validation in enterprise or mission-critical environments.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and resolve database, data quality, integration, and application performance issues across distributed environments.
  • Experience supporting database and application deployments using CI/CD pipelines, release automation, and DevSecOps best practices.
  • Experience working in Agile software development environments utilizing Scrum, Kanban, or similar methodologies.
  • Experience using source control and application lifecycle management tools such as Git, GitHub, Bitbucket, GitLab, or Azure DevOps.
  • Experience using approved AI-assisted tools or automation practices to support code generation, optimization, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, code reviews, knowledge management, and engineering productivity improvements.
  • Understanding of Responsible AI principles, AI governance, cybersecurity, data privacy, and secure AI adoption within enterprise or government environments.
  • Familiarity with AI-enhanced SDLC practices, AI-assisted DevSecOps, intelligent automation, and emerging AI engineering patterns.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, work independently or collaboratively, and continuously adapt to emerging database, cloud, and AI technologies.

What Would Be Nice To Have

  • Experience supporting Federal Government or large-scale enterprise applications.
  • Experience supporting Grants Management, Financial Management, Case Management, Regulatory, or workflow-driven systems.
  • Experience with Oracle Data Pump, Oracle GoldenGate, Informatica, Talend, ODI, Liquibase, Flyway, or similar data integration and migration tools.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL, or other enterprise database platforms.
  • Experience supporting cloud modernization, database migration, or application modernization initiatives.
  • Knowledge of Federal data security and compliance practices, including audit logging, least-privilege access, encryption-aware data handling, and security controls aligned with FISMA, NIST, or FedRAMP requirements.
  • Experience with data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, enterprise reporting, and business intelligence platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or Amazon QuickSight.
  • Experience supporting data pipelines and data platforms used for analytics, reporting, AI, and machine learning workloads.
  • Familiarity with AWS cloud-native application and service deployment architectures.
  • Oracle certifications preferred, including:
    • Oracle Certified Professional (OCP)
    • Oracle Database Administrator Certified Professional
    • Oracle SQL Certified Associate
  • Experience evaluating and adopting emerging AI technologies to improve software engineering productivity, database development, operational efficiency, and modernization initiatives.
  • Familiarity with modern AI data architectures, vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, knowledge management systems, and enterprise AI platforms.
  • Experience participating in AI-driven modernization efforts, intelligent automation initiatives, or enterprise data and analytics programs.

Job Description Summary

The Developer DBA will support application development, database engineering, data integration, analytics enablement, and operational database activities for the GrantSolutions platform. This role is responsible for designing, developing, testing, maintaining, and optimizing Oracle database solutions, including PL/SQL packages, procedures, functions, triggers, ETL processes, data migration scripts, and performance-tuned database objects.

The Developer DBA will work closely with application developers, architects, DevOps engineers, data engineers, Product Owners, Scrum teams, business stakeholders, and Federal partners to support mission-critical applications and modernization initiatives. The ideal candidate will be a self-starter with strong analytical and problem-solving skills who can quickly understand complex application data models, independently drive solutions, and deliver high-quality database solutions in an Agile environment.

This role will also support AI-enabled engineering initiatives by applying approved AI-assisted development and automation tools to improve productivity, code quality, documentation, testing, troubleshooting, and software delivery outcomes.

What You Will Do

We are seeking a highly motivated Developer DBA with strong Oracle SQL and PL/SQL expertise, ETL development experience, and cloud data platform knowledge to support application modernization, database development, systems integration, analytics, and operational support activities.



- Design, develop, and support Oracle database solutions, including packages, stored procedures, functions, triggers, views, materialized views, and sequences, ensuring high performance, scalability, and maintainability.
- Develop, enhance, and optimize SQL and PL/SQL code to support application functionality, reporting, system integrations, and business operations.
- Create and maintain database migration scripts, schema updates, release deployment packages, and automated database deployment processes.
- Design, build, and support ETL workflows, data transformation processes, validation frameworks, and batch data processing solutions.
- Analyze and interpret complex data models, database schemas, enterprise data flows, ERDs, and data mappings to support business and application requirements.
- Develop and support cloud-based data integration, reporting, and analytics solutions using AWS technologies such as Amazon Redshift, Amazon S3, Amazon RDS, and related services.
- Build and maintain data integration pipelines using Matillion ETL and other enterprise data integration platforms.
- Troubleshoot and resolve database issues, data quality concerns, application integration challenges, and performance bottlenecks across environments.
- Perform database performance tuning and optimization using execution plans, indexing strategies, partitioning, optimizer statistics, and Oracle diagnostic and monitoring tools.
- Collaborate closely with software engineers, architects, DevOps engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable and reliable data solutions.
- Participate in Agile development activities, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily standups, code reviews, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
- Contribute to DevSecOps and CI/CD initiatives by implementing automated testing, deployment, monitoring, and compliance practices for database solutions.
- Create and maintain technical documentation, including database designs, data mappings, interface specifications, operational procedures, and support guides.
- Develop and support database unit testing, regression testing, data validation testing, and automated test support for SQL, PL/SQL, ETL, and data migration changes.
- Support production operations, release deployments, incident troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and post-deployment validation for mission-critical database and application components.
- Leverage approved AI-powered development tools to accelerate SQL and PL/SQL development, code review, troubleshooting, documentation, testing, and knowledge-sharing activities.
- Identify and implement opportunities to apply AI and intelligent automation to database development, data engineering, deployment, monitoring, operational support, and engineering productivity.
- Support data governance, security, privacy, and compliance requirements by implementing least-privilege access, auditability, encryption-aware data handling, and controls aligned with Federal standards such as FISMA, NIST, and FedRAMP where applicable.
- Continuously evaluate emerging database, cloud, AI, and data engineering technologies and recommend improvements that enhance platform capabilities and team productivity.

What You Will Need



- Must be able to OBTAIN and MAINTAIN a Federal or DoD "PUBLIC TRUST"; candidates must obtain approved adjudication of their PUBLIC TRUST prior to onboarding with Guidehouse. Candidates with an ACTIVE PUBLIC TRUST or SUITABILITY are preferred.
- Bachelor’s degree required.
- Minimum of five (5) years of experience in Oracle database development, database engineering, ETL development, data integration, or related software engineering roles.
- Strong experience in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL development, including packages, procedures, functions, triggers, views, materialized views, sequences, complex queries, performance tuning, and Oracle development tools such as SQL Developer and SQL*Loader.
- Proven ability to design, develop, optimize, troubleshoot, and maintain database solutions supporting enterprise and mission-critical applications.
- Experience designing and implementing ETL solutions, data transformation processes, batch processing frameworks, and data migration initiatives.
- Experience with AWS data and cloud services, including Amazon Redshift, Amazon RDS, Amazon S3, and related analytics and integration technologies.
- Experience with Matillion ETL or similar cloud-native data integration, orchestration, and data pipeline platforms.
- Strong understanding of relational database architecture, logical and physical data modeling, ERDs, normalization, indexing, query optimization, transaction management, and referential integrity.
- Experience analyzing and supporting complex enterprise application databases, schemas, and data models.
- Experience developing or supporting database unit tests, regression tests, data validation checks, and deployment verification activities.
- Experience supporting production releases, operational incidents, defect triage, root-cause analysis, and post-release validation in enterprise or mission-critical environments.
- Ability to troubleshoot and resolve database, data quality, integration, and application performance issues across distributed environments.
- Experience supporting database and application deployments using CI/CD pipelines, release automation, and DevSecOps best practices.
- Experience working in Agile software development environments utilizing Scrum, Kanban, or similar methodologies.
- Experience using source control and application lifecycle management tools such as Git, GitHub, Bitbucket, GitLab, or Azure DevOps.
- Experience using approved AI-assisted tools or automation practices to support code generation, optimization, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, code reviews, knowledge management, and engineering productivity improvements.
- Understanding of Responsible AI principles, AI governance, cybersecurity, data privacy, and secure AI adoption within enterprise or government environments.
- Familiarity with AI-enhanced SDLC practices, AI-assisted DevSecOps, intelligent automation, and emerging AI engineering patterns.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, work independently or collaboratively, and continuously adapt to emerging database, cloud, and AI technologies.

What Would Be Nice To Have



- Experience supporting Federal Government or large-scale enterprise applications.
- Experience supporting Grants Management, Financial Management, Case Management, Regulatory, or workflow-driven systems.
- Experience with Oracle Data Pump, Oracle GoldenGate, Informatica, Talend, ODI, Liquibase, Flyway, or similar data integration and migration tools.
- Experience with PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL, or other enterprise database platforms.
- Experience supporting cloud modernization, database migration, or application modernization initiatives.
- Knowledge of Federal data security and compliance practices, including audit logging, least-privilege access, encryption-aware data handling, and security controls aligned with FISMA, NIST, or FedRAMP requirements.
- Experience with data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, enterprise reporting, and business intelligence platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or Amazon QuickSight.
- Experience supporting data pipelines and data platforms used for analytics, reporting, AI, and machine learning workloads.
- Familiarity with AWS cloud-native application and service deployment architectures.
- Oracle certifications preferred, including:

- Oracle Certified Professional (OCP)
- Oracle Database Administrator Certified Professional
- Oracle SQL Certified Associate
- Experience evaluating and adopting emerging AI technologies to improve software engineering productivity, database development, operational efficiency, and modernization initiatives.
- Familiarity with modern AI data architectures, vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, knowledge management systems, and enterprise AI platforms.
- Experience participating in AI-driven modernization efforts, intelligent automation initiatives, or enterprise data and analytics programs.

  • Ability to coordinate with infrastructure DBA teams and communicate effectively across technical disciplines.
  • Experience supporting Oracle-based applications and Oracle SQL.
  • Experience with Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration initiatives.
  • Experience with Oracle APEX applications.
  • Experience with Flyway, Liquibase, or similar database deployment frameworks.
  • Experience supporting AWS RDS PostgreSQL, Aurora PostgreSQL, Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized platforms.
  • Experience supporting Cognos reporting and analytics environments.
  • Experience with Python, Bash, or PowerShell automation.
  • Experience supporting federal government systems or regulated environments.
  • PostgreSQL, AWS, Java, DevSecOps, or cloud-related certifications.

descriptionHtml:
RSNA is seeking a SQL Server ETL Developer to build and support the data solutions that power reporting, analytics, and decision-making across the organization.

Working primarily with SQL Server, T-SQL, and SSIS, you’ll design reliable data pipelines, integrate data from multiple systems, and help ensure our data is accurate, accessible, and ready for analysis.

You’ll have ownership of your work from requirements and solution design through development, testing, deployment, and production support. You’ll also partner directly with analysts and business teams to turn their needs into scalable data solutions they can trust.

This is a SQL Server-centric role. ETL is built in T-SQL and SSIS, not Python or cloud-based drag-and-drop tools.

Why Join RSNA?

At RSNA, You’ll Combine Meaningful, Mission-driven Work With a Supportive Environment That Values Collaboration And Work-life Balance. You Can Expect

  • Work that supports an organization dedicated to advancing radiology and ultimately improving patient care.
  • A collaborative, experienced team that values knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
  • Opportunities to solve a variety of real-world data and business challenges.
  • A hybrid or remote work environment with generally predictable hours and limited evening or weekend work.
  • Professional development and opportunities to expand your technical skills.
  • Competitive benefits, generous paid time off, paid parental leave, long-term savings benefits, and a week-long Winter Break.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain ETL/data pipelines using SSIS, APIs, scripts, and other integration tools.
  • Develop and optimize T-SQL queries, stored procedures, views, and functions supporting reporting and analytics.
  • Build efficient incremental data-load processes using techniques such as Change Data Capture (CDC), watermarking, and MERGE/upsert patterns.
  • Design and maintain dimensional data models, including fact tables, dimensions, and slowly changing dimensions.

About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

The SQL Developer/Database Engineer will support a large-scale federal IT program by designing, developing, and optimizing database structures and SQL logic for mission-critical applications. This role requires strong SQL expertise, attention to detail, and the ability to troubleshoot complex data and performance issues. The candidate will collaborate closely with cross-functional technical teams operating in an Agile environment and will ensure data integrity, reliability, and scalability across multiple systems.

Location: On-site three days per week in Colorado Springs, CO.

Day to Day Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain SQL queries, stored procedures, functions, and database objects to support application and reporting needs.
  • Analyze and optimize existing SQL code for performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Design and implement database schemas, tables, indexing strategies, and data structures aligned to system requirements.
  • Troubleshoot database issues, including performance bottlenecks, data integrity problems, and SQL defects.
  • Collaborate with application developers, architects, business analysts, and DevOps teams to refine data requirements and deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Support data migration, transformation, and integration activities across systems.
  • Follow Agile processes, participate in sprint ceremonies, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Provide on-call or flexible support during weekend or after-hours windows as needed for deployments or system maintenance.
  • Ensure compliance with security, data protection, and federal program standards.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree and 12 years of experience or a Masters degree and 10 years of experience or an Associates degree and 14 years of experience or a High School diploma/eqivalent and 16 years of experience.
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen with an active Secret clearance
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience developing, writing, and optimizing SQL queries, stored procedures, and database scripts.
  • 3+ years of experience designing, developing, and implementing relational database structures, including tables, schemas, and indexes.
  • Experience troubleshooting SQL performance issues, resolving data integrity issues, and supporting database development and optimization.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 1+ year of experience with Microsoft SQL Server.
  • Experience supporting large-scale federal IT programs.
  • Familiarity with the SAFe Agile delivery framework.

Details

Target Salary Range: $104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

Application Statements: The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate's own.

descriptionHtml:
Job Purpose

Several strategic and business-critical development initiatives are underway to develop and extend our complex Fixed Income and Equity analytics using the latest technologies. We are also committed to leveraging the best practices in Object Oriented and Database Design and Development in this endeavor. To support rapid development, we continue to invest in developing the highest level of code quality and comprehensive test coverage.

The Senior Database Developer will play a key role in designing and developing the new platform to support our growth business in fixed income portfolio analytics. The platform is architected as a distributed system of services to manage data intensive computations of fixed income analytics across a large compute farm. We leverage the best-in-breed software, messaging systems, Oracle database tools, and development practices in a Python and Java-centric environment.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with key business and technology stakeholders to define functional and technical design.
  • Work closely with software engineering team and senior leadership to design and implement data solutions.
  • Develop technical specifications for physical relational data models on Oracle database that demonstrate a keen awareness of RDBMS design principles and performance-tuning.
  • Design data models, implement PLSQL procedures on the latest versions of Oracle and Postgress databases.
  • Develop, maintain and support the data used by our systems
  • Work with the development team to tailor the design and implement in Oracle for efficient access from Java.
  • Triage, diagnose and remediate system and performance issues in a timely manner
  • Lead and/or participate in project efforts using an Agile development methodology.
  • Be a trusted expert in loading large volumes of data in an efficient manner.
  • Develop system and training documentation as needed.
  • Must be able to work flexible hours as needed to support project timelines and deliver efforts on time.
  • Provide technical support or provide subject matter expertise to other team members as needed.

Knowledge And Experience

  • 7+ years of applied work experience as a database developer on Oracle
  • Enthusiastic advocate and expert in modern full software development lifecycle practices
  • Must be devoted to delivering quality and well-tested solutions
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Good experience developing solutions for both Linux and Windows.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of Oracle functionality: physical table design, normal forms, data partitions, integrity constraints, indexing strategies, performance tuning, execution plans, PLSQL and stored procedures, database monitoring tools, locking, deadlock detection and resolution
  • Demonstrated experience in the development and automation of ETL processes for data loading and extraction
  • Must be proficient in scripting languages. Basic understanding of Java and Python would be a plus.
  • Experience developing and integrating solutions in cloud environments such as AWS is desirable
  • A team player who collaborates effectively with other software engineers.
  • Self-starter, who is both motivated, disciplined and accountable for delivering accurate and timely results
  • The successful candidate will be adaptable, results-focused and can work individually or as part of a team.

descriptionHtml:
Unissant, Inc. delivers innovative capabilities to the agencies that keep our nation healthy and safe. We apply our domain expertise, data acumen, and technology know-how to achieve breakthrough results for our clients. Working collaboratively, we advance missions and careers through a focus on honesty, integrity, and dependability. We continuously look for talent, excited to join that effort. To learn more about our exciting organization, please visit us at www.unissant.com.

Unissant is seeking a Database Developer to support a newly awarded program for a federal health agency. Develop and maintain database code, schemas, and data access components supporting enterprise business applications and approved modernization.

The ideal candidate combines practical SQL development skills with attention to data integrity, application performance, and controlled delivery of database changes.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

  • Analyze existing schemas, stored procedures, views, and application data flows to understand business rules and dependencies.
  • Develop and maintain SQL queries, views, stored procedures, functions, and scripts for assigned applications.
  • Create and modify database objects and logical and physical data models in coordination with application architects and database administrators.
  • Implement data validation and integrity rules that align database behavior with approved requirements.
  • Analyze query execution and application data access; implement approved query and indexing improvements with database administrators.
  • Develop and test data transformation, migration, and reconciliation scripts, verifying results against authoritative source data.
  • Maintain database code in source control; prepare deployment scripts, rollback steps, and unit and integration test evidence.
  • Document database objects, data dictionaries, business rules, and dependencies; support transition knowledge transfer.
  • Coordinate database changes with developers, analysts, testers, and operations staff; investigate defects and report dependencies.
  • Use Government-approved tools and authorized data environments; validate any AI-assisted database code before use.

Basic Qualifications

Work Experience and Job Skills:

  • 3-6 years of experience developing SQL queries and database code for relational business applications.
  • Hands-on experience with an assigned relational database platform, such as Oracle or SQL Server, and its procedural SQL language.
  • Ability to translate business and data requirements into database objects and maintainable data access logic.
  • Experience with relational data modeling, keys, constraints, joins, views, and stored procedures.
  • Ability to troubleshoot database code and query performance in coordination with application developers and database administrators.
  • Experience testing database changes, validating data, and using source control and controlled deployment practices.
  • Ability to document work clearly, protect sensitive program information, and collaborate across Government and contractor teams.
  • Ability to meet federal suitability and access requirements and provide on-site support in the Bethesda, Maryland area as directed.

Additional Qualifications

  • Experience with PL/SQL or comparable procedural database development in a production application environment.
  • Experience developing migration or transformation scripts and reconciling data across application interfaces.
  • Familiarity with approved cloud database services and database code changes supporting application modernization.
  • Experience supporting a Federal IT services environment, preferably within a federal health agency or comparable federal IT environment.
  • Experience transferring knowledge from an incumbent team and maintaining reliable services during transition.

Education

  • A degree or relevant coursework in computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related discipline is preferred.

Certificates, Licenses And Registrations

  • Relevant database development or database platform credentials are preferred.

Communication Skills

  • Clear verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to coordinate professionally across Government, prime contractor, and subcontractor teams.
  • Ability to explain database designs, data issues, and implementation impacts to technical teams and business stakeholders.

Clearance Requirements

  • Must hold or be eligible for a Public Trust Moderate (Tier 2) background investigation and meet applicable federal suitability, badging, and system-access requirements.

Travel

  • Washington, DC.

Environmental Requirements

  • Mainly a routine office environment.
  • May be required to lift up to ten (10) pounds
  • Flexible in working extended hours

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. Unissant management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary. In addition, where applicable and available, reasonable accommodation(s) may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions of this position.

Candidate(s) will be required to go through pre-employment screening.

Performs other related duties as assigned.

Competitive Wages

Great 401(k) plan with company match

Comprehensive health benefits package

Generous Company paid Holidays and Paid Time Off (PTO)

Tuition reimbursement program

Company Description

Citizant is a leading provider of professional IT services to the U.S. government. We seek to address some of our country’s most pressing challenges in Agile application development, Enterprise Data Management, Enterprise Architecture, Product Management, and Program Management support services. This is for a near-term opportunity

Position Summary

The Field Maintenance Command and Control (FMxC2) Database Engineer designs, develops, optimizes, and modernizes database solutions supporting the FMxC2 application, including data integration, reporting, analytics, information management, and modernization initiatives. This role offers an exciting opportunity to design, develop, and modernize database solutions that are critical to mission success. The ideal candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure our database systems are secure, scalable, and reliable, enabling efficient data integration, reporting, analytics, and information management.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain database architectures and schemas supporting FMxC2.
  • Develop and optimize database objects, queries, views, and stored procedures.
  • Support data migration, modernization, and system enhancement initiatives.
  • Design, develop, and implement data integration solutions.
  • Analyze and improve database performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • Support reporting, analytics, and business intelligence requirements.
  • Develop database documentation, data models, and data dictionaries.
  • Collaborate with application developers supporting COBOL, C#, and related technologies.
  • Support database security, integrity, and data quality initiatives.
  • Collaborate with application, infrastructure, and cybersecurity teams.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years of database engineering experience.
  • Experience with database design, data modeling, and schema development.
  • Experience developing and optimizing database solutions for enterprise applications.
  • Experience developing complex SQL queries, views, stored procedures, and database objects.
  • Experience supporting enterprise application integrations and data exchange processes.
  • Experience supporting data migration and modernization efforts.
  • Familiarity with relational database management systems and performance tuning techniques.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Local to Montgomery, AL.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Active Secret security clearance.
  • Experience supporting FMxC2.
  • Experience supporting Air Force logistics, maintenance, readiness, sustainment, or operational systems.
  • Experience supporting DoD or Air Force programs.
  • Experience with ETL, data migration, and integration solutions.
  • Experience supporting cloud-hosted databases and database modernization initiatives.
  • Experience supporting legacy application modernization efforts.
  • Experience supporting databases utilized by COBOL- and C#-based enterprise applications.
  • Experience implementing data quality, data governance, or data integrity controls.
  • Experience supporting data architectures, data preparation, or analytics initiatives that enable AI and machine learning capabilities.
  • SAFe Agile experience or certification.

Clearance Requirement

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance.

Citizant Offers a Competitive Benefits Package, Including

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k)
  • Generous PTO
  • Company-paid life and disability insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Tuition Assistance & Professional Development Program

Join our team and be part of a forward-thinking organization committed to innovation, professional growth, and supporting national defense initiatives. We offer a collaborative culture that values your expertise and encourages continuous learning and development

Additional Information

Citizant strives to be an employer of choice in the Washington metropolitan area. Citizant associates accept challenging and rewarding work and, in return, receive excellent compensation and benefits, as well as the opportunity for personal and professional development.

Citizant is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, or disability status.

$100,000 - $105,000/yearly

Our challenge

We are seeking an experienced Oracle Database Developer to design, develop, optimize, and maintain Oracle database solutions supporting mission-critical business applications. The candidate will work closely with application developers, business analysts, and database administrators to deliver scalable and high-performing database solutions.


Additional Information*

The base salary for this position will vary based on geography and other factors. In accordance with law, the base salary for this role if filled within Charlotte, NC is $95k - $105k/year & benefits (see below).


The Role

  • Analyze and troubleshoot production database issues.
  • Develop and maintain ETL processes for data migration and transformation.
  • Create and maintain data models, database schemas, and documentation.
  • Ensure database security, integrity, and compliance with organizational standards.
  • Support application development teams in database design and integration activities.
  • Participate in code reviews and implement best practices for database development.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams for requirement gathering and technical solutions.
  • Assist in database deployments, upgrades, and release management activities.


Requirements:

  • Strong experience with Oracle Database (11g/12c/19c or higher).
  • Expertise in SQL, PL/SQL, Stored Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Packages, and Views.
  • Experience with performance tuning, query optimization, and execution plan analysis.
  • Strong knowledge of data modeling and database design principles.
  • Experience with ETL tools and data integration processes.
  • Familiarity with Oracle Data Pump, SQL Loader, RMAN, and database utilities.
  • Experience with version control systems such as Git.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.


Preferred, but not required:

  • Experience with Oracle RAC, ASM, Data Guard, and database replication.
  • Knowledge of Oracle APEX and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
  • Experience in Agile/Scrum development environments.
  • Oracle Certifications such as Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) are preferred.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, or OCI.


We offer:

  • A highly competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • A multinational organization with 58 offices in 22 countries and the possibility to work abroad.
  • 10 days of paid annual leave (plus sick leave and national holidays).
  • Maternity & paternity leave plans.
  • A comprehensive insurance plan including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and long-/short-term disability (plans vary by region).
  • Retirement savings plans.
  • A higher education certification policy.
  • Commuter benefits (varies by region).
  • Extensive training opportunities, focused on skills, substantive knowledge, and personal development.
  • On-demand Udemy for Business for all Synechron employees with free access to more than 5000 curated courses.
  • Coaching opportunities with experienced colleagues from our Financial Innovation Labs (FinLabs) and Center of Excellences (CoE) groups.
  • Cutting edge projects at the world’s leading tier-one banks, financial institutions and insurance firms.
  • A flat and approachable organization.
  • A truly diverse, fun-loving, and global work culture.


SYNECHRON’S DIVERSITY & INCLUSION STATEMENT


Diversity & Inclusion are fundamental to our culture, and Synechron is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) initiative ‘Same Difference’ is committed to fostering an inclusive culture – promoting equality, diversity and an environment that is respectful to all. We strongly believe that a diverse workforce helps build stronger, successful businesses as a global company. We encourage applicants from across diverse backgrounds, race, ethnicities, religion, age, marital status, gender, sexual orientations, or disabilities to apply. We empower our global workforce by offering flexible workplace arrangements, mentoring, internal mobility, learning and development programs, and more.


All employment decisions at Synechron are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to the applicant’s gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

descriptionHtml:
REI Systems’ mission is to deliver reliable, innovative technology solutions that advance Federal clients' missions and exceed their expectations. Our technologists and consultants are passionate about solving complex challenges that impact millions of lives. We take a Mindful Modernization® approach in delivering our services, including application modernization, grants management, case management systems, government data analytics, and advisory services. This approach, the REI Way, ensures mission impact by aligning our clients' strategic objectives with measurable outcomes through people, processes, and technology.


We offer the same commitment to our employees by providing professional development, meaningful projects, and flexibility to spend time with family and friends. We believe employees are at their best when fulfilled in both their professional careers and their personal lives. Learn more at www.REIsystems.com


Employees voted REI Systems a Washington Post Top Workplace in 2015, 2016, 2018, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, and 2025!

Responsibilities

Position Overview

REI Systems is seeking experienced Developer / Database Administrators (DBAs) to support a mission-critical Federal Health IT program focused on application modernization, database engineering, data integration, analytics, and cloud-based solutions.

The ideal candidate will bring strong hands-on expertise in Oracle SQL, PL/SQL, database development, ETL processes, performance optimization, and AWS cloud technologies. This individual will play a critical role in designing, developing, maintaining, and optimizing enterprise database solutions that support complex federal applications and business operations.

The Developer DBA will collaborate with software developers, solution architects, DevOps engineers, data engineers, Product Owners, and Agile delivery teams to implement scalable, secure, and high-performing database solutions.

This role also offers opportunities to leverage AI-assisted development tools, intelligent automation, and modern DevSecOps practices to improve engineering productivity, code quality, testing, and operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

Database Development and Engineering

  • Design, develop, implement, and maintain Oracle database solutions, including stored procedures, packages, functions, triggers, views, materialized views, and sequences.
  • Develop and optimize complex SQL queries and PL/SQL code supporting enterprise applications, reporting, and business processes.
  • Perform database performance tuning, query optimization, indexing, partitioning, and execution plan analysis.
  • Design and maintain database schemas, data models, entity relationship diagrams (ERDs), and database objects.
  • Develop database migration scripts, schema modifications, deployment packages, and automated database release processes.
  • Troubleshoot database performance issues, application integration challenges, and data integrity concerns.
  • Support database administration and operational activities, including monitoring, troubleshooting, and production support.

ETL, Data Integration, and Cloud Technologies

  • Design, develop, and maintain ETL workflows, data integration pipelines, and data transformation processes.
  • Develop and support batch processing, data migration, data validation, and reconciliation solutions.
  • Work with Matillion ETL or comparable enterprise ETL tools to develop and maintain data integration pipelines.
  • Support cloud-based data engineering and analytics solutions utilizing AWS services, including Amazon Redshift, Amazon RDS, and Amazon S3.
  • Analyze complex application data models, data mappings, and enterprise data flows.
  • Collaborate with application and data engineering teams to ensure reliable data integration across multiple systems.
  • Support database and application modernization initiatives, including cloud migration and integration efforts.

Application Development and DevSecOps

  • Partner with application developers, architects, and technical teams to design efficient database solutions aligned with business and technical requirements.
  • Develop and maintain database unit tests, regression tests, data validation scripts, and deployment verification processes.
  • Support CI/CD pipelines and automated database deployments using modern DevSecOps practices.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and troubleshooting activities.
  • Support production deployments, incident resolution, root-cause analysis, and post-release validation.
  • Maintain technical documentation, including database designs, deployment procedures, data mappings, and operational support guides.

AI-Assisted Development and Automation

  • Utilize approved AI-assisted development tools to enhance SQL and PL/SQL development, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive database development, validation, and operational activities.
  • Support AI-enabled software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices to improve engineering productivity and delivery quality.
  • Apply responsible AI practices while maintaining data security, privacy, and compliance requirements.

Agile Collaboration and Federal Compliance

  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Collaborate with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, business analysts, developers, and federal stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Ensure database solutions follow established security, governance, and compliance standards.
  • Support federal cybersecurity requirements and best practices aligned with FISMA, NIST, and FedRAMP, as applicable.
  • Implement secure database development practices, including access controls, audit logging, and data protection measures.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in Oracle database development, database engineering, ETL development, data integration, or related software engineering roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Oracle SQL and PL/SQL, including:
  • Stored procedures, functions, packages, and triggers.
  • Complex SQL queries, views, materialized views, and sequences.
  • Query optimization, indexing, execution plans, and performance tuning.
  • Oracle SQL Developer, SQL*Loader, or similar Oracle development utilities.
  • Experience designing, developing, troubleshooting, and maintaining enterprise database solutions.
  • Hands-on experience developing ETL workflows, data transformation processes, batch processing, and data migration solutions.
  • Experience working with AWS cloud technologies, including Amazon Redshift, Amazon RDS, and Amazon S3.
  • Experience with Matillion ETL or comparable ETL/data integration platforms.
  • Strong understanding of relational database architecture, logical and physical data modeling, normalization, referential integrity, and transaction management.
  • Experience with database performance tuning, query optimization, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience supporting complex enterprise applications and production database environments.
  • Experience developing database unit tests, regression tests, data validation processes, and deployment verification scripts.
  • Experience supporting production deployments, incident management, root-cause analysis, and issue resolution.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, source control, release automation, and DevSecOps practices.
  • Experience using tools such as Git, GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, or Azure DevOps.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and automation practices to improve software engineering productivity.
  • Understanding of secure development practices, data privacy, cybersecurity, and responsible AI adoption.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Federal Public Trust clearance, with approved adjudication required before onboarding.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience supporting Federal Government IT programs, particularly within Health IT or large-scale enterprise environments.
  • Experience with grants management, financial management, case management, or workflow-driven applications.
  • Experience with Oracle Data Pump, Oracle GoldenGate, Oracle Data Integrator (ODI), Informatica, Talend, Liquibase, or Flyway.
  • Experience with additional database technologies such as PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or MySQL.
  • Experience supporting cloud modernization, database migration, or application modernization initiatives.
  • Knowledge of data warehousing, dimensional modeling, enterprise reporting, and business intelligence technologies.
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, Amazon QuickSight, or comparable analytics platforms.
  • Familiarity with AWS cloud-native architectures and enterprise data platforms.
  • Experience supporting data pipelines for analytics, AI, or machine learning workloads.
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled DevSecOps, intelligent automation, and AI-assisted database engineering.
  • Knowledge of emerging AI technologies, including vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, and enterprise AI platforms.
  • Understanding of federal security and compliance requirements, including FISMA, NIST, and FedRAMP.
  • Active Federal Public Trust clearance or favorable suitability determination.
  • Relevant Oracle certifications, such as:
  • Oracle Certified Professional (OCP).
  • Oracle Database Administrator Certified Professional.
  • Oracle SQL Certified Associate.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. Masters degree preferred.

Clearance: Ability to obtain and maintain a clearance is preferred.

Location: Hybrid: 2 days per week at REI Systems’ Sterling, VA office.

EEO Statement: REI Systems is an Equal Opportunity Employer

- Collaborate with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, business analysts, developers, and federal stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions.

- Support federal cybersecurity requirements and best practices aligned with FISMA, NIST, and FedRAMP, as applicable.
- Implement secure database development practices, including access controls, audit logging, and data protection measures.
Qualifications

- Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in Oracle database development, database engineering, ETL development, data integration, or related software engineering roles.
- Strong hands-on experience with Oracle SQL and PL/SQL, including:
- Stored procedures, functions, packages, and triggers.
- Complex SQL queries, views, materialized views, and sequences.
- Query optimization, indexing, execution plans, and performance tuning.
- Oracle SQL Developer, SQL*Loader, or similar Oracle development utilities.
- Experience designing, developing, troubleshooting, and maintaining enterprise database solutions.
- Hands-on experience developing ETL workflows, data transformation processes, batch processing, and data migration solutions.
- Experience working with AWS cloud technologies, including Amazon Redshift, Amazon RDS, and Amazon S3.
- Experience with Matillion ETL or comparable ETL/data integration platforms.
- Strong understanding of relational database architecture, logical and physical data modeling, normalization, referential integrity, and transaction management.
- Experience with database performance tuning, query optimization, and troubleshooting.
- Experience supporting complex enterprise applications and production database environments.
- Experience developing database unit tests, regression tests, data validation processes, and deployment verification scripts.
- Experience supporting production deployments, incident management, root-cause analysis, and issue resolution.
- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, source control, release automation, and DevSecOps practices.
- Experience using tools such as Git, GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, or Azure DevOps.
- Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.
- Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and automation practices to improve software engineering productivity.
- Understanding of secure development practices, data privacy, cybersecurity, and responsible AI adoption.
- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, problem-solving, and communication skills.
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.
- Must be able to obtain and maintain a Federal Public Trust clearance, with approved adjudication required before onboarding.
Preferred Qualifications

- Previous experience supporting Federal Government IT programs, particularly within Health IT or large-scale enterprise environments.
- Experience with grants management, financial management, case management, or workflow-driven applications.
- Experience with Oracle Data Pump, Oracle GoldenGate, Oracle Data Integrator (ODI), Informatica, Talend, Liquibase, or Flyway.
- Experience with additional database technologies such as PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or MySQL.
- Experience supporting cloud modernization, database migration, or application modernization initiatives.
- Knowledge of data warehousing, dimensional modeling, enterprise reporting, and business intelligence technologies.
- Experience with Power BI, Tableau, Amazon QuickSight, or comparable analytics platforms.
- Familiarity with AWS cloud-native architectures and enterprise data platforms.
- Experience supporting data pipelines for analytics, AI, or machine learning workloads.
- Familiarity with AI-enabled DevSecOps, intelligent automation, and AI-assisted database engineering.
- Knowledge of emerging AI technologies, including vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, and enterprise AI platforms.
- Understanding of federal security and compliance requirements, including FISMA, NIST, and FedRAMP.
- Active Federal Public Trust clearance or favorable suitability determination.
- Relevant Oracle certifications, such as:
- Oracle Certified Professional (OCP).
- Oracle Database Administrator Certified Professional.
- Oracle SQL Certified Associate.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. Masters degree preferred.
Clearance: Ability to obtain and maintain a clearance is preferred.
Location: Hybrid: 2 days per week at REI Systems’ Sterling, VA office.
