Our challenge

We are seeking an experienced Senior Oracle Database Developer to design, develop, optimize, and maintain Oracle database solutions supporting mission-critical business applications. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in Oracle SQL, PL/SQL development, database performance tuning, data modeling, and ETL processes. The candidate will work closely with application developers, business analysts, and database administrators to deliver scalable and high-performing database solutions.


Additional Information*

The base salary for this position will vary based on geography and other factors. In accordance with law, the base salary for this role if filled within Charlotte, NC is $100k - $105k/year & benefits (see below).


The Role

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain Oracle database objects including tables, views, indexes, sequences, packages, procedures, functions, and triggers.
  • Develop complex SQL queries and PL/SQL programs to support business requirements.
  • Perform database performance tuning and query optimization.
  • Analyze and troubleshoot production database issues.
  • Develop and maintain ETL processes for data migration and transformation.
  • Create and maintain data models, database schemas, and documentation.
  • Ensure database security, integrity, and compliance with organizational standards.
  • Support application development teams in database design and integration activities.
  • Participate in code reviews and implement best practices for database development.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams for requirement gathering and technical solutions.
  • Assist in database deployments, upgrades, and release management activities.


Requirements:

  • Strong experience with Oracle Database (11g/12c/19c or higher).
  • Expertise in SQL, PL/SQL, Stored Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Packages, and Views.
  • Experience with performance tuning, query optimization, and execution plan analysis.
  • Strong knowledge of data modeling and database design principles.
  • Experience with ETL tools and data integration processes.
  • Familiarity with Oracle Data Pump, SQL Loader, RMAN, and database utilities.
  • Experience with version control systems such as Git.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.


Preferred, but not required:

  • Experience with Oracle RAC, ASM, Data Guard, and database replication.
  • Knowledge of Oracle APEX and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
  • Experience in Agile/Scrum development environments.
  • Oracle Certifications such as Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) are preferred.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, or OCI.


We offer:

  • A highly competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • A multinational organization with 58 offices in 22 countries and the possibility to work abroad.
  • 10 days of paid annual leave (plus sick leave and national holidays).
  • Maternity & paternity leave plans.
  • A comprehensive insurance plan including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and long-/short-term disability (plans vary by region).
  • Retirement savings plans.
  • A higher education certification policy.
  • Commuter benefits (varies by region).
  • Extensive training opportunities, focused on skills, substantive knowledge, and personal development.
  • On-demand Udemy for Business for all Synechron employees with free access to more than 5000 curated courses.
  • Coaching opportunities with experienced colleagues from our Financial Innovation Labs (FinLabs) and Center of Excellences (CoE) groups.
  • Cutting edge projects at the world’s leading tier-one banks, financial institutions and insurance firms.
  • A flat and approachable organization.
  • A truly diverse, fun-loving, and global work culture.


SYNECHRON’S DIVERSITY & INCLUSION STATEMENT


Diversity & Inclusion are fundamental to our culture, and Synechron is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) initiative ‘Same Difference’ is committed to fostering an inclusive culture – promoting equality, diversity and an environment that is respectful to all. We strongly believe that a diverse workforce helps build stronger, successful businesses as a global company. We encourage applicants from across diverse backgrounds, race, ethnicities, religion, age, marital status, gender, sexual orientations, or disabilities to apply. We empower our global workforce by offering flexible workplace arrangements, mentoring, internal mobility, learning and development programs, and more.


All employment decisions at Synechron are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to the applicant’s gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

descriptionHtml:
Standard Job Description

Space is a critical domain, connecting our technologies, our security and our humanity. While others view space as a destination, we see it as a realm of possibilities, where we can do more — we can innovate, invest, inspire and integrate our capabilities to transform the future. Designs, develops, builds, analyzes, evaluates and installs database management systems to include database modeling and design, relational database architecture, metadata and repository creation and configuration management. Uses data mapping, data mining and data transformational analysis tools to design and develop databases. Determines data storage and optimum storage requirements. Prepares system requirements, source analysis and process analyses and design throughout the database implementation.

At Lockheed Martin Space, we aim to harness the full potential of space to cultivate innovation, reduce costs, and push the boundaries of what technology can achieve. We’re creating future-ready solutions, focusing on resiliency and urgency through our 21st Century Security® vision. We’re erasing boundaries and forming partnerships across industries and around the world. We’re advancing spacecraft and the workforce to fuel the next generation. And we’re reimagining how space can connect us, ensuring security and prosperity.

Join us in shaping a new era in space and find a career that's built for you.

The Erebus Program is a newly awarded 7-year effort that delivers cutting-edge intelligence and geospatial data management applications and services to the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA). As the premier geospatial intelligence program globally, Erebus supports over 14,000 intelligence analysts and decision-makers at 50 distinct locations worldwide.

The Program’s focus is on meeting the current mission needs of our customer, but also pioneering future automation solutions for the NGA based on agency directives. We are developing innovative solutions for geospatial analysis and production capabilities that will revolutionize the way intelligence is distributed to stakeholders. To achieve this, we need talented engineers who share our passion for excellence and innovation. If you're a skilled engineer looking for a challenging and rewarding opportunity, join the Erebus Team and help us build next generation of geospatial intelligence software and support critical national security missions.

In this role, you will be part of a database development Scrum team assisting with database requirements verification, database development, database administrator and operational support. The successful candidate will have experience and/or knowledge of SCRUM processes and System Requirements verification (such as Jira, Confluence).

descriptionHtml:
The is responsible for designing, developing, optimizing, and supporting enterprise database solutions across multiple database platforms. This role partners with application developers, data engineers, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, and high-performing data solutions that support critical business processes and reporting needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, maintain, and optimize database solutions across multiple platforms, including Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and other relational database technologies.
  • Develop and maintain database objects such as stored procedures, functions, views, triggers, packages, and schemas.
  • Create and optimize complex SQL queries to support application, reporting, and analytical requirements.
  • Design, develop, support, and troubleshoot ETL/ELT processes for data integration and transformation.
  • Schedule, monitor, and support batch processing and data integration jobs using AutoSys or similar enterprise scheduling tools.
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts using Unix/Linux shell scripting, PowerShell, Python, or equivalent scripting languages.
  • Perform database performance tuning, query optimization, indexing, partitioning, and capacity planning.
  • Support database deployment activities and maintain development, testing, and production environments.
  • Implement database security standards, access controls, encryption, and auditing requirements.
  • Collaborate with application development teams to design efficient and scalable data models and database architectures.
  • Support system upgrades, database migrations, and cloud modernization initiatives.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement sustainable solutions.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and support runbooks.
  • Participate in on-call support and production release activities as required.

Required Experience And Technical Skills

  • 10+ years of hands-on experience with application development, with a strong focus on database development
  • Strong experience with SQL development across multiple database platforms, including: Microsoft SQL Server (T-SQL), Oracle (PL/SQL), MySQL, etc.
  • Strong database design, normalization, and data modeling expertise.
  • Hands-on experience with ETL development and support.
  • Experience scheduling and managing batch jobs using AutoSys or similar enterprise schedulers.
  • Strong Unix/Linux administration and shell scripting experience.
  • Experience with scripting languages such as Unix, Python, PowerShell, etc
  • Expertise in database performance tuning, query optimization, indexing, and monitoring.
  • Experience with source control tools such as Git, Bitbucket, GitHub, or Azure DevOps.
  • Knowledge of data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, and large-scale data processing.

Education

  • Master's degree in Computer Science or Statistics is preferred.

Other Relevant Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong production support and incident management experience.
  • Ability to mentor junior developers and establish database development best practices.

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As an Application Developer specializing in RDBMS, you will create and maintain database applications for various platforms, including Linux, Unix, and Windows. Responsibilities & Qualifications

 RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Use proven, efficient methodologies to support the Oracle and Structured Query Language (SQL) databases
  • Design and develop comprehensive database schemas, encompassing tables, views, indexes, triggers, stored procedures, functions, and other essential objects.
  • Craft efficient and optimized SQL queries, generate insightful reports, and seamlessly integrate data across various systems and applications.
  • Collaborate closely with end users and administrators to gain an understanding of their data needs, proactively optimize database performance, and uphold data quality standards.
  • Continuously monitor and optimize database performance through query tuning, index optimization, and resource management to ensure optimal efficiency and responsiveness.
  • Implement and enforce data security measures, including access controls, encryption, and authentication, to safeguard sensitive information and maintain compliance with relevant regulations
  • Create and maintain data models that accurately represent the organization's data structure and relationships, helping to guide database design decisions.
  • Document database architecture, configurations, and processes to ensure that knowledge is well-documented and can be easily transferred to other team members.
  • Develop and maintain Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) processes to move, transform, and load data from various sources into the database, ensuring data consistency and quality.
  • Perform capacity planning for future data growth and resource requirements, and plan for scaling the database infrastructure accordingly.
  • Plan and execute database migrations, ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.
  • Diagnose and resolve database-related issues, working closely with developers, system administrators, and other relevant teams to address technical challenges.
  • Provide guidance and mentorship to junior database developers and team members, fostering skill development and best practices.
  • Formulates/defines system scope and objectives.
  • Devises or modifies procedures to solve complex problems considering computer equipment capacity and limitations.
  • Prepares detailed specifications from which programs will be written.
  • Designs, codes, tests, debugs, and documents those programs.
  • Participates in related areas, such as such as design, implementation, integration, management, and maintenance of complex databases, with respect to the operating system, access methods, access time, device allocation, validation checks, organization, protection and security, documentation, guidelines, and statistical methods; evaluation of commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) products; and analysis of hardware/software issues.
  • May direct the work of others.

Required Qualifications

  • Ten years of technical experience in applications software development, three of which are in systems analysis
  • 1 year of which is acting as technical lead.
  • Master’s degree in Engineering/Computer Science or area related to the project’s functional requirement
  • Has a good understanding of the business or function for which the application is designed
  • Proficient with software languages, such as HyperText Markup Language (HTML), JAVA, JavaScript, Postgres, Python, CSS, SQL, NoSQL, C#, Perl or other languages as required.
  • Competent to work at a high level for all phases of system/database development/management
  • Ability to pass a DOI Background Investigation and obtain a Public Trust Clearance

Desired Qualifications

  • Strong skills in SQL for querying and manipulating data in Oracle databases.
  • Proficiency in PL/SQL for developing stored procedures, triggers and functions.
  • Proficiency in Oracle Database management is essential. This includes understanding database architecture, SQL, PL/SQL and database design principles.
  • Strong problem-solving skills to troubleshoot and resolve database-related issues
  • Ability to design and implement database structures, including tables, indexes and constraints, to ensure data integrity and optimal performance.
  • Understanding performance tuning techniques and the ability to optimize database performance
  • Familiarity with Oracle tools and technologies like Oracle enterprise manager, Oracle Data Pump and Oracle Recovery Manager
  • Knowledge of Unix/Linux and Windows Operating systems

With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As an Application Developer specializing in RDBMS, you will create and maintain database applications for various platforms, including Linux, Unix, and Windows. You will utilize your expertise in writing code in PL/SQL, T-SQL, and DB2 application development for LUW to design, develop, and test database applications.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

  • Design Database Applications: Design efficient, secure, and reliable database applications that meet the required specifications, utilizing your knowledge of database concepts, data modeling, and SQL programming.
  • Develop Database Code: Write high-quality code in PL/SQL, T-SQL, and DB2 for LUW, ensuring database applications are functional and meet performance expectations.
  • Test and Optimize: Test and optimize database applications to ensure they are running efficiently and effectively, identifying areas for improvement and implementing changes as needed.
  • Ensure Data Security: Ensure database applications are secure, adhering to best practices and guidelines to protect sensitive data and prevent unauthorized access.

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • RDBMS Application Development: Exposure to designing, developing, and testing database applications for various platforms, including Linux, Unix, and Windows.

Job Description

Must Have Technical/Functional Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience working with IBM DB2 UDB (LUW).
  • Strong SQL skills (complex joins, subqueries, window functions, correlated queries).
  • Experience writing stored procedures, user-defined functions, triggers, and packages in DB2.
  • Proficient in performance tuning: explain plans, index design, bind/rebind concepts, and statistics.
  • Familiarity with database design concepts, normalization/denormalization, and ER modeling.
  • Experience with ETL processes and tools (e.g., IBM DataStage, Informatica, SSIS) or scripting for data movement.
  • Experience with backup/restore, high availability, and disaster recovery solutions for DB2.
  • Comfortable working with Linux/Unix/Windows environments and shell scripting for automation.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Roles & Responsibilities

Role Summary

We’re seeking an experienced DB2 UDB Developer to design, develop, and maintain applications and database solutions on IBM DB2 (UDB). The ideal candidate has strong SQL and performance-tuning skills, experience with DB2 on LUW (Linux/Unix/Windows) and a track record of working with development teams to deliver reliable, high-performance data solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain stored procedures, functions, triggers, packages, and SQL scripts for DB2 UDB.
  • Collaborate with application developers and architects to design efficient data models and queries.
  • Optimize SQL statements and database structures for performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Analyze and resolve database performance issues (e.g., high CPU, long-running queries, I/O bottlenecks).
  • Implement and maintain indexing strategies, table partitioning, and data distribution techniques.
  • Participate in database capacity planning, backup/restore strategy, and disaster recovery planning.
  • Support schema changes and data migrations; write migration scripts and assist with deployment planning.
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and compliance with organizational policies and standards.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation: data models, ER diagrams, SQL standards, and runbooks.
  • Work with DBAs to monitor database health, apply patches, and manage configuration changes.
  • Assist in troubleshooting application/database interactions, including connection pooling and transaction issues.
  • Participate in code reviews, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience working with IBM DB2 UDB (LUW).
  • Certification: IBM Certified Database Administrator or relevant DB2 certification.
  • Familiarity with application servers (WebSphere, JBoss), connection pooling, and JDBC/ODBC drivers.
  • Experience with CI/CD for database changes (Liquibase, Flyway, custom pipelines).
  • Knowledge of SQL performance tools (db2exfmt, db2expln) and monitoring tools (IBM Data Studio, Nagios, Prometheus).
  • Experience wit h data warehousing, OLAP, and analytical workloads.
  • Exposure to cloud-based DB2 deployments or migration experience to cloud platforms.

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical mindset and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently and in cross-functional teams.
  • Good documentation and knowledge-sharing habits.
  • Comfortable in fast-paced/agile environments.

TCS Employee Benefits Summary

Discretionary Annual Incentive.

Comprehensive Medical Coverage: Medical & Health, Dental & Vision, Disability Planning & Insurance, Pet Insurance Plans.

Family Support: Maternal & Parental Leaves.

Insurance Options: Auto & Home Insurance, Identity Theft Protection.

Convenience & Professional Growth: Commuter Benefits & Certification & Training Reimbursement.

Time Off: Vacation, Time Off, Sick Leave & Holidays.

Legal & Financial Assistance: Legal Assistance, 401K Plan, Performance Bonus, College Fund, Student Loan Refinancing.

Salary Range: $120,000 - $130,000 a year

Qualifications: BACHELOR OF COMPUTER SCIENCE

Power Global Supply Chains: Database Developer (Remote, US)

Shape the future of global logistics by engineering high-availability database solutions that connect freight networks worldwide. If you thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative space turning complex data into seamless transportation technology, Trimble is where you belong.

About Us

Trimble is an industrial technology company transforming the way the world works by delivering solutions that enable our customers to thrive. We create technologies that connect the digital and physical worlds, helping our customers increase productivity, quality, safety, and sustainability. From purpose-built products to enterprise-level solutions, our technology empowers professionals in construction, geospatial, government, transportation, and more.

T&l

Trimble Transportation is transforming the global supply chain through intelligent, connected technology and workflows that are rooted in industry standard commercial maps and data. At the intersection of the physical and digital worlds, Trimble Transportation offers SaaS, web, mobile and installed solutions that improve efficiency, promote safety, optimize utilization, and enable collaboration. From planning to delivery, we provide cutting edge procurement, transportation management, mapping, routing, dispatch, navigation, location, fleet management, ELD compliance and asset maintenance solutions. For more information, visit: transportation.trimble.com.

What Makes This Role Great

In this role, you will play a central part in advancing enterprise-scale database services that keep mission-critical supply chain platforms running around the clock, directly influencing platform stability and next-generation architectural enhancements.

Key Exciting Responsibilities

  • Architect, design, and optimize robust relational database schemas and objects to power high-volume, real-time logistics services.
  • Partner across engineering and infrastructure teams to identify stability enhancements, elevate reporting capabilities, and implement best practices.
  • Deliver high-performance SQL and T-SQL development, conducting code reviews to ensure top-tier quality and data integrity.
  • Drive estimations, prototyping, and end-to-end delivery of database features in an agile, developer-empowered environment.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience in MS SQL and T-SQL development supporting production environments.
  • Proven track record in data architecture, relational table design, and complex stored procedure implementation.
  • Strong expertise in SQL performance tuning and scaling large, high-volume database systems.
  • Bachelor degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or equivalent practical professional experience.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience with Database Administration (DBA) practices.
  • Hands-on familiarity with cloud technologies, migrations, and modern data platforms.

Logistics Location: Fully Remote, United States Travel Requirement: 0-10%

Salary

companyDescription:
Child Care Resource Center (CCRC) assists close to 50,000 parents, children, and child care providers each month in Northern Los Angeles County and the entirety of San Bernardino County serving a total area of 22,500 square miles. 

Since 1976, CCRC has been managing programs to assist with issues such as finding and selecting child care, child care financial assistance, school readiness, home visiting, and research and program evaluation. Children and families benefit from these programs, allowing parents to go to work and attend school, contribute to the economy and strengthen their families and the community. CCRC's early care & education specialists offer parents and child care professionals assistance ranging from finding child care and child development ages & stages to marketing child care businesses and CPR training and certification.

CCRC operates and oversees Head Start Birth-5 programs for a total of 3,312 children. These programs promote school readiness and family engagement to ensure a healthy development of children and their families. Children benefit from a high quality preschool education as well as medical and dental exams. 

Through CCRC’s literacy campaign “What a Difference a Book Makes”, we have collected 800,000 age appropriate books. It is the agency’s belief that the cognitive benefits of literacy are immeasurable and has a large impact on the ability of an economy to general and sustain wealth. 

Mission: CCRC cultivates child, family and community well-being.
companySlogan: CCRC cultivates child, family, and community well-being.
descriptionHtml:
Expected Hourly Pay Rate

$46.19

Work where your work matters. Work at CCRC.

CCRC prides itself as a workplace of choice for passionate talent, driven by our mission to cultivate child, family and community well-being. Whether the position works directly with the public or supports our programs, every position is vital to our mission's success and reputation as a leader. We are not your typical non-profit. We are 900+ people strong and growing!

General Summary

Under general supervision of the Special Application Support Manager, the Sr. Database Developer designs, develops, optimizes, and maintains the database and reporting solutions that support agency operations, analytics, and business decision-making. This is a senior-level technical role that owns the architecture of CCRC’s data warehouse and leads integration of new applications into the enterprise data ecosystem while serving as a subject matter expert to business stakeholders, analysts, application developers across Programs, Finance, Research, and other divisions.

The role also carries responsibility for data governance: ensuring the integrity, quality, security, and availability of enterprise data assets through documented standards, validation processes, and compliance with regulatory requirements, including HIPAA.

This position is classified as Hybrid, full time, 40 hours per week.

Please review the full job flyer here.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Within a team structure, this position will perform the following responsibilities:

Data Architecture, Development, and Analytics (50%)

Data Governance, Data Integrity, and Quality (25%)

Stakeholder Partnership and User Enablement (15%)

Data Advisory and Leadership Support (5%)

Operational Excellence and Documentation (5%)

Job Specifications

Minimum Required

  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science or related discipline.
  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in SQL application and database development, database administration support, data management, reporting, and analytics environments.
  • Technical Requirements:
    • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft SQL Server and SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS).
    • Advanced knowledge of T-SQL, stored procedures, views, functions, triggers, and database optimization techniques.
    • Experience supporting data integration, ETL processes, and reporting environments.
    • Experience developing and supporting business intelligence solutions, dashboards, scorecards, and KPI reporting tools.
    • Strong understanding of relational database design principles, normalization, indexing strategies, and data modeling methodologies.
    • Experience reviewing execution plans, identifying performance bottlenecks, and implementing database optimization strategies.
    • Experience implementing data governance frameworks, data quality controls, and data stewardship best practices.
    • Knowledge of data lifecycle management, data lineage, metadata management, and master data concepts.
    • Understanding of database security, access controls, auditing, and compliance requirements.
    • Experience gathering business requirements, conducting stakeholder interviews, and translating business needs into technical reporting and data solutions
    • Ability to communicate technical and analytical concepts to non-technical audiences, including managers, directors, and executive leadership.
    • Strong documentation, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
    • Experience working within Change Management and Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) frameworks.
    • Travel: Some travel/business related driving required for all staff, large divisional events, and specified meetings. Staff may choose any mode of transportation (driving, walking, bicycling, carpooling, etc.) to arrive to and depart from the location where attendance is required. Should a staff member choose to drive, the staff member must become an approved driver with CCRC prior to driving on behalf of CCRC. Approved drivers driving on behalf of CCRC may choose to drive a CCRC vehicle or own vehicle and must meet requirements to be an approved driver including holding and maintaining current auto insurance, current California Driver’s License and receiving DMV clearance.

  • Work Schedule: This position is hybrid. Full time, typically M-F, ability to at times work a non-traditional work schedule including early mornings, late evenings, and weekends.
  • Work Environment: Standard office environment with moderate level of background noise.
  • Background & Health Clearance Requirements: Background requirements determined according to the requirements of the program(s) which the position will be supporting. Background check required. As a grant-funded Agency supporting Children and Family Services, CCRC conducts background checks commensurate with the role to verify candidate qualifications (criminal history, employment history / experience, education, reference checks) and ensure grant compliance. Specific roles may have additional verification / clearance to the standard background check as part of the recruitment and selection process, including:
    • Live Scan Clearance / DOJ Fingerprinting: For positions working directly with the public in a child/ community care or child / community care adjacent setting (CA Health and Safety Code Section 1596.871 and/or Head Start Program Performance Standards 1302.90).

descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a highly skilled SSIS/SQL Developer to join our dynamic and innovative team. As an SSIS/SQL Developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining efficient database load and update processes using Microsoft SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) and other related technologies. Your expertise in SSIS and SQL programming, particularly with large data sets, will be crucial in developing our data integration packages, ensuring data accuracy, and supporting various data-driven initiatives within our organization.


SSIS/SQL Developer Responsibilities and Duties


  • Design, develop, and maintain SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) packages to efficiently load large, consolidated data sets.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather business requirements and translate them into technical specifications for data integration and SSIS solutions.
  • Create and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and functions where necessary to support SSIS package operation/performance.
  • Perform data profiling and analysis to identify data quality issues and propose appropriate solutions.
  • Implement data cleansing, transformation, and validation rules to ensure the accuracy and consistency of data.
  • Collaborate with database administrators and data architects to align processes with the company’s data processing frameworks and database standards.
  • Develop and maintain documentation, including data flow diagrams, data dictionaries, and technical specifications.
  • Monitor and optimize the performance of SSIS processes to ensure efficient data processing and system reliability.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve data-related issues, including data integration failures, data quality problems, and performance bottlenecks.
  • Stay up to date with industry trends and best practices in SSIS, SQL development, and data integration technologies.


SSIS/SQL Developer Work Experience


  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in designing and implementing SSIS solutions according to best practices, ideally with large data sets.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience working as a SQL Developer within a data intensive environment, demonstrating strong analytical and critical thinking skills, including a thorough understanding of how to interpret customer business requirements and translate them into database-oriented solutions.


SSIS/SQL Developer Qualifications and Skills


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. Equivalent work experience may be considered.
  • Proven experience as an SSIS/SQL Developer or a similar role, with a strong understanding of database concepts and SQL programming.
  • In-depth knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) and experience in designing and developing database load/update processes.
  • Proficiency in SQL programming, including complex query optimization, stored procedures, and functions.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling concepts
  • Familiarity with data profiling and quality assurance techniques.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with the ability to identify data-related issues and propose effective solutions.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment. Ability and desire to share SSIS knowledge, approaches, and experience with less experienced team members.
  • Ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.


SSIS/SQL Developer Additional Considerations


  • Python/PHP experience a plus
  • Familiarity with API integrations

descriptionHtml:
About Peregrine

Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA.

Our clients describe our support as "absolutely excellent" and our people as "instrumental to organization's success." Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair's Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership.

We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people.

As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become.

People first. Ownership always.

We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else.

At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk.

At Peregrine Advisors, you will design and build the data layer for a federal enterprise platform. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are.

This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination.

Your first project

Your first project will likely have you taking responsibility for the accuracy and performance of your assigned components. Depending on the assignment, you may:

  • Design database schemas, and write the views, stored procedures, functions, and Structured Query Language (SQL) queries that run on them
  • Build and maintain data pipelines and extract, transform, and load (ETL) and extract, load, and transform (ELT) processes, including loads from Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3)
  • Make queries and databases fast enough for high-volume workloads
  • Help model data across Amazon Web Services (AWS) stores such as Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL-compatible), Amazon DynamoDB, and S3
  • Keep data accurate and secure, with governed access and changes that can be audited
  • Work out data access patterns and integrations with developers, architects, and data engineers
  • Where the work allows, use artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted tools for query, pipeline, and troubleshooting work, and review and validate what they produce

You deliver database components accurate and fast enough that analysts and systems trust them. You automate the loads and checks that used to be run by hand, and you build models that keep working as the platform grows.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of data engineering, database development, database engineering, software development, or comparable practical experience
  • Bachelor's degree
  • SQL skills across complex queries, views, stored procedures, and functions, together with relational design, normalization, and data modeling
  • Working expertise in Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL-compatible), covering schema design, stored procedures and functions, and indexing
  • Experience with Amazon DynamoDB, covering data modeling and Global and Local Secondary Indexes (GSIs and LSIs)
  • Performance and query tuning that addresses slow queries through indexing and execution-plan work
  • Experience making logical data modeling and database-design decisions for assigned components within an established platform architecture
  • ETL and ELT development and data integration across AWS data services such as Aurora, DynamoDB, and S3
  • Experience working within data security controls such as encryption, access management, and auditing
  • Experience loading data from S3 into the platform stores and connecting through Open Database Connectivity (ODBC) and Java Database Connectivity (JDBC)
  • Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel

Preferred

  • An AWS certification at the associate level, such as Developer Associate or Solutions Architect Associate
  • Experience tuning queries that involve locking and deadlocks
  • Familiarity with supporting cloud-native applications in AWS through continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) and development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) practices
  • Ownership of physical design for Aurora and DynamoDB schemas and indexes, or the drive to grow into it
  • Experience in federal information technology or high-volume transaction environments
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted developer tools

Who You Are

You enjoy building with SQL and take responsibility for getting data right. You can take a database problem from design through delivery and stand behind how your work performs. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task.

What You Bring

  • Solid SQL on a modern relational platform, Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL-compatible), with stored procedures, functions, and views that hold up in use
  • Practical skill in query tuning against slow queries, indexing, and execution plans, together with data loading, connectivity, version control, and clean delivery
  • Practical experience developing logical data models and database schemas, and making database-design decisions for assigned components within the established platform architecture
  • The ability to own assigned database work from design through maintenance, working within data security controls, with sound judgment where accuracy and auditability are not optional

When we talk

Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned.

Benefits

This is a full-time W-2 position with a salary of $120,000 to $140,000 per year.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer-paid life, accidental death, and short-term and long-term disability insurance; a 401(k) with an employer match of up to 4% of salary; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.

What We Offer

You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship.

What We Commit To

As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better.

We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.

Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer.

descriptionHtml:
Tygart Technology is seeking an experienced Data Engineer / Database Developer to support a DOJ component. The candidate will be an integral part of a collaborative team, working closely with government staff to develop innovative data solutions that meet the needs of business stakeholders. This position requires a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience and an active Top Secret security clearance.

Position Responsibilities

  • Leverage SQL databases and reporting tools to develop and implement new IT capabilities and data solutions through notifications, reports, and data services.
  • Support organizational data needs by developing SQL-based notifications, reporting, and data visualization solutions.
  • Analyze user requirements and deliver end-to-end data solutions, including database design, development, integration, and implementation.
  • Design, develop, and optimize relational database structures, queries, stored procedures, and data services.
  • Develop and maintain data integration solutions connecting Microsoft SQL Server, SharePoint, and other enterprise applications.
  • Design and implement data storage frameworks such as databases, data lakes, data warehouses, and data marts to support strategic and tactical organizational objectives.
  • Develop ETL processes and data pipelines to support data extraction, transformation, validation, and delivery across business processes and IT infrastructure.
  • Perform requirements gathering, data modeling, schema design, query optimization, and ongoing enhancement of enterprise data solutions.
  • Conduct data validation and verification in accordance with agency policies, industry best practices, and documentation standards.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in data engineering and database development, supporting communication, reporting, and data-driven business processes.
  • Provide technical recommendations and implement data solutions to support mission-critical organizational needs.

Required Qualifications:

  • Active Top Secret security clearance.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Engineering, Computer Information Systems, or a related analytical, scientific, or technical discipline.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in data engineering, database development, or related data-focused IT disciplines.
  • Strong experience developing and working with SQL databases and technologies such as SQL Server, Oracle, MS Access, MySQL, PostgreSQL, XML, and CSV.
  • At least 3 years of experience with web-based technologies, including SharePoint and Microsoft SQL, supporting data delivery, integration, reporting, and visualization in browser-based environments.
  • Experience developing SQL queries, stored procedures, database schemas, data models, and reporting solutions.
  • Experience developing ETL processes, data pipelines, and data integration solutions.
  • Experience with SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) and other reporting and visualization tools.
  • Familiarity with Windows virtual server environments and government information security, assurance, and accessibility requirements.
  • Experience migrating and deploying database solutions across development, test, and production environments is preferred.
  • Ability to perform effectively under pressure, with strong oral and written communication skills and excellent organizational abilities.

The base salary range for this position is $110,00 to $130,000. Actual compensation will be determined based on work location, qualifications, experience, job-related skills, and relevant education or training.

Why Join Tygart Technology? At Tygart Technology, we value innovation, integrity, and technical excellence. You'll join a team of dedicated professionals who deliver mission-critical solutions to our government partners. We offer competitive compensation, benefits, and the opportunity to grow your career while supporting impactful work.

Founded in 1992, Tygart's customer-first mindset and agile development methodology have led to our continued success. Tygart supports the Department of Defense, Federal Bureau of Investigation, Intelligence Community, Federal Election Commission, Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation, and various other Federal and State organizations and maintains offices in West Virginia and Northern Virginia.

Oracle is a global leader in AI, delivering the cloud infrastructure, data, and applications that organizations across the world trust to successfully achieve business outcomes at scale.

Oracle Government, Defense & Intelligence Consulting Group is seeking a highly experienced, motivated and security-cleared Consulting Senior Principal - AI Database Developer to join our team support our IC programs in Northern Virginia. In this hands-on technical role, you will design, develop, and optimize Oracle database solutions, data pipelines, and AI-enabled data platforms for enterprise-scale mission systems.

You will work with customer stakeholders, architects, data scientists, and database administrators to translate complex requirements into secure, reliable, and high-performing solutions. This role demands technical expertise, strategic thinking, and hands-on experience with Oracle-based systems in high-volume environments.

If you thrive in a fast-paced, data-driven organization and enjoy solving complex data engineering challenges, we want to hear from you.

Most possess or have the ability to obtain and maintain TS/SCI Security Clearance with Poly

This full-time, in-person role is based at our Reston, Virginia, office, with occasional visits to client sites. We are seeking candidates who live within commuting distance of Reston.

Responsibilities

Required Skills:

  • MUST possess or have the ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI with Poly.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • At least 6 years of relevant experience in database development, data engineering, or ETL/ELT development for enterprise-scale systems.
  • Strong hands-on experience designing, developing, and implementing Oracle Database solutions.
  • Advanced SQL and PL/SQL skills, including stored procedures, packages, complex queries, and performance optimization.
  • Experience designing and implementing scalable data pipelines, including data transformation, validation, error handling, and operational monitoring.
  • Experience working with geospatial data, including vector and raster formats.
  • Experience working with different data formats, such as relational, spatial, JSON, and graph data.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Experience working with containers and Kubernetes.
  • Proficiency in Python, shell scripting, or comparable tools for automation and data processing.
  • Working knowledge of data governance, metadata management, data lineage, and secure data handling.
  • Ability to collaborate with data scientists, database administrators, application developers, analysts, and customer stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and written and verbal communication skills.


Desired Skills:

  • Experience supporting Intelligence Community (IC) or other federal mission systems.
  • Experience with Oracle Spatial, including spatial indexing, coordinate systems, spatial queries, and raster data management.
  • Hands-on experience with vector embeddings, vector data types, similarity search, and RAG workflows.
  • Familiarity with MCP and its use in connecting AI applications to approved data sources and tools.
  • Experience developing RESTful APIs.
  • Experience with Git, automated deployments, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience applying database security controls, auditing, and customer-specific compliance requirements.
  • Relevant Oracle certifications, such as Oracle Database or OCI architecture certifications.

descriptionHtml:
Job Summary:


The Database Programmer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining SQL Server database objects, ETL processes, reports, dashboards, and data extracts that support operational reporting and business analytics across AnovoRx. This role partners with the Reporting and Business Analytics team and business stakeholders to translate raw operational data into reliable, well-structured, production-ready datasets that support decision-making in a specialty pharmacy environment serving patients with rare diseases. The position also supports key initiatives, including Aperture, while ensuring data handling practices protect PHI and comply with HIPAA requirements.


Primary Duties and Responsibilities






  • Design, develop, test, implement, and maintain SQL Server database objects, including stored procedures, views, functions, triggers, tables, and related structures.

  • Build, enhance, and optimize ETL processes to extract, transform, validate, and prepare data from core systems, including CPR+, for reporting, dashboards, analytics, and operational use.

  • Develop and maintain reporting and dashboard data sources using tools such as SSRS, Power BI, or similar business intelligence platforms.

  • Support the Aperture project and other active initiatives by delivering accurate, timely, and well-documented data extracts, queries, and database development support.

  • Tune queries, indexes, and database logic to improve performance, scalability, and reliability across growing data volumes.

  • Partner with analysts, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to understand ad hoc and recurring data needs and translate them into sustainable, production-ready database solutions.

  • Maintain data dictionaries, schema documentation, ETL documentation, and technical specifications to support transparency, continuity, and knowledge transfer.

  • Troubleshoot database, reporting, data integrity, and performance issues; identify root causes and recommend or implement corrective actions.

  • Ensure database development, data extraction, and data handling practices are consistent with HIPAA requirements and Company policies for safeguarding PHI and confidential information.

  • Follow database development best practices, coding standards, testing procedures, and change management processes to promote quality and reliability.

  • Other work-related duties as assigned by supervisor/manager.





    • Minimum Knowledge, Abilities, and Skills Required


     


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, a related field, or equivalent professional experience required.

  • Minimum of three years of hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server, including T-SQL development, stored procedures, views, functions, and related database objects.

  • Experience building, maintaining, and optimizing ETL pipelines using SSIS or an equivalent ETL tool.

  • Strong understanding of relational database design, normalization, indexing strategy, query tuning, and database performance optimization.

  • Experience supporting reporting and business intelligence tools such as SSRS, Power BI, or similar platforms.

  • Ability to translate ad hoc and recurring business data needs into accurate, reliable, production-ready SQL queries, data extracts, and reporting datasets.

  • Snowflake, Azure, a strong understanding of cloud databases, and project/data migration

  • Strong written communication skills, including the ability to document data structures, schemas, ETL processes, technical specifications, and recurring reporting logic.

  • Experience in healthcare, pharmacy, specialty pharmacy, or another regulated data environment preferred.

  • Familiarity with specialty pharmacy systems, including CPR+, preferred.

  • Working knowledge of HIPAA data handling requirements and safeguards for PHI preferred.

  • Scripting experience, such as Python or PowerShell, for automation preferred.

  • Exposure to Azure SQL or other cloud-hosted SQL Server environments preferred.

  • Must have excellent computer skills and proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

  • Must have history evidencing reliability and consistency in timeliness, attendance, and quality of work.

  • Must articulate thoughts well and communicate clearly, both orally and in writing.

  • Able to work independently as well as collaboratively with analysts, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.

  • Willingness to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

  • Must not have history evidencing dishonesty, lack of trustworthiness, or workplace violence.

  • Must pass the Company’s drug test and background screening prior to start of employment.

  • Cannot be disqualified or suspended from participation in any state or federal healthcare program.





    • This description is intended to be only a general outline of major activities. It is expected that the employee performs these and any other activities which may be assigned, or which may occur in the normal course of work. This description is not a contract or guarantee of employment. AnovoRx is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionHtml:
Overview

Design the data foundation behind mission-critical geospatial systems.

Join Esri`s Professional Services organization and partner with Defense and Intelligence customers to design, implement, secure, and optimize enterprise database environments supporting geospatial applications.

You`ll bring deep database engineering expertise to complex customer environments, working across database architecture, performance, automation, security, high availability, disaster recovery, cloud database technologies, and spatial data. You`ll also advise customers on database design, migration, and integration approaches throughout the engagement lifecycle.

Esri has a Relocation Assistance Program and can provide support with relocating to the St. Louis, MO area for this position.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable, secure, enterprise database environments
  • Configure and maintain database platforms
  • Develop high availability, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery strategies
  • Monitor and optimize database performance
  • Implement database security and access controls
  • Automate database loading, maintenance, and monitoring
  • Support database migration and integration initiatives
  • Apply geospatial concepts including spatial data types and spatial indexing
  • Advise customers on enterprise database best practices

Requirements

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in database design, administration, and optimization for Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or SAP HANA
  • Demonstrated experience with database design principles, data loading techniques, backup and recovery solutions, performance monitoring and tuning, database maintenance, and security
  • Scripting skills in SQL and Python for automation and data workflows
  • Experience with cloud-based database solutions (such as AWS RDS, Azure SQL Database)
  • Understanding of geospatial concepts such as spatial data types, coordinate systems, and spatial indexing
  • Ability to clearly communicate complex technical concepts to technical peers and non-technical project managers or customers
  • US citizenship with Active or Current (within 2 years of active) Top Secret Security Clearance with SCI eligibility
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, mathematics, GIS, or related STEM field

Recommended Qualifications

  • Experience with ArcGIS Enterprise geodatabases
  • Knowledge of integrating GIS with other enterprise systems
  • CompTIA Security + certification
  • One or more industry-standard IT certifications (such as Esri, Microsoft, Amazon, PostgreSQL, Oracle)
  • Master's degree in computer science, mathematics, GIS or related STEM field

Total RewardsEsri’s competitive total rewards strategy includes industry-leading health and welfare benefits: medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance for employees (and their families), 401(k) and profit-sharing programs, minimum accrual of 80 hours of vacation leave, twelve paid holidays throughout the calendar year, and opportunities for personal and professional growth. Base salary is one component of our total rewards strategy. Compensation decisions and the base range for this role take into account many factors including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs.

A reasonable estimate of the base salary range is: $120,640 USD - $197,600 USD

descriptionHtml:
Penlink is a technology company bringing clarity to complex data for people who need it now. We partner with law enforcement agencies across the world, offering a software solution to manage data and aid investigators solving crimes. It sounds like a lot of data and analytics, but really, it’s about improving the world and keeping safe the places we call home.

As a Database Engineer, you will be responsible for working within a software engineering team to design and develop software solutions utilizing an Oracle database backend. You’ll be creating new relational database models, improving, and extending existing models, and writing queries and stored procedures in collaboration with other database engineers. You will be responsible for making decisions on partitioning, indexing, and structure to ensure the product performs optimally and reliably under demanding and diverse use cases.

LOCATION: this is a hybrid opportunity with the requirement to commute to the Lincoln office twice a week.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design and implement moderately complex SQL queries, views, and stored procedures to support product features and reporting needs.
  • Optimize existing database structures, queries, and indexes to improve performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Perform regular data quality checks and resolve data integrity issues across systems.
  • Support application developers by advising on data access patterns, query design, and schema usage.
  • Contribute to relational data modeling decisions, including table design, relationships, and constraints.
  • Participate in code reviews for database changes and uphold team coding standards and documentation practices.
  • Investigate and resolve database-related defects, escalating complex issues with clear analysis when needed.
  • Maintain thorough documentation of schemas, procedures, and changes.
  • Mentor and support Database Engineer I team members on day-to-day tasks and tools.
  • All other duties as the business requires

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Oracle or PostgreSQL certification recommended.
  • 2–5 years of relevant database engineering experience.
  • Advanced SQL skills, including query optimization and stored procedure development.
  • Solid understanding of relational data modeling, normalization, and schema design.
  • Experience with indexing strategies and diagnosing performance bottlenecks.
  • Proactive troubleshooting skills and the ability to work independently on assigned tasks.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to support developers across teams.
  • Disciplined approach to documentation and change management.
  • Hands-on experience with Oracle or PostgreSQL in a production environment.
  • Familiarity with partitioning, query execution plans, and database monitoring tools.
  • Experience supporting data-intensive or analytics-heavy applications.

This position currently follows a hybrid schedule requiring two days per week in our Lincoln, Nebraska office. Onsite requirements may be adjusted based on business needs and company or departmental policy.

descriptionHtml:
Position Summary

Work Arrangement

***This position is available as a hybrid position in our Sioux Falls, SD office.***

At The Bancorp, we’ve spent more than 25 years driving innovation in the financial services industry. As one of the first banks to embrace fintech, we combine technology, expertise and a forward-looking approach to deliver creative, real-world solutions. We work side by side with our partners to help them grow and innovate with confidence. Across Fintech Solutions, Institutional Banking, Commercial Lending and Real Estate Bridge Lending, we provide the people, processes, technology and banking capabilities that turn bold ideas into outcomes.

Join a team that brings urgency and rigor to every challenge and plays a direct role in driving growth for our clients and the communities we serve.

The AVP Database Developer III role designs, develops, and implements data integration packages for the organization. Performs a wide variety of database programming assignments and research/troubleshooting in T-SQL. Troubleshoots and maintains existing ETL packages. Becomes a subject matter expert in the organization’s SSIS packages.

Key Responsibilities

  • Creates new Extraction, Transformation, and Loading (ETL) packages to achieve data integration between various source and destination systems including the ACH & Wire transfer processing system GPP.
  • Tests and debugs code using departmental standards and protocols prior to elevation.
  • Acts as a subject matter expert in the existing ETL packages used to load GPP data for reporting. Makes recommendations and implement improvements to the packages.
  • Reviews database design and code written by other database and application developers, identifies issues and discusses efficiencies to improve data integration code and/or controls.
  • Troubleshoots ETL issues as they arise by evaluating the ETL packages, source data, and destination systems.
  • Develops, updates, and maintains ETL specifications and documentation used to develop data migration mappings and transformations.
  • Develops close working relationships with project management and end users to understand issues and delivers accurate and efficient solutions.
  • Serves as a mentor to less experienced database developers to develop their skills. Acts as a resource for the team by providing advice and guidance on programming issues and concerns. Brainstorms solutions with the team and provide feedback as needed.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • No travel required.

Qualification Requirements

  • Undergraduate degree in a related field or an equivalent combination of training and experience.
  • Minimum 5 years of T-SQL and SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) development experience.
  • Banking or financial services experience, preferred.
  • Working knowledge of Anti Money Laundering platforms and technologies such as Actimize, preferred.
  • Working knowledge of Global Payment Processing platforms and technologies such as Finastra’s GPP, preferred.
  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, preferred.
  • Excellent analytical ability, judgement, and problem analysis techniques, preferred.
  • Ability to write and understand complex SQL queries, preferred.
  • Ability to take ownership of projects and be self-directed, preferred.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team-fashioned, multi-tasking environment, preferred.

What Success Looks Like

  • SSIS packages and T-SQL solutions are clearly scoped, developed, tested, documented, and implemented in accordance with departmental standards.
  • Data integrations across the organization’s ETL portfolio, including those supporting Actimize, operate reliably and deliver accurate, timely data to critical systems.
  • Finastra Global Payment Processing (GPP) data structures, mappings, transformation rules, dependencies, and downstream uses are thoroughly understood and documented.
  • Changes affecting GPP data used for ACH payments governed by Nacha rules and wire payment processing are evaluated early and translated into controlled ETL updates with minimal disruption and rework.
  • Production issues are identified, analyzed, communicated, and resolved efficiently, with consideration for source data, ETL processing, destination systems, and business impact.
  • Database designs and code are reviewed consistently, with performance, quality, maintainability, and control concerns identified and addressed before deployment.
  • ETL specifications, data mappings, support procedures, and technical documentation remain current, accessible, and sufficient for ongoing maintenance and troubleshooting.
  • Team capability grows through mentoring, knowledge sharing, constructive code reviews, and collaboration with developers, project managers, business stakeholders, and external partners.

Why This Role Matters

  • The AVP Database Developer III helps The Bancorp turn internal and partner-provided data requirements into reliable, maintainable ETL solutions across critical business systems. By providing technical leadership across the ETL portfolio and serving as the subject matter expert for Finastra GPP data, this role helps ensure that data generated through ACH and wire payment processing is accurately understood, integrated, and made available for reporting and other downstream uses.
  • In a regulated financial services environment, changes to third-party payment data can affect reporting, operational processes, compliance activities, and multiple downstream systems. This role provides the technical knowledge, disciplined testing, effective controls, reliable documentation, and cross-functional coordination needed to reduce risk, resolve issues efficiently, and support scalable data integration with confidence.

Additional Information

This job will be open and accepting applications for a minimum of five days from the date it was posted.

Working at The Bancorp Bank, N.A. and Benefits Information: https://thebancorp.com/company/join-our-team/

Company Culture & Background Screening

Company Culture at The Bancorp Bank: https://www.thebancorp.com/company/company-culture/

Employment with The Bancorp Bank, N.A. includes successfully passing a background check including credit, criminal, education, employment, OFAC, and social media background history.

descriptionHtml:
Notified, Your Story Begins Here


We are Notified, the only technology partner dedicated to both investor relations and public relations professionals. We help our clients control and amplify the corporate narrative. Our fully integrated PR and IR platforms streamline every step from press release distribution, media targeting, and analytics to IR websites, earnings and investor events, and regulatory filings. Powered by GlobeNewswire, one of the largest and most trusted newswire distribution networks for over 30 years, we empower communicators to inform a better world.


Notified is an affiliate of Equiniti Group Limited (EQ), a fintech that connects the future of capital, communications, and governance — building trust and confidence in every market we serve.


Summary

Responsible for leading the creation, design, development and implementation of innovative database and or backend solutions for assigned area of responsibility; coordinate with other internal departments to ensure customer requests integrate and deploy as scheduled; ensure the quick implementation of mass data change requests and complex report/data extraction requests making sure the impact on existing applications is adequately analyzed and evaluated; lead the design and development of test codes for data conversions.


Location

This role will be based in our Woburn, MA office, located at 130 New Boston Street and offers in-person collaboration and flexibility to work from home.


What Part You Will Play in Our Growth


Database Developing Functions - Leading the creation, design, development and implementation of innovative database or backend solutions for assigned area of responsibility in accordance to departmental and Company guidelines and timeframes

  • Coordinate with other internal departments to ensure customer requests integrate and deploy as scheduled
  • Ensure the quick implementation of mass data change requests and complex report/data extraction requests making sure the impact on existing applications is adequately analysed and evaluated
  • Lead the design and development of test codes for data conversions
  • Enter codes to create development database, reviewing application design specifications and database access methods to prevent inefficient coding techniques
  • Resolve application support tickets escalated to employee's level ensuring appropriate resolution of issues in a timely manner
  • Write and assist departmental staff with technical system programs to provide specialized database access


Data Support - Ensure data is protected according to departmental policies and procedures and is retrievable in a timely manner, auditing back up rotation to ensure adherence to established standards

  • Establish periodic schedules to test validity of backups and ability to perform restores
  • Establish query standards for accessing databases of different sizes, selecting and upgrading recommended attributes
  • Provide tuning and performance of the database environment by monitoring optimum values for database parameters
  • Develop scripts, documentation, and procedures for database administration, testing, and production


Problem Resolution - Proactively oversee the activities involved in quality resolution of problems related to area of responsibility

  • Respond with a sense of urgency to problems escalated to employee's level
  • Escalate to supervisor any situation outside the employee's control that could adversely impact the services being provided
  • Provide analysis and feedback to management staff and appropriate departments regarding recurring problems, recommending improvements aimed at reducing future occurrences of problems
  • Participate in creating, administering, and continuously updating procedures for resolution of all related issues


Required Knowledge and Skills


Education

  • Bachelor's degree with major course work in computer science, MIS, or a related field is required. Equivalent work experience in a similar position may be substituted for educational requirements Experience

Experience

  • Minimum three years’ experience developing and maintaining databases required
  • Core Database Administration Knowledge: Performance tuning, data modeling and architecture, security and compliance, HA/DR, Cloud and infrastructure, observability
  • Proficient in at least one RDBMS (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle)
  • Experience with Cloud-native DB features, serverless SQL, auto-scaling considerations
  • SQL stored procedures and triggers
  • Relation database modeling for OLPT
  • Database user management and security
  • Database installation, configuration, connectivity, monitoring and fine tuning
  • T-SQL / PL/SQL / PL/pgSQL proficiency, ability to script deployments
  • Version control in Git workflow, all DB changes in source control


Compensation

Our salary range for this role is $135,000 – $150,000 and is commensurate with experience, skills and location.


Why You Will Love Working Here

EQ is recognized as a Top Employer in US, UK and India! Together we offer more than a job, we offer a place to grow. Through hands-on experience, real-world projects, and access to industry-leading tools, you’ll have what you need to build a meaningful career. You’ll join a diverse, global team united by innovation, collaboration, and a shared passion for what we do. With flexible work options, competitive pay, wellness benefits, and a people-first culture, we support your success - both at work and beyond.


Equal Opportunity Statement

We are an equal opportunity employer and make employment decisions without regard to race, creed, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), parental status, marital status, national origin, age, disability, family medical history or genetic information, political affiliation, military service, status with regard to public assistance, or any other characteristic protected under federal, state, or applicable local law.


Come and join us — let’s grow together.
