descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?

Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.

The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.

Pay And Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
  • Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
  • Pension / Retirement benefits
  • Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
  • DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

The Impact You Will Have in This Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, Database Engineering, you will support DTCC’s Institutional Trade Processing applications, including Central Trade Manager (CTM) and Settlement Instruction Manager (SIM), which are critical platforms within the post-trade processing lifecycle.

You will design, develop, and optimize scalable database and application solutions that support high-volume, high-transaction environments. You will also contribute to strategic modernization initiatives focused on cloud adoption, platform resiliency, and performance optimization.

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys working with complex data, building reliable enterprise solutions, and partnering across Agile teams to deliver business-critical technology outcomes.

Your Primary Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and optimize enterprise database solutions using Oracle and PostgreSQL.
  • Build and support high-volume OLTP systems that process large transactional workloads.
  • Develop data models, complex SQL queries, PL/SQL, stored procedures, views, and database objects.
  • Partner with application development teams to build integrated solutions using Java, JDBC, JMS, and related technologies.
  • Support cloud-first modernization initiatives using AWS and cloud-native engineering practices.
  • Implement database change management, schema deployments, and version control using tools such as Liquibase, Git, and GitHub.
  • Perform database performance tuning, query optimization, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis.
  • Support data integration through APIs, SFTP, batch processing, ETL/ELT, and replication technologies.
  • Ensure data quality, security, access controls, resiliency, and operational reliability.
  • Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, sprint planning, design discussions, and delivery execution using Jira.
  • Collaborate with engineers, architects, product owners, and business partners to deliver scalable technical solutions.
  • Mentor junior team members and promote engineering best practices, documentation standards, and technical excellence.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in software engineering, database development, or related technical roles.
  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale applications in high-volume, transactional environments.

Talent Needed for Success

  • Strong experience with Oracle database development, preferably Oracle 19c or higher.
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL in production environments.
  • Advanced SQL and PL/SQL development expertise.
  • Strong experience with data modeling, database design, and OLTP systems.
  • Experience supporting high-volume, high-performance transactional environments.
  • Hands-on Java development experience, including JDBC and JMS.
  • Experience with Linux/Unix environments and shell scripting.
  • Experience with AWS cloud services and cloud-native data platforms.
  • Strong expertise in database performance tuning, query optimization, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with database change management and deployment tools such as Liquibase.
  • Familiarity with Git, GitHub, Jira, and Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to solve complex technical challenges in large-scale, mission-critical environments.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience with database change management and deployment tools such as Liquibase.
  • Familiarity with Git, GitHub, Jira, and Agile/Scrum delivery practices.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to solve complex technical problems in large-scale, high-volume transactional environments.
  • Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting large-scale modernization, cloud transformation, or application migration initiatives.
  • Financial services, capital markets, post-trade processing, or settlement experience.
  • Experience with Snowflake.
  • Experience with Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform.
  • Experience with Jenkins or CI/CD pipelines.
  • Knowledge of Oracle GoldenGate or other data replication technologies.
  • Experience with Python, Perl, or other scripting languages.
  • Familiarity with Oracle RAC, Toad, or Erwin Data Modeler.

The salary range is indicative for roles at the same level within DTCC across all US locations. Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. Job Description

Be an integral part of an agile team that's constantly pushing the envelope to enhance, build, and deliver top-notch technology products.

As a Senior Lead Software Engineer at JPMorganChase within the Consumer and Community Banking Administration - Consumer Banking Technology team, you are an integral part of an agile team that works to enhance, build, and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. Drive significant business impact through your capabilities and contributions, and apply deep technical expertise and problem-solving methodologies to tackle a diverse array of challenges that span multiple technologies and applications.

Job Responsibilities

  • Provide direct support for development teams performing database modernization activities and serve as a function-wide subject matter expert in one or more areas of focus
  • Influences peers and project decision-makers to consider the use and application of leading-edge technologies, providing recommendations on database technology based on applications for the business requirements and needs
  • Contribute as database engineer and development expert, working with application development teams to develop, execute and support database modernization, optimization, performance tuning and design activities

Description

At Accora, we foster and embrace a distinct set of values that we live by and instill in all aspects of our organization: dedication, commitment, partnership, trust, and recognition. We have incorporated these values into successful delivery for our customers since 1988. Accora believes in ensuring its employees feel deeply connected to Accora, recognizing successes and hard work, and providing continuous opportunities to learn and grow. We promote a collaborative culture with our clients, and with each other, as one team working towards a common vision. We’d love you to join our team!

Workplace: Ashburn, VA

Job Summary

Accora Federal is looking for a Database Developer to join a collaborative team of database developers and administrators supporting a large, complex application development program. This role focuses on designing, developing, and maintaining database structures, as well as managing and optimizing data within enterprise-scale environments.

This position offers the opportunity to work in a dynamic, Agile environment while expanding expertise across modern data platforms, cloud technologies, and advanced data engineering practices.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain database structures to support application development initiatives
  • Create, modify, and optimize complex SQL queries in high-volume, complex data environments
  • Perform data profiling, cleansing, transformation, and reporting activities
  • Develop and maintain ETL processes and data staging solutions
  • Write and manage DDL, DML, and DCL statements to support database operations
  • Troubleshoot performance issues and implement query tuning and optimization strategies
  • Support data migration, validation, and pipeline development within AWS environments
  • Develop automation scripts using Python to support database and data processing tasks
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and clients to design data solutions within technical and business constraints
  • Utilize version control tools (e.g., Git) to manage code and database changes
  • Monitor and support system performance using tools such as CloudWatch, Kibana, and Dynatrace
  • Continuously evaluate and adopt new tools and technologies to improve data solutions

Education And Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field
  • 5+ years of experience in database development roles

Required Skills

  • Strong experience with: Data profiling, cleansing, and ETL processes, writing and optimizing complex SQL queries, query tuning and performance optimization, and database programming (DDL, DML, DCL).
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL database development
  • Experience developing Python scripts for automation or data processing
  • Experience with Git or other version control systems
  • Working knowledge of AWS services, including Data migration and validation, data pipelines, monitoring tools (CloudWatch, Kibana, Dynatrace).
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills
  • Ability to quickly learn new tools and technologies
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical teams and clients

Desired Skills

  • Experience with database administration (DBA) functions
  • Experience working in Agile environments and using tools such as Jira
  • Willingness and ability to learn DB2 if not currently proficient

Security Clearance

  • Willing and eligible to obtain a CBP public Trust.

Physical & Work Environment Requirements

Employees must be able to perform the essential functions of this position, with or without accommodation.

  • Ability to remain stationary for extended periods while working at a computer.
  • Frequently operate standard office equipment, including computers and telephones.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in person, by telephone, video conference, and email.
  • Occasionally move about the office and lift up to 20 pounds.
  • Ability to work the assigned schedule with regular and reliable attendance.
  • Ability to travel up to 10% as required.

Accora has grown into a company trusted by our clients for exceptional service, innovative solutions, and inspired employees. Accora Federal is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act and applicable law. descriptionHtml:
About Peregrine

Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA.

Our clients describe our support as "absolutely excellent" and our people as "instrumental to organization's success." Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair's Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership.

We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people.

As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become.

People first. Ownership always.

We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else.

At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk.

At Peregrine Advisors, you will own the data pipelines and databases behind a mission-critical federal enterprise data platform: their design, their performance and reliability, and the integrity of the data in them. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are.

This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination.

Your first project

Your first project will likely have you owning the extract, transform, and load (ETL) and extract, load, and transform (ELT) processes, logical and physical data models, physical data configurations, and the performance of that layer under real query volume. Depending on the assignment, you may:

  • Design and maintain databases that scale, in Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL-compatible), Amazon DynamoDB, and the platform's other data stores
  • Design the logical and physical data models, and build the schemas, indexes, views, stored procedures, and functions that implement them
  • Write and tune complex Structured Query Language (SQL), reading execution plans and adjusting indexes until high-volume queries hold up
  • Build and support extract, transform, and load (ETL) and extract, load, and transform (ELT) pipelines and Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3) loads that keep the data accurate and complete
  • Track down performance, locking, replication, and data consistency problems
  • Keep the databases available and recoverable through monitoring, capacity planning, backup and recovery, high availability, and disaster recovery
  • Secure them with least-privilege access, and keep them auditable
  • Work with architects, developers, and data engineers, and move database changes through continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) and infrastructure as code

You deliver a database layer analysts and systems can trust at scale. You automate the data-integration and load patterns that would otherwise be hand-run, and you build the access controls that keep a governed platform governed.

This is where you start, not the shape of your career here.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of hands-on data engineering, database development, database engineering, software development, or comparable practical experience in support of enterprise applications
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Expertise in Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL-compatible), covering schema design, stored procedures and functions, indexing, and execution-plan analysis
  • Experience with Amazon DynamoDB, covering data modeling, partition and key design, and Global and Local Secondary Indexes (GSIs and LSIs)
  • Advanced SQL skills across complex queries, views, stored procedures, and functions, together with relational design, normalization, and data modeling
  • Performance and query tuning that resolves slow queries, locking, and deadlocks through indexing and execution-plan work
  • ETL and ELT development and data integration across Amazon Web Services (AWS) data services, such as Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS), S3, and data migration services
  • Data security controls such as encryption, access management, auditing, and compliance
  • Support for cloud-native applications in AWS through CI/CD and development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) practices, including monitoring, backup and recovery, high availability, and disaster recovery
  • Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel

Preferred

  • An AWS certification at the level of Database Specialty, Developer Associate, or Solutions Architect

Overview

SCCI is seeking a mid-level Database Developer to join our team! In this position you will support the design and implementation of a cohesive enterprise data ontology across a diverse portfolio of projects and systems. This role is central to transforming fragmented and unstructured data into a unified, well-modeled data ecosystem that supports analytics, interoperability, and long-term scalability. If you have strong database design expertise to support relating data across systems join our team and work closely with architects, data engineers, and domain stakeholders to define consistent data structures, normalize and map disparate datasets, and contribute to a shared enterprise data vision. This position is located in Dahlgren, VA.

SCCI offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including Health, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability benefits, 401k with Company Match, time off consisting of 2 weeks of paid vacation, 48 hours of sick/personal leave, and 11 paid Holidays.

Responsibilities

  • Database Design & Modeling
    • Design, implement, and maintain relational and non-relational database schemas aligned with enterprise data standards
    • Develop logical and physical data models that support scalability, performance, and maintainability
    • Normalize and optimize table structures while balancing performance considerations
  • Enterprise Data Ontology Development
    • Contribute to the definition and evolution of an enterprise-wide data architecture
    • Map data elements across systems into a unified conceptual model
    • Define relationships, hierarchies, and semantic consistency across datasets
    • Collaborate with stakeholders to standardize naming conventions and data definitions
  • Structured & Unstructured Data Integration
    • Analyze unstructured and semi-structured data (JSON, logs, documents, etc.) and design strategies to structure and integrate it
    • Develop transformation pipelines to align disparate data sources into cohesive schemas
    • Support metadata tagging and classification efforts
  • Data Transformation & ETL Support
    • Build and maintain a pipeline to extract, transform, load (ETL/ELT) and cleanse data
    • Ensure data integrity, consistency, and traceability across systems
    • Support data lineage and auditability requirements
  • Cross-System Data Alignment
    • Work across multiple project teams to reconcile differences in data structures and definitions
    • Identify duplication, inconsistency, and gaps in existing data models
    • Propose and implement standardized solutions
  • Performance & Optimization
    • Tune queries, indexes, and database configurations for performance and efficiency
    • Monitor database health and implement improvements as needed
  • Documentation & Governance
    • Maintain clear documentation of schemas, data models, and ontology mappings
    • Support data governance initiatives, including data quality standards and validation rules
    • Contribute to best practices and development standards
Qualifications

Essential Skills and Experience:

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen and be able to obtain and maintain an active Secret Security Clearance
  • Bachelor's (BS) Degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or Math; Or five (5) years technical experience with information management in lieu of degree
  • Three (3) - Six (6) years of experience in database development
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and relational database design (e.g., PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL)
  • Experience designing normalized schemas and understanding tradeoffs with denormalization
  • Familiarity with handling semi-structured/unstructured data (e.g., JSON, XML, document stores)
  • Experience with ETL/ELT processes and data transformation pipelines
  • Solid understanding of data modeling concepts (ER diagrams, dimensional modeling, etc.)
  • Ability to translate business/domain concepts into structured data representations

Preferred Skills And Experience

  • Active Secret Security Clearance
  • Experience contributing to or working with data ontologies, semantic models, or knowledge graphs
  • Familiarity with data cataloging, metadata management, or data governance tools
  • Exposure to NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cassandra, etc.) and hybrid data architectures
  • Experience with cloud data platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Experience with Docker containerization
  • Knowledge of data lineage, data quality frameworks, and master data management (MDM)
  • Basic scripting or programming skills (Python, Bash Script, etc.) for data processing

descriptionHtml:
About the job

About ACB

The Advertising Checking Bureau (ACB) has been a trusted partner in channel marketing for over 100 years, managing reward programs for 200+ leading brands across Co-op Advertising, MDF Programs, Consumer Rebates, and Channel Spiff Programs. Our U.S.-based team combines deep industry expertise with a genuine commitment to getting it right — for our clients, our data, and each other.

We're a mid-sized company where your work is visible, your impact is real, and the problems you solve actually matter to the business.


The Role

We're looking for a Senior SQL Developer who is as comfortable digging into a complex data problem as they are thinking about where data infrastructure needs to go next. This is a hands-on role with real influence — you won't just be maintaining what exists, you'll be helping shape what comes next.

This role is hybrid, you could be based out of our Tempe, AZ or Memphis, TN office.


What You'll Actually Be Doing Day to Day

Most of your time will be spent working directly in SQL Server — writing and tuning complex T-SQL, building and maintaining stored procedures, and keeping our data pipelines running cleanly and accurately. You'll work closely with the IT, operations, and data teams to translate business needs into reliable, well-documented SQL solutions.

Beyond day-to-day execution, you'll have a meaningful role in helping us modernize. We have a significant amount of legacy infrastructure built up over decades of client-driven development — SSIS packages, manual workflows, and processes that were built for a different era. We're actively working to reduce that technical debt, and we need someone who can help us think through what better looks like, not just maintain what exists.

Specifically, you can expect to:

  • Write and optimize complex T-SQL — stored procedures, functions, and queries against large, complex datasets
  • Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines, including existing SSIS packages and newer approaches as we modernize
  • Develop and maintain SSRS reports and support the transition toward modern BI tooling such as Power BI
  • Design and document database schemas, data models, and ERD diagrams
  • Identify and resolve data quality issues — accuracy, completeness, consistency
  • Convert legacy manual processes into automated, auditable SQL solutions
  • Collaborate across IT, operations, and client teams to understand requirements and deliver solutions
  • Contribute to the creation, review and update of data governance standards and participate in enforcing the same
  • Help evaluate and introduce modern SQL Server capabilities that ACB hasn't yet explored


What You Bring

Required:

  • 5+ years of professional SQL development experience in production environments
  • Deep T-SQL expertise — complex queries, stored procedures, performance tuning, large datasets
  • The ability to translate non-technical business needs into technical data solutions
  • Solid understanding of relational database design, data modeling, and ERD
  • Experience with ETL/ELT operations and data pipeline development
  • Familiarity with SSIS and SSRS — and an opinion about where things are heading
  • Strong communication skills — you can explain data problems to non-technical stakeholders clearly
  • Attention to detail and a genuine commitment to data accuracy
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift and you manage your own time effectively

Preferred:

  • Experience with modern BI tools — Power BI, Tableau, or similar
  • An understanding of CDC and how to best implement it
  • Familiarity with ELT patterns and cloud data concepts (data lakes, Azure, etc.)
  • Exposure to version control (Git) and agile workflows
  • Microsoft SQL Server or Azure certifications
  • Background in financial systems, incentive programs, channel marketing, or advertising
  • An interest in — or experience with — evaluating newer SQL Server features and guiding teams toward better patterns


Why ACB

  • Real impact. In a team of ~30 IT professionals supporting a $6B+ business, your contributions are visible and valued.
  • Hybrid flexibility. 2-3 days in office per week in Tempe or Memphis. The rest is yours to manage.
  • A company that's investing. We pay competitively for senior talent. We know what good costs, and we're committed to it.
  • Interesting problems. Decades of client-driven development means there is genuinely meaningful modernization work to be done — the kind that requires experience, judgment, and someone who cares about doing it right.
  • Stable foundation. Over 100 years in business, a loyal client base, and a team that tends to stay. If you want a place where you can plant a flag and build something, this is it.

The Sr Analyst Application Services/Technical is a high-level individual contributor in the Application Services area of the Information Services (I/S) department. This position leads, modifies, configures, tests, implements, and maintains third-party computer application software and/or designs and develops specialized fit-to-purpose programs utilizing Company standards and practices. The position analyzes business needs, translates needs into requirements, and develops or recommends software solutions with the aim of optimizing operational efficiency. This position also supports business operations by providing guidance, training, and system support while continuously analyzing current business processes against related policies and procedures to promote technology innovations aimed to maximize productivity and standardization across the organization. This position performs work with a high degree of latitude and independently at times and handles the most complex issues and problems using advanced theories, methods, and techniques to complete work. Provides leadership, coaching, and/or mentoring to Analyst I/Application Services and Analyst II/Application Services.
POSITION DIMENSIONS
The incumbent does not have accountability for budgets but may have accountability for direct reports. The incumbent frequently exchanges information with senior management, Information Services support staff, vendors, and consultants.
QUALIFICATIONS

There are clear precedents and practices which the incumbent uses to determine how this job is
performed. Possesses expert technical knowledge of subject matter. Requires four to six years of
relevant work experience and a bachelor’s degree in a related field from an accredited university, or
equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential
job responsibilities.

Competencies required: Ability to work as part of a team; Problem management; Problem-solving
skills; Analytical thinking skills; Technical expertise; Debugging skills; Computer skills; Detail
oriented; Ability to meet deadlines; Project management skills; In-depth experience with two or more
programming languages or frameworks.

Industry recognized certification(s) relevant to responsibilities are preferred. Incumbents performing
activities requiring government, regulatory or vendor certification must keep those certifications
current.
ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES
- Design, develop and maintain front end GUI screens for a custom application using Oracle Fusion Middleware Development Tools. Proficiency and experience with Oracle Forms and Oracle Reports is required for this position.
- Design and maintain Oracle RDBMS and related objects (tables, views, stored procedures, triggers, packages).
- Design, develop and maintain complex PL/SQL code within procedures, functions, packages, triggers.
- Design, develop and debug complex SQL queries including dynamic SQL.
- Participate in established software system testing and validation procedures and documentation.
- Plan, design, and conduct appropriate levels of application or infrastructure testing, including preparation of test plans, scripts, data, and expected results.
- Support production environment by troubleshooting issues and working rapidly to provide a workaround or resolution to the stated issue.
- Consult with business support group and application users to understand business requirements and translate those concepts into a formal technical design.
- Select and utilize appropriate troubleshooting approaches to address customer specific issues in a comprehensive and useful manner, display a broad grasp of the relevant technical concepts, and incorporate these concepts into pragmatic solutions for customers.
- Take part in peer code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards, security and compliance rules.
- Work within the constructs of the Software Development Life Cycles (SDLC) and/or Agile/Scrum philosophy.
- Troubleshoot, debug, and fix performance bottlenecks in application database queries, application GUI screen, packages or procedures.
- Work with project management and/or business area personnel to determine functional needs and identify technical application requirements, including requirements for security, recovery and integration with related applications.
- Participate in the analysis and prioritization of system enhancements and upgrades and ensure appropriate coordination and communication.
- Confer with other teams such as system architects, middleware analysts to design systems and perform tasks related to enhancements, performance and security.
- Work closely with DBAs and infrastructure teams to ensure system stability and scalability.
- Support modernization initiatives.
- Implement proper application software version control related tasks.
- Work independently or in a team construct to produce results in timely and efficient manner.

descriptionHtml:
Why This Role Matters

The Senior Database Engineer at Bluestaq owns the data systems that move and protect information behind national security decisions — the schemas, pipelines, and datastores our enterprise platform runs on. This is not a ticket-closing seat. You are the go-to engineer for a data domain: you design the schemas, tune the queries that are actually slow, keep the pipelines healthy, and lead the medium-sized data work from requirements through production. You operate independently, call out risk before it becomes an outage, and set the bar for the engineers around you.

What You Own

  • Own sets of tables, schemas, and data flows end-to-end within a larger product or program — including their data quality, performance, and operability over time.
  • Design robust relational schemas and data models with sound normalization and denormalization tradeoffs, DDL, and extensive SQL.
  • Work across SQL and NoSQL datastores (MongoDB, Postgres/RDS, Amazon Athena) following best practices, and represent practical DB constraints in data modeling discussions.
  • Lead the design and delivery of medium-sized data features — new domains, new ingest, or significant schema changes.
  • Build moderately complex ETL/ingest pipelines with incremental loads, error handling, and validation.
  • Investigate and fix non-trivial performance problems — bad query plans, missing indexes, partitioning, table bloat — and tune queries, indexes, and configurations for real workloads.
  • Apply database-level security controls — row-level security (e.g., Postgres RLS), roles and permissions, and auditing patterns — to protect sensitive data.
  • Plan and execute database upgrades, patches, and migrations with minimal disruption to dependent systems.
  • Serve as the escalation point for Associate and mid-level engineers on data correctness and performance, and mentor through code review and by explaining design choices.
  • Partner with Software Engineering, Data Modeling, Systems, and Cyber to align data design, performance, and access patterns with mission needs.
  • Keep database and process documentation current — schema and data-flow diagrams, runbooks, and how-to guides for operating and querying key datasets.

What You Bring

Required Education & Experience

  • High School Diploma/GED and 8+ years of relevant experience, OR
  • Associate degree in a related field and 6+ years of relevant experience, OR
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field and 4+ years of relevant experience, OR
  • Master's degree in a related field and 2+ years of relevant experience

Must-Haves

  • Relational database mastery — production experience designing, tuning, and operating one or more of Postgres, MySQL, Oracle, or SQL Server.
  • NoSQL / large-scale stores — hands-on work with MongoDB, Athena, or equivalent, and sound judgment on when to use them.
  • Schema and data modeling — designing normalized and denormalized structures that hold up under real-world query and storage conditions.
  • Performance engineering — diagnosing bad plans and bottlenecks, and applying indexing, partitioning, and query rewrites that stick.
  • ETL / ingest pipelines — building moderately complex loads with incremental processing, error handling, and validation.
  • Database security — row-level security, roles and permissions, and auditing patterns applied in production.
  • Backup, recovery, and disaster recovery — you know the plan and have exercised it.
  • Linux environments and scripting / automation — PowerShell, Bash, Python, and SQL.
  • SQL depth — Common Table Expressions, dynamic SQL, and the ability to reason about complex queries.
  • Independent delivery — you scope the work, choose the approach, surface risk, and drive it from design through rollout without being managed through it.
  • Mentorship and communication — you raise the bar through code review and clear technical writing for peers, leadership, and cross-functional teams.
  • Ownership mentality — you follow through, document your work, check downstream impact, and know when to persevere vs. ask for help.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Relevant certifications (e.g., DBA certifications).
  • Cloud platforms — AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Containerization — Docker, Kubernetes.
  • Schema automation / migration tooling — Liquibase, Flyway.
  • Monitoring and observability — Splunk or equivalent.
  • DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines.

Salary Range (US): $115,000 USD - $140,000 USD

Clearance Requirement: This position may require an active TS/SCI Clearance. Current clearance holders are strongly encouraged to apply. If you don't currently hold one, Bluestaq will sponsor eligible candidates through the clearance process based on program needs.

Relocation: Relocation assistance is available for full-time positions.

About Bluestaq

At Bluestaq, we build secure data platforms that matter for space missions, national defense, healthcare systems, and commercial innovation. Founded in 2018, we've become a leader in enterprise software and secure data management by staying focused on what counts: modern architecture, operational excellence, and mission impact.

We're engineers, problem-solvers, and builders who take the mission seriously, but not ourselves. We automate the repeatable, question the status quo, and design systems that are as reliable as they are scalable. Whether we're supporting space, defense systems, or healthcare advancements, we build with the same principles: cloud-native solutions, security by design, and relentless simplicity.

What We Offer:

For full-time positions

  • 100% employer-paid health, dental, and vision for you and your dependents
  • Up to 6% match to 401(k) contributions with additional discretionary 4% profit share on day one. Roth options available; no vesting period.
  • Every role is eligible for an annual performance bonus
  • $200,000 employer-paid life insurance, plus short- and long-term disability coverage
  • $5,000 annual professional development budget per employee
  • 20 days PTO, plus 8 paid holidays
  • Pet insurance, onsite gym, and flexible schedule

Bluestaq is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees on the basis age 40 and over, color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, military or veteran status, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by state or local law.

Bluestaq will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities and employees whose work requirements interfere with a religious belief unless doing so would result in an undue hardship to Bluestaq or a direct threat. Employees needing such accommodation are instructed to contact Human Resources immediately at contact.us@bluestaq.com.

Applications will be accepted for 60 days beyond the posting date, or until the position is filled, whichever comes first.

- Lead the design and delivery of medium-sized data features — new domains, new ingest, or significant schema changes. 
- Build moderately complex ETL/ingest pipelines with incremental loads, error handling, and validation. 
- Investigate and fix non-trivial performance problems — bad query plans, missing indexes, partitioning, table bloat — and tune queries, indexes, and configurations for real workloads. 
- Apply database-level security controls — row-level security (e.g., Postgres RLS), roles and permissions, and auditing patterns — to protect sensitive data. 
- Plan and execute database upgrades, patches, and migrations with minimal disruption to dependent systems. 
- Serve as the escalation point for Associate and mid-level engineers on data correctness and performance, and mentor through code review and by explaining design choices. 
- Partner with Software Engineering, Data Modeling, Systems, and Cyber to align data design, performance, and access patterns with mission needs. 
- Keep database and process documentation current — schema and data-flow diagrams, runbooks, and how-to guides for operating and querying key datasets.

Required Education & Experience



- High School Diploma/GED and 8+ years of relevant experience, OR 
- Associate degree in a related field and 6+ years of relevant experience, OR 
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field and 4+ years of relevant experience, OR 
- Master's degree in a related field and 2+ years of relevant experience 

Must-Haves

- Schema and data modeling — designing normalized and denormalized structures that hold up under real-world query and storage conditions.

Description

SAIC is hiring a COMSEC Database Management Engineer in Springfield, VA to own the data behind cryptographic accountability for a global federal mission. The COMSEC Material Control System is an authoritative record of what cryptographic material exists, who holds it, where it moved, and when it was destroyed. You will keep that system running today and design, build, and deploy its replacement.

The role runs on two tracks on purpose. Accountability does not pause for modernization, and the hardest part of the new build is not the new schema — it is understanding what is in the legacy record well enough to carry it forward without losing a transaction. You will do both, which is why this job develops a skill set the market is short of.

What You Will Do

  • Operate the current CMCS database and application in production — availability, backup and recovery, performance tuning, patching, and release deployment.
  • Design the Next-Generation CMCS data model inventory, accounts, custodian and hand receipt chains, chain-of-custody history, destruction records, and access authorizations.
  • Build a tiered architecture that separates data by classification and by audience, with access enforced at the row level in the database rather than only in the application.
  • Implement an append-only audit architecture where every accountability event carries actor, timestamp, and source, and corrections are new entries rather than overwrites.
  • Develop database services and APIs, managed through version control, peer review, and versioned schema migrations in a CI pipeline.
  • Integrate CMCS with the systems that generate COMSEC events, including Key Management Infrastructure and federal access management systems supporting personnel onboarding and offboarding.
  • Migrate the legacy record — profile it, design the transformation rules, and prove record count, balance, and transaction history parity through automated reconciliation before cutover.
  • Provide Tier II and Tier III application support, resolving data errors, failed transactions, and reported discrepancies.

Why This Role This is a system of record being rebuilt, not a maintenance seat. You will make the data architecture decisions, then live with them through migration and into production — and few engineers anywhere combine modern data platform skill with real cryptographic accountability depth. There is a defined path toward Senior Database Engineer, CMCS Solution Architect, and engineering leadership.

Qualifications

Required Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline and 9 years of experience; Masters and 7 years; 4 additional years of relevant experience may substitute for the degree.
  • 5 years of database engineering or development experience.
  • Proven relational data modeling for transactional systems of record — normalization, referential integrity, constraint design, and audit trail architecture.
  • Production DBA experience on an enterprise platform (Oracle, SQL Server, or PostgreSQL) backup and recovery, performance tuning, index and query optimization, high availability.
  • Advanced SQL and stored procedure development, plus one general-purpose language for data services and automation.
  • Experience building system-to-system interfaces — API, message-based, or ETL — with real error handling and reconciliation.
  • Hands-on legacy data migration experience profiling, transformation design, and proving the migration was complete and accurate.
  • Working knowledge of federal database security requirements — access control, encryption, audit logging, and the evidence an Assessment and Authorization needs.

Required Clearance

  • US Citizenship.
  • Active top secret clearance with SCI eligibility.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with CMCS, KMI, or another cryptographic accountability system.
  • Experience building systems that must produce defensible audit evidence under external inspection — property, custody, controlled substances, or financial accountability all count.
  • Multi-level or compartmented data architectures where classification or need-to-know is enforced in the data tier.
  • Near real-time dashboards and reporting against a transactional system without degrading transaction performance.
  • Familiarity with COMSEC accountability concepts CCI handling, hand receipts, SF-153 transfers, inventory reconciliation, destruction reporting.
  • Agile delivery with JIRA and CI pipelines in a federal accredited environment; ServiceNow ITSM and CMDB.

Target salary range $140,001 - $180,000. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

As a Development Database Administrator, you’ll build database solutions that help complex digital products respond quickly and reliably.

The Sports Platform and PAM & MarTech teams within our Technology department develop low-latency data and database solutions for our website, app, member, and regulatory platforms. As a Development Database Administrator, you’ll develop database code, provide architectural guidance, and help improve the quality of database delivery across our products.

SQL Server supports the current platform, while Google Spanner and Kafka underpin newer services. You’ll translate product requirements into practical, well-performing solutions across complex, high-concurrency systems processing more than 1,000 transactions each second. This is a software development role focused on building, testing, tuning, and maintaining database systems at scale.

This role is included in our hybrid work from home policy.

  • Hands-on experience with managed databases, including Google Spanner, Cosmos DB, or DynamoDB

  • Demonstrated experience developing database solutions for high-concurrency, high-throughput environments
  • Proven ability to monitor, tune, and troubleshoot database performance
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and deliverables independently
  • Methodical approach to resolving complex database and performance issues

  • Translate product requirements into practical solutions with development and testing teams

descriptionHtml:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

We're looking for experienced engineers to build and scale the database infrastructure that powers Claude's products and Anthropic's research. As a Software Engineer on the Databases team, you'll architect and operate the systems that let millions of users interact with Claude while also supporting frontier AI research workloads.

You'll help set the database strategy for Anthropic: designing systems that handle billions of API requests, building storage that runs cleanly across GCP, AWS, and a range of deployment models, and creating the reliable data layer that lets research move fast.

The Databases team spans three areas: the core database platform (data plane and control plane), data movement (migrations, backfill, and change data capture), and caching. We're hiring across all three.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive the technical direction for database solutions used across Product and Research
  • Design and implement database solutions that scale to support millions of users across Claude's product ecosystem
  • Build and scale database systems through 100x+ growth while maintaining reliability and performance
  • Build the database platform that lets Anthropic engineers ship without thinking about databases or scaling.
  • Architect data storage solutions that operate across GCP, AWS, first-party deployments, third-party deployments, and other environments
  • Develop database infrastructure that serves both product and research workloads with different performance characteristics
  • Build data movement infrastructure (migration tooling, backfill, and change data capture pipelines) that safely consolidates and moves data across the organization
  • Design and operate caching infrastructure, including CDC-driven cache invalidation, that keeps Anthropic's hottest paths fast and correct
  • Partner with product and research teams to understand data requirements and build infrastructure that accelerates their work
  • Optimize database performance, reliability, and cost efficiency at scale
  • Make build-vs-buy decisions for database technologies

Minimum Qualifications

  • Significant experience as a software engineer building and operating production database or storage systems
  • Deep knowledge of distributed database architectures and OLTP systems at scale
  • Proficiency with SQL and at least one major relational or distributed database engine (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, Spanner, CockroachDB, DynamoDB)
  • Track record of leading large, complex infrastructure projects as an engineer or tech lead
  • Ability to balance moving quickly with the reliability needs of production systems
  • Strong technical leadership and cross-functional collaboration skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • 10+ years building and scaling database systems, with 3+ years leading large-scale projects or teams
  • Experience scaling databases through periods of rapid growth at high-growth companies
  • Experience operating Spanner, CockroachDB, TiDB, AlloyDB, or other globally distributed SQL databases in production
  • Experience with Redis, Temporal, vector databases, or async job processing frameworks
  • Experience with change data capture (Debezium or similar), large-scale data migration, or streaming data infrastructure
  • Experience building multi-cloud or hybrid cloud database solutions
  • Knowledge of database orchestration and automation at scale
  • Contributions to database internals, storage engines, or related open source projects

Note: Prior AI/ML infrastructure experience is not required. We value deep infrastructure and database expertise from any domain.

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$320,000—$485,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

descriptionHtml:
APPLICANTS MUST BE PERMANENT IN THE COMPUTER ASSOCIATE SOFTWARE CIVIL SERVICE TITLE

The HIV/AIDS Services Administration (HASA) is the most comprehensive program of its kind in the country, helping New Yorkers living with HIV or AIDS live healthier and more independent lives. We assist with an individualized service plan that targets the support and necessary benefits that are specific to a client’s medical situation that will enhance his or her well-being. In addition, this Agency has a legal mandate, based on Local Law 49 and the Henrietta D. versus Giuliani Federal court case, to ensure that HASA clients are serviced promptly.

HASA provides intensive case management, rental assistance, emergency and non-emergency housing, and assistance with applying for public benefits and services including Medicaid, food stamps and cash assistance. HASA also provides vocational services that prepare clients for work. With counselors to help identify barriers to employment, clients can select vocational goals and receive support. Other HASA services include home care and homemaking services, mental health and substance use screening and treatment referrals, transportation assistance,

referrals to community-based organizations, and SSI or SSD application and appeal.

The HIV/AIDS Services Administration (HASA) is recruiting for one (1) Computer Associate (Software) II to function as a Database Application Developer/Report Designer, who will:

Under the general supervision of the Applications Development Manager, with considerable latitude for independent initiative and judgment for deriving solutions to all issues and concerns within Information Technology, database developer/ report designer will be responsible for the development, design and enhancement of info-structures, implementation, and support of program specific software.

  • Design and deploy reports using Microsoft SQL Server Reporting Services. Creates reports for case management, eligibility operations, finance, personnel, housing, and contracts units connecting to database applications in Oracle and MS SQL Server.
  • Coordinate design, development and implementation of HASA database Applications and maintains existing Databases applications, designs, develops and implementing new programs using SQL Server 2016 and above utilizing tables, views, stored procedure, and SSIS packages in SQL Server 2016.
  • Analyze and enhance existing quality assurance and other statistical and periodic reports and create new reports based on analysis and recommendations using all available resources such as Oracle, Electronic Data warehouse (EDW), in house SQL Server Applications and flat files received through file transfer protocol (sftp) from outside HASA.
  • Coordinate the design and planning stages of electronic forms (E-Forms) with Policy and Procedures unit. Maintains and update the design of all web-based E-forms.
  • Communicate with operational staff to know their requirements and feedback and ensuring that these are fully conveyed to programming and web development team, recommending changes to web application and database design.
  • Provide technical support to users and program vendors in the use of web-based application HASAWeb by resolving issues, maintaining security module, adding removing users, codes, roles and coordinating with other HASA staff and/or HRA-ITS.
  • Create ad-hoc reports based on management requests using all available data sources such as Oracle, SQL Server 2016 databases, flat text files.
  • Coordinate the Single Room Occupancy (SRO) billing process, acting as single point source by creating necessary exception reports for contract, creating, uploading, and downloading files to and from HRA ftp servers, requesting updates to central database application.

Hours/Schedule: 9:00a- 5:00p

COMPUTER ASSOC (SOFTWARE) - 13631

Minimum Qualifications

  • A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college including or supplemented by 24 semester credits in computer science or a related computer field and one year of satisfactory full-time computer software experience in computer systems development and analysis, applications programming, database administration, maintenance and support, systems programming, data communications, mainframe development, mobile development, web development and design; or
  • A four-year high school diploma or its educational equivalent and five years of satisfactory full-time computer software experience as described in "1" above; or
  • Education and or/or experience equivalent to "1" or "2" above. College education may be substituted for up to two years of the required experience in "2" above on the basis that 60 semester credits from an accredited college is equated to one year of experience. In addition, 24 semester credits from an accredited college or graduate school in computer science or a related field, or a certificate of at least 625 hours in computer programming from an accredited technical school (post high school), may be substituted for one year of experience. However, all candidates must have at least a four-year high school diploma or its educational equivalent and at least one year of satisfactory full-time experience as described in "1" above.

55a Program

This position is also open to qualified persons with a disability who are eligible for the 55-a Program. Please indicate at the top of your resume and cover letter that you would like to be considered for the position through the 55-a Program.

Public Service Loan Forgiveness

As a prospective employee of the City of New York, you may be eligible for federal loan forgiveness programs and state repayment assistance programs. For more information, please visit the U.S. Department of Education’s website at https://studentaid.gov/pslf/.

Residency Requirement

New York City Residency is not required for this position

Additional Information

The City of New York is an inclusive equal opportunity employer committed to recruiting and retaining a diverse workforce and providing a work environment that is free from discrimination and harassment based upon any legally protected status or protected characteristic, including but not limited to an individual's sex, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, gender identity, or pregnancy.

Job Description

At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

Database Engineer - Mid Level

Why This is an Exciting Role:

As a Database Engineer - Mid Level at Boeing Intelligence & Analytics (BI&A), you will be required to:


  • Contribute to cutting edge development programs and designing new solutions
  • Innovate RF signal processing applications
  • Provides technical expertise for database design, development, implementation, information storage and retrieval, data flow and analysis
  • Develop relational and/or Object-Oriented databases, database parser software, and database loading software
  • Project long-range requirements for database administration and design
  • Develop a database structure that fits into the overall architecture of the system under development and has to make trades among data volumes, number of users, logical and physical distribution, response times, retention rules, security and domain controls
  • Develop requirements from a project’s inception to its conclusion for a particular business and Information Technology (IT) subject matter area (i.e., simple to complex systems)
  • Assist with recommendations for, and analysis and evaluation of systems improvements, optimization, development, and/or maintenance efforts
  • Translate a set of requirements and data into a usable document by creating or recreating ad hoc queries, scripts, and macros; updates existing queries, creates new ones to manipulate data into a master file; and builds complex systems using queries, tables, Open Database Connectivity and database storage and retrieval using Cloud methodologies


What Makes BI&A Different:

As a fully owned subsidiary of The Boeing Company, BI&A offers an optimal mix of a small company environment with exceptional opportunities supported by a large corporation.

Every day, Boeing Intelligence & Analytics supports global missions by building and delivering intelligence, analytics, and cyber solutions that enable users to advance national security. From hardware and software engineering solutions to analytics that keep this nation safe, we create value that meets users’ needs. With vibrant partnerships and innovative approaches, we serve the Intelligence Community through innovation and vision. We have provided our customers with the tools needed to counter evolve global and cyber threats, and to improve wartime decision-making.


  • Our talented employees bring software development, systems engineering, and advanced analytics expertise.
  • We offer numerous prime contract opportunities with customers headquartered in Maryland, Virginia, and the District of Columbia, as well as subcontract opportunities that align with our areas of focus and additional opportunities nationwide through our parent company.
  • We have current open positions on awarded programs across diverse customer sets and are anticipating upcoming contract awards with a 5-year life cycle and an additional 5 option years.
  • Our diverse portfolio allows our employees to move to other projects and teams as they gain further proficiency in their current skill set and learn new skill sets along the way.
  • We offer hands-on access to cutting-edge technologies and a culture of technical excellence.


Experience and Qualifications:

To be eligible for this demanding position, the ideal candidate should demonstrate the following experience and qualifications:

Required Education and Years of Experience:


  • Five (5) years experience as a DBE in programs and contracts of similar scope, type, and complexity is required.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline from an accredited college or university
  • Four (4) years of additional DBE experience may be substituted for a Bachelor’s degree


Required Qualifications:


  • Active TS/SCI with Polygraph Clearance
  • Experience developing requirement recommendations from a project’s inception to its conclusion for a particular Business and IT subject matter area (i.e. simple to complex systems)
  • Experience developing long and short-term requirements for database administration and design


Telework/Remote Availability: Telework/Remote work currently not authorized

Work Location(s): Annapolis Junction, MD

Summary Pay Range:

Please note that the information shown below is a general guideline only. Pay is based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

$122,000 - $167,000

Application Privacy Policy: This notice pertains to the collection and processing of personal information of applicants to The Boeing Company and its group of companies (“Boeing”), worldwide.

To review Boeing’s Privacy Policy, copy and paste this link into a new tab and following the URL:

https://www.boeing.com/careers/privacy-statement

BI&A is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race,color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Equal Employment Opportunity is the Law (PDF)

Equal Opportunity Employer:

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not accept unlawful discrimination in our recruitment or employment practices on any grounds including but not limited to; race, color, ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military and veteran status, or other characteristics covered by applicable law.

We have teams in more than 65 countries, and each person plays a role in helping us become one of the world’s most innovative, diverse and inclusive companies. We are proud members of the Valuable 500 and welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. Applicants are encouraged to share with our recruitment team any accommodations required during the recruitment process. Accommodations may include but are not limited to: conducting interviews in accessible locations that accommodate mobility needs, encouraging candidates to bring and use any existing assistive technology such as screen readers and offering flexible interview formats such as virtual or phone interviews.

Solerity is seeking a Mid-Level Software and Database Developer to support IGC software-development, application-modernization, and database-development activities. The selected candidate will develop, integrate, test, and maintain secure application and database components supporting global transportation and logistics operations, with emphasis on SQL development, relational database design, application-to-database integration, performance tuning, and database modernization support.

  • Develop, enhance, test, deploy, and maintain enterprise application and database components, including RESTful APIs, microservices, and system integrations.
  • Develop and optimize complex SQL queries, schemas, tables, views, indexes, functions, stored procedures, and database scripts.
  • Create and maintain logical and physical data models supporting application, reporting, analytics, and integration requirements.
  • Troubleshoot application-to-database connectivity, data-quality, query-performance, and integration issues; perform query tuning, indexing, and execution-plan analysis.
  • Develop repeatable scripts and processes for data loading, transformation, validation, deployment, and environment support.
  • Support database modernization by modifying database objects, SQL, application queries, and data-access components for approved target platforms, including Amazon Aurora where implemented.
  • Support schema conversion, data-type mapping, query remediation, data validation, reconciliation, and compatibility testing under senior database or migration engineering direction.
  • Use Git and established GitLab CI/CD pipelines to build, test, validate, and deploy application and database changes in accordance with approved release processes.
  • Apply secure coding and database-security practices and support applicable DoD cybersecurity, RMF, software-assurance, and STIG requirements.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, code and database-design reviews, sprint demonstrations, testing, release activities, and technical documentation.

Requirements

  • Secret Clearance Required
  • Four or more years of professional software-development, database-development, or closely related technical experience.
  • Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Java, C#, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or comparable languages.
  • Experience developing RESTful APIs, web services, microservices, or enterprise applications.
  • Strong SQL development skills, including complex queries, joins, views, stored procedures, functions, indexes, and query optimization.
  • Experience with relational database design, data modeling, database integration, and application-to-database connectivity.
  • Experience with one or more enterprise relational database platforms such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Amazon Aurora/RDS, SQL Server, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience using Git and working within established CI/CD and software-release processes.
  • Understanding of Agile software development, automated testing, secure coding, DevSecOps, and continuous delivery practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience modernizing legacy application and database components for AWS or another approved cloud environment.
  • Experience supporting Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, Aurora MySQL, Amazon RDS, or comparable managed relational database services.
  • Familiarity with containerized application environments such as Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon ECS, or Amazon EKS.
  • Familiarity with Apache Superset or another business-intelligence platform from a database/data-layer perspective.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code or configuration-automation tools such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or Ansible.
  • Experience supporting Department of Defense, transportation, logistics, or other mission-critical enterprise systems.

Education

  • A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Data Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related software-engineering discipline; or
  • One of the following current certifications: Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP), CyberSec First Responder (CFR), Federal IT Security Professional–Manager (FITSP-M), GIAC Security Essentials Certification (GSEC), CompTIA Security+, or Systems Security Certified Practitioner (SSCP).

Benefits You'll Enjoy

  • Medical, dental and vision coverage
  • Health Savings Accounts and Flexible Spending Accounts for healthcare and dependent care
  • 401(k) and company-funded life insurance
  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Tuition and training assistance
  • Financial rewards for employee referrals.
  • Pet insurance
  • Employee discount program

Solerity is an equal opportunity employer as to all protected groups, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. Solerity is a VEVRAA Federal Contractor.

APPLY TODAY!
