Description

Columbia Technology Partners is seeking a Database Engineer 3 to provide technical expertise in database design, development, implementation, and administration for complex mission-focused systems. In this role, you will support the full database lifecycle, from requirements analysis and architecture design through implementation, testing, and deployment. You will develop scalable database solutions, optimize data flow and storage, and help ensure systems meet performance, security, and operational requirements. The ideal candidate is experienced in designing and managing enterprise database environments, developing data-driven solutions, and working within modern cloud-based architectures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, implement, and maintain database solutions supporting mission and enterprise systems.
  • Develop database schemas, structures, queries, scripts, macros, and data workflows to meet system and mission requirements.
  • Create and maintain database parser software and database loading applications to support data ingestion and processing.
  • Analyze existing database environments and recommend improvements for performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Lead the design and development of database architectures that balance data volume, user demand, response times, security requirements, retention policies, and system distribution.
  • Translate business and technical requirements into efficient database structures and data management solutions.
  • Support and direct database administration, data flow analysis, and database optimization efforts.
  • Guide the development of complex database solutions utilizing relational databases, ODBC connectivity, and cloud-based storage and retrieval technologies.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline from an accredited college or university.
  • Ten (10) years of experience as a Database Engineer supporting programs of similar scope, type, and complexity.
  • Five (5) years of additional Database Engineer experience may be substituted for a bachelor's degree.
  • Experience supporting database design, development, implementation, and administration in enterprise environments.

Desired Skills

  • Experience with relational database design, data modeling, and database architecture.
  • Strong SQL development skills, including complex queries, scripting, stored procedures, and database automation.
  • Experience with database performance tuning, optimization, and capacity planning.
  • Knowledge of cloud-based database technologies and modern data storage and retrieval methodologies.
  • Familiarity with ETL processes, data integration, and large-scale data management.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with software developers, systems engineers, and stakeholders throughout the system lifecycle.

Why Join CTP?

At Columbia Technology Partners, you'll join a team of talented engineers, analysts, and innovators working on mission-critical challenges that matter. We offer meaningful technical work, a collaborative and supportive culture, opportunities for continued professional growth, and a comprehensive benefits package. If you're looking for a place where your expertise can make an immediate impact while advancing your career, we'd love to hear from you.

Requirements

  • U.S. Citizenship is required for all applicants. CTP is an equal opportunity employer and abides by applicable employment laws and regulations. All applicants and employees are subject to random drug testing in accordance with Executive Order 12564. The Petaluma-based company in California’s beautiful Sonoma County was the first dairy in the United States to earn American Humane certification, and hold its partnership of local family-owned dairy farms to a higher standard by developing its own unique Clover Promise of Excellence. Clover Sonoma is proud to bring clean and delicious dairy products direct from its farms to consumers. A Certified B Corporation®, the company uses its business as a power to do good, and its passionate support of animal welfare, sustainable business practices, and local community have always been hallmarks of the business.

descriptionHtml:
As a purpose-driven, certified B corporation, Clover is leading the way for conscious businesses by demonstrating care for all stakeholders and moving the world forward. We are committed to lowering our environmental impact and meeting our sustainability targets, by providing kids and adults with healthy, nutritious, and delicious products that are made with care for animals, people, and the planet.

About The Role

The Database Engineer designs, builds, administers, and improves the data platforms that support Clover Sonoma's dairy manufacturing, warehousing, distribution, finance, sales, and reporting operations. The role is responsible to design, build, and support enterprise data pipelines from SAP S/4HANA in SAP RISE through SAP HANA Cloud and into an AWS Data Lake. This role will implement a Medallion Architecture—Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers—to deliver governed, reliable, and Power BI-ready datasets.

Working closely with IT, business leaders, application owners, implementation partners, and data and analytics teams, the Database Engineer translates operational needs into durable technical solutions. The position also helps strengthen master data integrity, production support, reporting accuracy, and business continuity across a time-sensitive food manufacturing and distribution environment.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, administer, monitor, and optimize relational databases and related data services supporting SAP and other business-critical applications.
  • Design and build secure data pipelines from SAP S/4HANA in RISE to SAP HANA Cloud and AWS.
  • Extract SAP data using approved technologies such as CDS Views, OData, ODP/ODQ, SLT, SDI/SDA, APIs, or SAP Datasphere.
  • Design SAP HANA Cloud schemas, calculation views, SQLScript procedures, data models, and replication processes.
  • Implement Bronze, Silver, and Gold data layers within the AWS Data Lake.
  • Build curated data models for Power BI reports, dashboards, and semantic models.
  • Develop and maintain reliable data pipelines, interfaces, and integrations between SAP and business systems such as warehouse, manufacturing, quality, payroll, CRM, sales, and business intelligence platforms.
  • Monitor database health, availability, job execution, storage, replication, and query performance; identify root causes and implement sustainable corrective actions.
  • Establish and maintain database backup, recovery, high-availability, disaster-recovery, retention, and archival practices consistent with business continuity requirements.
  • Apply role-based access, encryption, logging, change control, and other security practices to protect company, customer, employee, supplier, and operational data.
  • Partner with business and functional teams to improve the accuracy, completeness, consistency, and governance of item, material, vendor, customer, pricing, inventory, and other master data.
  • Support data migration, cleansing, validation, reconciliation, and cutover activities for SAP enhancements, acquisitions, system implementations, and process changes.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, including database architecture, data flows, interfaces, data dictionaries, operating procedures, recovery procedures, and support runbooks.
  • Provide responsive production support for database and integration incidents that may affect plant operations, warehousing, order fulfillment, transportation, financial processing, or customer service, including occasional after-hours support for critical events.
  • Evaluate database technologies, tools, and automation opportunities and recommend improvements that increase reliability, scalability, security, data quality, and team efficiency.
  • Follow company cybersecurity, data privacy, food safety, quality, change-management, and record-retention requirements while performing work in office, warehouse, and manufacturing environments.
  • Perform other duties and participate in cross-functional projects as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, data management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Five or more years of experience in database engineering, database administration, data engineering, or a closely related role supporting business-critical systems.
  • Hands-on production experience supporting SAP S/4HANA, SAP HANA, and RISE with SAP environments.
  • Hands-on experience designing, building, or administering an AWS cloud data lake, including practical experience with Amazon S3 and relevant AWS data services such as AWS Glue, AWS Lake Formation, Amazon Athena, Amazon Redshift, or comparable services.
  • Advanced SQL skills and experience with relational database design, performance tuning, indexing, query optimization, backup and recovery, and production troubleshooting.
  • Experience building or supporting integrations, ETL or ELT processes, APIs, batch jobs, and data exchanges across enterprise applications.
  • Working knowledge of database security, access controls, auditing, data protection, change management, and disaster recovery practices.
  • Ability to analyze complex technical and operational issues, identify root causes, communicate risks clearly, and coordinate resolution across technical and business teams.
  • Strong documentation, project management, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with internal teams, vendors, and consultants.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in food, beverage, dairy, consumer packaged goods, manufacturing, warehousing, or distribution operations.
  • Experience with SAP modules and data supporting materials management, production planning, sales and distribution, warehouse or inventory management, finance, controlling, and profitability analysis.
  • Experience with Microsoft SQL Server, Power BI, and complementary cloud, database, and analytics technologies.
  • Familiarity with manufacturing and operational platforms such as MES, warehouse management, transportation, quality, maintenance, or shop-floor systems.
  • Experience with data governance, master data management, data quality monitoring, metadata management, and reporting reconciliation.
  • SAP, Microsoft, database, cloud, or data engineering certification.
  • Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish.

Core Competencies

  • Technical depth and practical judgment
  • Data integrity and attention to detail
  • Operational urgency and dependable follow-through
  • Root-cause analysis and structured problem solving
  • Cross-functional collaboration and clear communication
  • Continuous improvement and disciplined change management

Work Environment And Physical Requirements

This role operates primarily in an office environment and regularly supports systems used in active dairy manufacturing, warehouse, and distribution facilities. The employee may occasionally enter production, cold-storage, warehouse, loading, or yard areas and must follow all required safety, food-safety, sanitation, security, and personal protective equipment rules. The role requires regular use of a computer and may require work outside normal business hours to support critical incidents, maintenance windows, upgrades, or implementations. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

What You Bring To The Team

  • Collaborative: Ability to build effective working relationships across Clover IT, Alpina, Kyndryl, and business teams, including across different cultures, time zones, and levels of technical expertise.
  • Accountable: A personal high-level of ownership of issues from diagnosis through resolution, ability to communicate progress clearly, and follow through reliably in a business-critical operating environment.
  • Analytical: Ability to approach complex data and systems problems methodically, identify root causes, and develop practical, sustainable solutions.
  • Adaptable: Ability to remain calm and effective when priorities shift, systems fail, or operational needs require urgent attention, while balancing immediate fixes with long-term improvements.

Based in Petaluma, California, in the heart of beautiful Sonoma County, Clover Sonoma offers high quality dairy sourced from its network of local family farms. A pioneer in sustainable dairy farming Clover has the largest organic acreage of regeneratively farmed land in the state and is committed to reducing its carbon footprint by lowering on-farm methane emissions, regenerative farming practices focused on soil health and packaging innovation. The first dairy in the US to become American Humane certified across all of its farms, Clover has delivered on its promise of producing the highest-quality dairy products — including milk, cheese, butter, and more — for more than a century.

As a Certified B Corporation® Clover gives back 5% of net profits to help make nutritious food more accessible and uses its business as a power for good across its support for people, farms, animals, community and planet.

For more information, please visit www.cloversonoma.com and join the conversation on Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, and YouTube.

The role is responsible to design, build, and support enterprise data pipelines from SAP S/4HANA in SAP RISE through SAP HANA Cloud and into an AWS Data Lake. This role will implement a Medallion Architecture—Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers—to deliver governed, reliable, and Power BI-ready datasets.

Working closely with IT, business leaders, application owners, implementation partners, and data and analytics teams, the Database Engineer translates operational needs into durable technical solutions. The position also helps strengthen master data integrity, production support, reporting accuracy, and business continuity across a time-sensitive food manufacturing and distribution environment.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities



- Design, implement, administer, monitor, and optimize relational databases and related data services supporting SAP and other business-critical applications. 
- Design and build secure data pipelines from SAP S/4HANA in RISE to SAP HANA Cloud and AWS. 
- Extract SAP data using approved technologies such as CDS Views, OData, ODP/ODQ, SLT, SDI/SDA, APIs, or SAP Datasphere. 
- Design SAP HANA Cloud schemas, calculation views, SQLScript procedures, data models, and replication processes. 
- Implement Bronze, Silver, and Gold data layers within the AWS Data Lake. 
- Build curated data models for Power BI reports, dashboards, and semantic models. 
- Develop and maintain reliable data pipelines, interfaces, and integrations between SAP and business systems such as warehouse, manufacturing, quality, payroll, CRM, sales, and business intelligence platforms. 
- Monitor database health, availability, job execution, storage, replication, and query performance; identify root causes and implement sustainable corrective actions. 
- Establish and maintain database backup, recovery, high-availability, disaster-recovery, retention, and archival practices consistent with business continuity requirements. 
- Apply role-based access, encryption, logging, change control, and other security practices to protect company, customer, employee, supplier, and operational data. 
- Partner with business and functional teams to improve the accuracy, completeness, consistency, and governance of item, material, vendor, customer, pricing, inventory, and other master data. 
- Support data migration, cleansing, validation, reconciliation, and cutover activities for SAP enhancements, acquisitions, system implementations, and process changes. 
- Create and maintain technical documentation, including database architecture, data flows, interfaces, data dictionaries, operating procedures, recovery procedures, and support runbooks. 
- Provide responsive production support for database and integration incidents that may affect plant operations, warehousing, order fulfillment, transportation, financial processing, or customer service, including occasional after-hours support for critical events. 
- Evaluate database technologies, tools, and automation opportunities and recommend improvements that increase reliability, scalability, security, data quality, and team efficiency. 
- Follow company cybersecurity, data privacy, food safety, quality, change-management, and record-retention requirements while performing work in office, warehouse, and manufacturing environments. 
- Perform other duties and participate in cross-functional projects as assigned. 

Required Qualifications



- Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, data management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. 
- Five or more years of experience in database engineering, database administration, data engineering, or a closely related role supporting business-critical systems. 
- Hands-on production experience supporting SAP S/4HANA, SAP HANA, and RISE with SAP environments. 
- Hands-on experience designing, building, or administering an AWS cloud data lake, including practical experience with Amazon S3 and relevant AWS data services such as AWS Glue, AWS Lake Formation, Amazon Athena, Amazon Redshift, or comparable services. 
- Advanced SQL skills and experience with relational database design, performance tuning, indexing, query optimization, backup and recovery, and production troubleshooting. 
- Experience building or supporting integrations, ETL or ELT processes, APIs, batch jobs, and data exchanges across enterprise applications. 
- Working knowledge of database security, access controls, auditing, data protection, change management, and disaster recovery practices. 
- Ability to analyze complex technical and operational issues, identify root causes, communicate risks clearly, and coordinate resolution across technical and business teams. 
- Strong documentation, project management, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with internal teams, vendors, and consultants. 

Preferred Qualifications



- Experience in food, beverage, dairy, consumer packaged goods, manufacturing, warehousing, or distribution operations. 
- Experience with SAP modules and data supporting materials management, production planning, sales and distribution, warehouse or inventory management, finance, controlling, and profitability analysis. 
- Experience with Microsoft SQL Server, Power BI, and complementary cloud, database, and analytics technologies. 
- Familiarity with manufacturing and operational platforms such as MES, warehouse management, transportation, quality, maintenance, or shop-floor systems. 
- Experience with data governance, master data management, data quality monitoring, metadata management, and reporting reconciliation. 
- SAP, Microsoft, database, cloud, or data engineering certification. 
- Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish. 

Core Competencies



- Technical depth and practical judgment
- Data integrity and attention to detail
- Operational urgency and dependable follow-through
- Root-cause analysis and structured problem solving
- Cross-functional collaboration and clear communication
- Continuous improvement and disciplined change management

Work Environment And Physical Requirements

This role operates primarily in an office environment and regularly supports systems used in active dairy manufacturing, warehouse, and distribution facilities. The employee may occasionally enter production, cold-storage, warehouse, loading, or yard areas and must follow all required safety, food-safety, sanitation, security, and personal protective equipment rules. The role requires regular use of a computer and may require work outside normal business hours to support critical incidents, maintenance windows, upgrades, or implementations. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

What You Bring To The Team



- Collaborative: Ability to build effective working relationships across Clover IT, Alpina, Kyndryl, and business teams, including across different cultures, time zones, and levels of technical expertise. 
- Accountable: A personal high-level of ownership of issues from diagnosis through resolution, ability to communicate progress clearly, and follow through reliably in a business-critical operating environment. 
- Analytical: Ability to approach complex data and systems problems methodically, identify root causes, and develop practical, sustainable solutions. 
- Adaptable: Ability to remain calm and effective when priorities shift, systems fail, or operational needs require urgent attention, while balancing immediate fixes with long-term improvements. 

Based in Petaluma, California, in the heart of beautiful Sonoma County, Clover Sonoma offers high quality dairy sourced from its network of local family farms. A pioneer in sustainable dairy farming Clover has the largest organic acreage of regeneratively farmed land in the state and is committed to reducing its carbon footprint by lowering on-farm methane emissions, regenerative farming practices focused on soil health and packaging innovation. The first dairy in the US to become American Humane certified across all of its farms, Clover has delivered on its promise of producing the highest-quality dairy products — including milk, cheese, butter, and more — for more than a century.

As a Certified B Corporation® Clover gives back 5% of net profits to help make nutritious food more accessible and uses its business as a power for good across its support for people, farms, animals, community and planet.

For more information, please visit www.cloversonoma.com and join the conversation on Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, and YouTube.

Compensation Range: $130K - $150K

descriptionHtml:
Our client is seeking an experienced Lead SQL/ETL Developer (SSIS, SSRS & Tableau) to support enterprise application modernization, data integration, reporting, and legacy system migration initiatives.


The ideal candidate will have extensive experience with SQL Server, T-SQL, SSIS, SSRS, and Tableau, along with strong technical leadership skills and the ability to independently drive development activities from requirements through implementation.


This role involves supporting existing .NET applications and participating in the modernization of a Statewide Automated Child Welfare Information System (SACWIS), working closely with business stakeholders and system integrators.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, implementation, and maintenance of SQL Server databases and ETL solutions.
  • Develop, maintain, and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, triggers, and T-SQL scripts.
  • Design, develop, deploy, and troubleshoot SSIS packages for data extraction, transformation, integration, and loading.
  • Develop and maintain Tableau dashboards, reports, and SSRS reporting solutions.
  • Lead data migration and conversion activities from legacy systems to modern platforms.
  • Design and implement data integration processes, including data mapping, cleansing, validation, reconciliation, and error handling.
  • Optimize SQL queries, SSIS package execution, and overall ETL performance.
  • Develop and support data models, relational database structures, data marts, and data dictionaries.
  • Integrate data from multiple sources, including SQL Server, DB2, and external systems.
  • Configure and deploy SSIS packages using version control, environment variables, and SQL Server Agent jobs.
  • Work with business analysts, stakeholders, and system integrators to validate requirements, designs, and technical deliverables.
  • Participate in the complete SDLC, including requirements analysis, development, testing, deployment, production support, and documentation.
  • Provide technical ownership, troubleshoot complex issues, and support knowledge transfer for ongoing application maintenance.


Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of overall IT experience, with strong hands-on SQL development, ETL, and data integration experience.
  • 5+ years of Tableau experience, including developing complex reports and dashboards.
  • 5+ years of experience writing complex SQL queries, including performance tuning and optimization.
  • 5+ years of experience with T-SQL, SSIS, SSRS, or Talend.
  • Strong experience developing and maintaining stored procedures, triggers, and database objects.
  • Experience deploying SSIS packages using Git, environment variables, and SQL Server Agent.
  • Experience with data migration, data conversion, data mapping, and ETL/ELT processes.
  • Experience with SQL Server and integrating data from multiple database platforms.
  • Experience with version control tools such as Team Foundation Server (TFS).
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently own technical deliverables and drive projects from requirements through implementation.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Salesforce and MuleSoft.
  • Experience supporting .NET enterprise applications.
  • Experience with SACWIS, child welfare systems, or government modernization projects.
  • Experience working with system integrators and supporting knowledge transfer.
  • Experience with service-oriented architecture (SOA) and enterprise data integration.


Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a hands-on technical lead, not just a developer with a senior title. The successful candidate must demonstrate strong SQL/ETL development expertise, independent technical ownership, experience leading complex data integration initiatives, and the ability to deliver solutions with minimal supervision.

Most benefits take effect within 30 days of employment, and some require a waiting period.

Job Summary

The SQL & PHP Developer supports the development and maintenance of data-driven applications and business reporting solutions, with an initial focus on SQL query and stored procedure development. This role is responsible for creating, modifying, testing, troubleshooting, and optimizing SQL queries and stored procedures that support application functionality, reporting, dashboards, business analytics, and forecasting. Because the data produced through this work is used to support operational reporting, performance measurement, business analytics, and forecasting, accuracy, consistency, and an understanding of how data is used by the business are important aspects of the role. As technical skills and knowledge of the applications grow, the position will progressively expand into PHP development, providing a clear path from SQL-focused development to broader back-end application development.

Compensation

[Starting / Initial] Base Salary Pay Range: $65,000 - $75,000/yr.

Specific offers within the listed pay ranges are determined by a variety of factors such as experience, education, skills, certifications and business needs.

Responsibilities

that support applications, reporting, dashboards, analytics, and other business processes.

Analyze existing SQL queries and stored procedures to understand business logic, data relationships, dependencies, and expected results.

Create efficient queries that retrieve, transform, aggregate, and organize data according to application and business requirements.

Troubleshoot incorrect, incomplete, duplicate, or unexpected query results and identify issues within SQL logic, stored procedures, or application interactions.

Modify and enhance existing stored procedures as application functionality and business requirements change.

Test SQL changes to confirm data accuracy, expected functionality, and appropriate performance before implementation.

Review and optimize queries and stored procedures to improve efficiency and reduce unnecessary processing.

Understand how data generated by queries and stored procedures is consumed by downstream applications, dashboards, reports, analytics, and forecasting processes.

Work with business and technical team members to understand reporting and analytical requirements and translate those requirements into appropriate SQL logic.

Recognize the business impact of data quality and ensure that SQL development produces accurate, consistent, and reliable results for operational and analytical use.

Support data used in dashboards that help business users monitor key performance indicators, identify trends, evaluate performance, and make informed operational and strategic decisions.

Assist with the development and maintenance of data processes that support historical analysis, business forecasting, and other analytical activities.

Document stored procedures, complex queries, business rules, data logic, dependencies, and technical changes as appropriate.

Use source control and established development, testing, code review, and deployment practices.

Review existing PHP application code to understand how applications execute stored procedures, process returned data, and present information to users.

Progress from SQL-focused assignments into PHP development tasks as knowledge of the applications, business processes, and development environment grows.

Develop, troubleshoot, and enhance PHP application functionality under the guidance of experienced developers.

Take on increasingly independent SQL and PHP development responsibilities as technical proficiency and system knowledge grow.

Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback to improve code quality, maintainability, performance, and development practices.

Qualifications

Associate degree, bachelor's degree, technical certification, relevant coursework, or comparable hands-on experience in computer science, information technology, software development, data analytics, or a related field.

2+ years of SQL Server experience with the ability to develop queries using joins, subqueries, aggregate functions, grouping, conditional logic, and common data manipulation techniques.

1+ years of PHP web development experience.

1+ years of experience with the Laravel Framework

Understanding of relational database concepts, including tables, views, relationships, primary and foreign keys, data types, and normalization concepts.

Familiarity with developing and modifying stored procedures using parameters, variables, conditional logic, temporary data structures, and result sets.

Ability to analyze, troubleshoot, and modify existing queries and stored procedures while maintaining data accuracy and considering query performance and downstream dependencies.

Understanding of how data is used in business reporting, dashboards, key performance indicators, analytics, and forecasting, with an appreciation for the importance of accurate and consistent results.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to translate business or technical requirements into logical development tasks.

Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical team members, learn existing application and business logic, and progress from SQL development into PHP and back-end application development.

Proficiency with HTML/CSS/Javascript.

Experience in all phases of SDLC, OO analysis and design, and revision control systems.

Ability to converse with end-users, gather requirements, and provide feedback in plain non-technical English.

Ability to structure a software project (UI / API / DB)

Ability to write clear, concise, and accurate technical documentation.

Outstanding customer service and time management skills

Strong interpersonal, communication and organizational skills

Physical Requirements

  • Frequently remains in a sitting/stationary position during the workday
  • Operates a computer and performs desk-based computer tasks continually, frequently viewing a computer screen

By submitting an application or resume for this position, I understand that is an in-office position.

To apply for the SQL & PHP Developer position, please submit your resume and cover letter to careers@cogentco.com .

Cogent Communications is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are unable to offer employment visa sponsorship for any of our open positions, including H-1B, OPT, or STEM extensions. All applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis without requiring employer sponsorship now or in the future.

descriptionHtml:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.


Location

This is a remote position.


About the job you’re considering

Capgemini is looking for a highly skilled and experienced Software Engineer - Database Developer to join our outstanding Engineering team. As a Software Engineer - Database Developer, you will play an important role in maintaining and updating our databases, ensuring accurate data analysis and reporting. You will also collaborate with other team members to efficiently implement new queries, resolve any issues with automated jobs, and improve performance. More importantly, Leverage AI-driven techniques to automate error classification, enable predictive analytics for recurring issues, and deliver intelligent reporting, dashboards, and optimized data retrieval solutions.


Your Role

Data Base Administration:

  • Management of the data extractions from the SAGE Datawarehouse cubes (this requires, troubleshooting, maintenance and modifications as necessary)
  • Ensures that the servers hardware and software are updated (RARS mainly)
  • Making sure that the new drivers, plug-ins are updated. Make sure to run the maintenance services, keep the indexes up to day, adapt to the IT network changes, protection against virus, etc.
  • Monitoring of the performance of the hardware and software
  • Preserving data. Organize the data and secure backups
  • Changes to the server configuration as needed

Reporting (Error summary and system and shot reports):

  • Maintain both data bases: the internal reporting and the IB one
  • Update the look up tables for new errors and new classification of errors per weight and functional category
  • Update the cubes to allow queries that are required to analyze the data
  • Create new queries that allow to get the necessary reports from the existing cubes (internal testing and install base)
  • Monitor and troubleshooting of the daily automated jobs to run the reports.
  • Work with other resources when there are issues or modification are needed with the SAGE DW interface
  • Pre-emptive maintenance, look for data clogs and issue on the reports generation
  • Update the stored procedures for the excel reports with new errors, remove previous ones, add system info, etc
  • Apply AI/ML-driven tools and techniques for:
  • Database performance optimization (query tuning, indexing strategies, workload prediction)
  • Intelligent anomaly detection in system performance and data flows
  • Predictive maintenance of database infrastructure

AI Integration in Reporting:

  • Leverage AI techniques for:
  • Automated error classification and pattern detection
  • Predictive analytics for identifying recurring system/reporting issues
  • Intelligent report generation and recommendation systems
  • Build and maintain smart dashboards with predictive insights and anomaly alerts.
  • Use AI-assisted tools to optimize report queries and improve data retrieval efficiency.


Your Skills and Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in database schema design, development, and management
  • Database Administration & Performance Optimization (SQL Server, indexing, query tuning, backups)
  • Data Warehousing & ETL Management (SAGE DW, cubes, data extraction, ETL processes)
  • Reporting & SQL Development (complex queries, stored procedures, automated reporting)
  • System Monitoring & Troubleshooting (job monitoring, performance tracking, issue resolution)
  • AI/ML & Advanced Analytics (anomaly detection, predictive analytics, AI-driven optimization & dashboards)

descriptionHtml:
Swift is a privately held, mission-driven and employee-focused services and solutions company headquartered in Reston, VA. Our capabilities include Software Development, Engineering & IT, Data Science, Cyber Enablement, Logistics, and Training. Founded in 2019, Swift supports Civilian, Defense, and Intelligence Community customers across the country and around the globe.

We are looking for a skilled Senior Database Developer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and managing scalable data pipelines and infrastructure, with a focus on AWS cloud services. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to support data-driven applications and analytics, ensuring efficient data flow and accessibility. The ideal candidate will thrive in an Agile project management setting and possess a strong background in data management and processing. The position is in Herndon, VA.

Responsibilities

  • Designing, developing, and managing database systems, particularly focusing on AWS RDS for PostgreSQL and SQL databases
  • Managing data structures and load routines to support application development and support application users
  • Working with reporting tools like Power BI
  • Developing and interfacing with Application Program Interfaces (APIs), supporting application development teams, and leveraging AWS environments for database and application support
  • The ideal candidate will thrive in an Agile project management setting and possess a strong background in data management and processing

Requirements

  • 5+ years of relevant experience
  • Demonstrated database experience with RDS PostgreSQL and SQL databases
  • Proficiency in working with views, triggers, and stored procedures
  • Strong knowledge of SQL scripting, database indexing, and optimization techniques
  • Experience in developing and interfacing with APIs
  • Experience in developing, creating, and modifying data structures and load routines for business use
  • Expertise in working with relational data, including cleansing, transforming, and processing structured data
  • Knowledge of Amazon Web Services (AWS) environments
  • Experience working within an Agile project management framework
  • Proven experience collaborating with diverse teams, including client staff, IT customers, and technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • US Citizenship and an active TS/SCI with Polygraph security clearance required

Desired Experience

  • Experience designing, developing, and deploying AI and Generative AI models and algorithms
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to identify and solve business challenges using AI technologies
  • Researching and staying up-to-date with the latest advancements in AI and GenAI
  • Experience with AWS Cloud Data Migration Services
  • Familiarity with Jira for project tracking and management
  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes
  • Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation
  • Experience with data visualization tools like Power BI or Tableau
  • AWS certifications related to data engineering or architecture

We are not working with outside staffing agencies to fill this position, and we will not be accepting unsolicited resumes. All inquiries must go through the recruiting team.

descriptionHtml:
We are currently looking for a SQL Developer / Data Analyst for a 100% remote position supporting a large federal government healthcare modernization project. This role will support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) by providing SQL development, data analysis, reporting, and data quality monitoring for ongoing electronic health record (EHR) modernization initiatives. The developer will work with large clinical and operational datasets, supporting data migration, integration, validation, and business intelligence reporting using SQL Server, Power BI, and related technologies.

The position operates within a remote, multidisciplinary Agile team, collaborating with software developers, data engineers, quality assurance personnel, and federal stakeholders. The developer will participate in data analysis, reporting, validation, and continuous improvement activities to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of healthcare data throughout modernization and migration efforts.

The candidate must reside within the continental US.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize advanced SQL queries, scripts, and transformation logic to support data extraction, validation, reconciliation, and analysis across large clinical and operational datasets within SQL Server environments.
  • Analyze and interpret healthcare data from multiple systems, identify trends and anomalies, and develop reports, dashboards, and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, Excel, and related business intelligence tools to support program reporting and decision-making.
  • Collaborate with developers, data engineers, and program stakeholders to evaluate data flows, source-to-target mappings, transformation requirements, and conceptual and physical data models supporting federal healthcare data warehouses and integration initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain data quality monitoring processes, validation routines, and reconciliation reports to assess data completeness, accuracy, consistency, and timeliness throughout migration and EHR modernization activities.
  • Investigate data discrepancies, perform exploratory data analysis and root cause investigations, document findings, and maintain technical documentation, including data dictionaries, mapping specifications, runbooks, and validation protocols.
  • Support recurring reporting deliverables and evaluate AI-assisted tools for SQL optimization, automated data quality checks, anomaly detection, and technical documentation while validating generated outputs and maintaining data security and quality standards.
  • Take on additional tasks and responsibilities as needed to support team objectives and ensure the success of the project.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field from an accredited college or university recognized by the U.S. Department of Education, or eight (8) years of additional relevant experience in lieu of a degree, with a minimum of five (5) years of relevant professional experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience developing advanced SQL queries, scripts, and data extraction processes using Microsoft SQL Server, including working with large, complex datasets and optimizing query performance.
  • Experience analyzing healthcare or clinical datasets, including familiarity with healthcare data standards and systems such as HL7, FHIR, or VistA, and supporting data validation, transformation, and integration activities.
  • Strong understanding of relational database structures, data modeling, indexing, normalization, and performance tuning, with experience developing reports and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, or Microsoft Excel.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail and the ability to identify data discrepancies, investigate root causes, and ensure data accuracy and integrity.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, documentation, and collaboration skills with the ability to present technical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and work effectively within multidisciplinary teams.

Additional Qualifications

  • Previous experience supporting Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) healthcare data systems, including VX130, Oracle Health Millennium, or the Corporate Data Warehouse (CDW), and familiarity with InterSystems IRIS, Caché, mirrored database architectures, or EHR data migration and cutover verification activities.
  • Experience working within Agile development environments using JIRA, Azure DevOps, or similar tools, with knowledge of healthcare data governance, metadata management, source-to-target mapping, data quality monitoring, and technical documentation practices.
  • Experience using AI-assisted tools such as GitHub Copilot to develop and optimize SQL queries, generate data validation and reconciliation scripts, identify anomalies, analyze trends, and produce technical documentation, with an understanding of AI output validation, PHI/PII protection, and responsible AI practices within federal healthcare environments.

Security Clearance Requirements

  • U.S. Citizenship is required.
  • All selected candidates must successfully complete a background check.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Government/Public Trust clearance, including required fingerprinting, when required for the position.

Benefits

  • Medical/Dental/Vision
  • 401k with Employer Match
  • PTO + Federal Holidays
  • Corporate Laptop
  • Training Opportunities
  • Remote Opportunity

VetsEZ is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status.

descriptionHtml:
At InterSystems, we’re redefining the future of analytics and intelligent data platforms. Our high-performance, hyper-capacity engine supports a multi-model storage layer—blending structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data—to power a new generation of AI-native and real-time workloads.

We believe in technical craftsmanship, deep collaboration, and a culture where ambitious people can build bold systems. The SQL Engine group is the nerve center of our product—where query processing meets distributed intelligence. We consider engineering a science, an art, and a craft, and we cultivate an environment where the most talented minds can thrive, innovate, and make a lasting impact.

This is your chance to design the core foundations of a data platform trusted by the world's most mission critical systems and AI research teams.

What You’ll Do

As a Distinguished Developer in the SQL Engine group, you'll help build the next-generation query processing stack, optimizing across both traditional analytics and emerging AI-driven workloads. You’ll contribute to:

  • Query parsing, validation, and transformation
  • Logical/physical optimization over multi-model data (row, columnar, stream, document, vector)
  • Plan generation and adaptive execution strategies
  • Code generation and vectorized execution
  • Compiler-accelerated storage access patterns for AI workflows
  • Collaborative integration with our multi-model storage engine

You’ll design data processing abstractions and execution engines that enable AI-native features like fast vector search, graph traversal, and probabilistic joins—all within a familiar SQL interface.

Your Impact

  • Architect and implement query optimization and execution components that scale across petabytes
  • Design tooling and frameworks that make AI and analytics convergence seamless
  • Collaborate with platform and storage teams to leverage multi-model indexing and caching strategies
  • Contribute to building programmable, intelligent data pipelines that drive downstream ML model performance
  • Mentor engineers, guide technical debates, and influence long-term system direction
  • Champion a culture of quality, rigor, and innovation

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years of experience in systems-level or database internals engineering
  • Proven expertise in SQL query engines, optimizers, execution runtimes, or data compiler toolchains
  • Experience with multi-model data systems (SQL + JSON, vector search, graph traversal)
  • Expert in at least one systems programming languages, or LLVM-based codegen environments
  • Strong grasp of relational algebra, compiler construction, and data-intensive workloads
  • Familiarity with AI infrastructure or ML inference pipelines is a strong plus
  • Experience using AI-assisted tools (e.g. copilots, summarisation tools, or chatbots) with an ability to critically evaluate and verify AI-generated outputs
  • Demonstrated ability to learn, evaluate, adapt to, propose and implement AI-augmented workflows in order to continually enhance your own, and the team’s productivity
  • Passion for designing software that balances performance, correctness, and usability
  • PHD degree or published research experience is highly advantageous.

Our Engineering Culture

  • Innovation is expected: Engineers propose, prototype, and lead from the front
  • Excellence over ego: Code is debated, ideas are tested, and the best ones win
  • Long-term vision: We optimize for architectural clarity and product longevity
  • Cross-domain thinking: We solve storage, processing, and AI problems together
  • Sane pace, deep focus: We value craft, creativity, and time to do both well

Ready to Build What’s Next?

If you dream of working on deep query systems, love systems-level programming, and want to help create a platform that bridges SQL, multi-model data, and AI—we’d love to talk.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and do not discriminate because of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, age, disability, sexual orientation or gender identity or expression or any other legally protected category. Other compensation may include a discretionary annual variable target incentive.

The company also provides generous employee benefits including:

  • Medical, vision, and dental insurance
  • Short-term and long-term disability, and life insurance
  • 401(k) Profit Sharing Contribution
  • Paid Time Off and Holidays
  • Parental Leave
  • Tuition reimbursement

The estimated base compensation range for this role is:

$144,000—$205,000 USD

InterSystems, a creative data technology provider, delivers a unified foundation for next-generation applications for healthcare, finance, manufacturing, and supply chain customers in more than 80 countries. Our data platforms solve interoperability, speed, and scalability problems for large organizations around the globe to unlock the power of data and allow people to perceive data in imaginative ways. Established in 1978, InterSystems is committed to excellence through its 24×7 support for customers and partners around the world. Job Description

Be an integral part of an agile team that's constantly pushing the envelope to enhance, build, and deliver top-notch technology products.

As a Senior Lead Software Engineer at JPMorganChase within the Consumer and Community Banking Administration - Consumer Banking Technology team, you are an integral part of an agile team that works to enhance, build, and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. Drive significant business impact through your capabilities and contributions, and apply deep technical expertise and problem-solving methodologies to tackle a diverse array of challenges that span multiple technologies and applications.

Job Responsibilities

  • Provide direct support for development teams performing database modernization activities and serve as a function-wide subject matter expert in one or more areas of focus
  • Influences peers and project decision-makers to consider the use and application of leading-edge technologies, providing recommendations on database technology based on applications for the business requirements and needs
  • Contribute as database engineer and development expert, working with application development teams to develop, execute and support database modernization, optimization, performance tuning and design activities
  • Drives team adoption of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted engineering practices within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and operational outcomes (e.g., AI-assisted code review/refactoring, test strategy acceleration, incident/root-cause analysis support), while establishing consistent validation standards (secure coding, peer review, automated testing) and promoting reuse of effective patterns across the team
  • Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation
  • Provide thought leadership and modernization support to application development (AD) teams through the analysis, migration, and post migration efforts for their database footprints
  • Provide direct support for development teams performing database modernization activities and contribute to the design and development of tools to accelerate modernization efforts
  • Partner with PaaS, DBaaS, and Cloud Delivery teams to resolve issues and influence implementation of self service capabilities to support the AD teams
  • Participate in tactical and strategic database modernization planning and development of database modernization patterns
  • Drives decisions that influence the product design, application functionality, technical operations, processes and partner with other Center Of Excellence teams in setting best practices, guidelines and proper design patterns across various DB technologies
  • Support AD teams in DB design activities, troubleshooting and resolving production database issues - contributing to root cause analysis supporting problem workstreams to upskill database development and support competencies for database issues that support problem management workstreams

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Formal training or certification in software engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience
  • Hands-on practical experience in database system design, performing database development and performace testing and ensuring operational stability
  • Advanced in one or more programming language(s) and framework(s) (i.e., Tigergraph, Oracle, Sql Server, Aurora Postgres, CockroachDB, Mongo DB, etc.)
  • Perform proactive reviews of database implementations to enhance performance, efficiency, resiliency, and cost optimization
  • Experience supporting databases in DevOps and proficient in automation and continuous delivery methods
  • Demonstrated experience leading effective use of approved AI-assisted software development tools (e.g., for coding, code review, test acceleration, troubleshooting) with the ability to set team expectations for validating AI outputs for correctness, performance, and security
  • Strong understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; experience coaching engineers on safe, compliant adoption within delivery practices
  • Advanced knowledge of software applications and technical processes with considerable in-depth knowledge in one or more technical disciplines (e.g., cloud, artificial intelligence, machine learning, mobile, etc.)
  • Proficient in all aspects of the Software Development Life Cycle and advanced understanding of agile methodologies such as CI/CD, Application Resiliency, and Security
  • Demonstrate proficiency in software applications and technical processes within a technical discipline (e.g., cloud, artifical intelligence, machine learning, mobile, etc.)
  • Demonstrate ability to perform database upgrades and migrations to tackle design and functionality problems independently with little to no oversight

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Practical cloud native experience
  • Adds to the team culture of diversity, opportunity, inclusion, and respect
  • Strong desire to master emerging technologies and share experience with other team members
  • Ability to adjust and adapt role to support team success
  • Direct experience with SQL and NoSQL databases
  • In-depth knowledge of the financial services industry and their IT systems

ABOUT US

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. Those in eligible roles may receive commission-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. We also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs, based on eligibility. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage, on-site health and wellness centers, a retirement savings plan, backup childcare, tuition reimbursement, mental health support, financial coaching and more. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

Our Consumer & Community Banking Group depends on innovators like you to serve consumers, small businesses, municipalities and non-profits. You'll support the delivery of award winning tools and services that cover everything from personal and small business banking as well as lending, mortgages, credit cards, payments, auto finance and investment advice. This group is also focused on developing and delivering cutting edged mobile applications, digital experiences and next generation banking technology solutions to better serve our clients and customers.

Responsibilities

Position Overview

REI Systems is seeking an experienced AWS Database Engineer to support mission-critical federal applications, database modernization, data integration, and cloud engineering initiatives within the GrantSolutions platform.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on expertise in Oracle SQL/PL/SQL, PostgreSQL, Amazon RDS, AWS database services, ETL development, and database migration technologies. This role will focus on designing, developing, optimizing, securing, and maintaining scalable database solutions that support complex federal applications and enterprise data environments.

The AWS Database Engineer will collaborate with application developers, cloud architects, DevOps engineers, data engineers, Product Owners, Agile teams, and federal stakeholders to deliver reliable, secure, and high-performing database solutions.

This position also offers opportunities to leverage approved AI-assisted development and automation tools to enhance database engineering, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

Database Development & Engineering

  • Design, develop, maintain, and optimize Oracle and PostgreSQL database solutions supporting enterprise applications.
  • Develop complex SQL queries, PL/SQL packages, stored procedures, functions, triggers, views, materialized views, and sequences.
  • Develop and optimize PostgreSQL SQL and PL/pgSQL code, including functions, procedures, triggers, and database objects.
  • Analyze complex data models, database schemas, entity relationship diagrams (ERDs), and enterprise data flows.
  • Perform database performance tuning using execution plans, indexing strategies, partitioning, optimizer statistics, and database diagnostic tools.
  • Develop and maintain database migration scripts, schema updates, and automated deployment processes.
  • Troubleshoot database performance issues, data inconsistencies, integration challenges, and production defects.

AWS Cloud Database Engineering

  • Design, configure, administer, monitor, and maintain cloud-based database solutions using AWS services, including:
  • Amazon RDS for Oracle
  • Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL
  • Amazon Redshift
  • Amazon S3
  • AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS)
  • AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT)
  • Amazon CloudWatch
  • AWS Secrets Manager
  • AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS)
  • AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM)
  • Configure and optimize PostgreSQL databases hosted on Amazon RDS, including indexing, extensions, parameter groups, performance tuning, and operational troubleshooting.
  • Implement database backup, recovery, high availability, monitoring, encryption, and access control mechanisms.
  • Support AWS cloud modernization initiatives involving Oracle and PostgreSQL databases.
  • Monitor database performance, availability, resource utilization, and operational health across AWS environments.

Database Migration & Modernization

  • Support database migration and modernization initiatives across Oracle, PostgreSQL, and AWS environments.
  • Implement AWS DMS and AWS SCT solutions for database migration, schema conversion, and replication.
  • Configure source and target database endpoints, full-load migration tasks, and change data capture (CDC) processes.
  • Perform migration assessments, data validation, reconciliation, cutover planning, and post-migration verification.
  • Identify opportunities to improve database architecture, scalability, performance, and operational efficiency.

ETL, Data Integration & Analytics

  • Design, develop, and maintain ETL workflows, data transformation processes, and batch processing solutions.
  • Build and support enterprise data integration pipelines using Matillion ETL or similar technologies.
  • Develop data validation frameworks and automated data quality checks.
  • Support data integration between enterprise applications, databases, reporting platforms, and analytics environments.
  • Collaborate with data engineers and application teams to ensure data accuracy, integrity, consistency, and accessibility.
  • Support database solutions and pipelines used for analytics, reporting, and AI/ML workloads.

DevSecOps, Automation & Production Support

  • Support database deployments through CI/CD pipelines and automated release processes.
  • Collaborate with DevOps teams to implement database deployment automation, monitoring, and infrastructure management practices.
  • Develop and execute database unit tests, regression tests, data validation tests, and deployment verification activities.
  • Participate in production deployments, incident resolution, root-cause analysis, and post-release validation.
  • Implement database security controls, audit logging, encryption, credential management, and least-privilege access.
  • Maintain technical documentation, database designs, data mappings, deployment procedures, and operational support guides.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.

AI-Assisted Engineering & Continuous Improvement

  • Leverage approved AI-powered development tools to improve SQL development, code optimization, testing, troubleshooting, and technical documentation.
  • Identify opportunities to implement AI-assisted automation within database engineering and operational support activities.
  • Apply responsible AI practices while maintaining data security, privacy, and compliance requirements.
  • Evaluate emerging database, cloud, and AI technologies to improve engineering productivity and platform capabilities.

  • Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in database engineering, Oracle database development, ETL development, data integration, or related software engineering roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Oracle SQL and PL/SQL, including stored procedures, packages, functions, triggers, views, materialized views, complex queries, and performance tuning.
  • Experience using Oracle database development tools such as SQL Developer and SQL*Loader.
  • Required hands-on experience with AWS database services, including Amazon RDS for Oracle, Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL, Amazon Redshift, Amazon S3, AWS DMS, AWS SCT, Amazon CloudWatch, AWS Secrets Manager, AWS KMS, and IAM.
  • Strong PostgreSQL and Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL experience, including SQL/PL/pgSQL development, administration, indexing, query optimization, performance tuning, backup and recovery, high availability, and troubleshooting.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing database migrations and replication using AWS DMS and AWS SCT, including schema conversion, endpoint configuration, full-load migrations, CDC, validation, and cutover activities.
  • Experience implementing AWS database operational controls for monitoring, logging, backup and recovery, encryption, credential management, access control, and infrastructure automation.
  • Experience designing and implementing ETL workflows, data transformation processes, batch processing, and data migration solutions.
  • Experience with Matillion ETL or similar cloud-native data integration and orchestration platforms.
  • Strong understanding of relational database architecture, logical and physical data modeling, normalization, indexing, transaction management, and referential integrity.
  • Experience optimizing complex database queries and troubleshooting performance bottlenecks.
  • Experience developing database unit tests, regression tests, data validation processes, and automated deployment verification.
  • Experience supporting production database environments, incident management, root-cause analysis, and application releases.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps practices, and database deployment automation.
  • Experience working in Agile environments using Scrum, Kanban, or similar methodologies.
  • Proficiency with version control and development tools such as Git, GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, or Azure DevOps.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and their application to software engineering, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting.
  • Understanding of responsible AI, data privacy, cybersecurity, and secure technology adoption in enterprise environments.

  • Experience supporting AWS cloud migration, database modernization, and application transformation initiatives.
  • Knowledge of federal cybersecurity and compliance standards, including FISMA, NIST, and FedRAMP.

Job Number: R0250194

Database Solutions Engineer

The Opportunity:

Data is only useful when it is trusted, accessible, and ready to support the mission. As a Database Developer, you’ll help design and deliver secure, high-performing Oracle Database solutions that support applications, analytics, APIs, and AI-enabled workflows.

In this role, you’ll work across logical and physical data design, geospatial intelligence, multimodal data, and emerging AI capabilities. You’ll help integrate relational, spatial, JSON, and graph data while ensuring solutions remain reliable, maintainable, secure, and ready to support operational users.

You’ll collaborate with application developers, AI specialists, data engineers, cloud architects, security professionals, and customer stakeholders to solve complex data challenges. If you’re excited about building database capabilities that make mission data more useful and actionable, we invite you to join us.

What You’ll Work On:

  • Architect, implement, and optimize Oracle Database solutions for complex enterprise and mission workloads.
  • Design logical and physical data models, schemas, indexes, views, packages, and data access patterns that support performance, security, and maintainability.
  • Design multi-model Oracle Database solutions integrating relational, spatial, JSON, and graph data types.
  • Manage geospatial intelligence data, including raster and vector formats, and develop spatial schemas, indexes, queries, and services.
  • Enable AI use cases in Oracle Database using vector data types, embeddings, RAG, and MCP integrations.
  • Assess source systems, define migration and conversion strategies, and validate data quality, completeness, reconciliation, and performance.
  • Support database operations, including performance tuning, monitoring, backup and recovery, security, troubleshooting, documentation, and operational runbooks.
  • Collaborate with application, AI, data engineering, cloud, security, and customer teams to translate requirements into maintainable database designs.


Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 8+ years of experience in database engineering, database development, or data architecture
  • Experience architecting, implementing, and optimizing Oracle Database solutions, including logical and physical design, performance tuning, security, backup and recovery, and operational support
  • Experience managing geospatial intelligence data, including raster and vector formats, and designing spatial schemas, indexes, queries, and services
  • Experience designing multi-modal database solutions using relational, spatial, JSON, and graph data types
  • Experience enabling AI use cases in Oracle Database using vector data types, embeddings, RAG, or MCP integrations
  • Experience with SQL and PL/SQL, including schemas, packages, procedures, functions, views, and query optimization
  • Experience assessing source systems, developing migration and conversion strategies, validating data quality, and collaborating across technical and mission teams
  • Active TS/SCI clearance; willingness to take a polygraph exam
  • Bachelor’s degree


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with Oracle AI Database 26ai, Oracle Exadata, or OCI Autonomous AI Database Service on Exadata
  • Experience creating RESTful APIs and integrating with Oracle API Gateway or similar API management capabilities
  • Experience migrating Oracle Databases into OCI using Zero Downtime Migration, Data Pump, GoldenGate, or similar tools
  • Experience migrating JSON data from MongoDB or similar document stores into Oracle Database
  • Experience with Oracle Spatial and spatial analytics workflows
  • Experience designing highly available, scalable, reliable, and observable database solutions in regulated or mission environments
  • Knowledge of OCI, including database deployment, networking, identity, storage, monitoring, and security services


Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $86,800.00 to $198,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
  • Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role.
  • Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.


Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.
