Job Title: SQL Developer

Department: Information Technology

Reports To: Director of Informatics

FLSA Status: Exempt

Wage range that the company expects to pay: $4,557.60 - $5,024.75 bi-weekly

Summary

Under the general supervision of the Director of Informatics, the SQL Developer is responsible for building and optimizing Microsoft SQL queries, stored procedures, and other database objects to improve system performance and meet business needs.

It is the primary purpose of CHCCC to provide the highest quality of total care possible to the patient population it serves. Such a level of quality depends ultimately on the staff's desire and ability to work together, individually, and as a team. The employee is expected to be professional, punctual, maintain regular attendance, cooperative, motivated, and organized at all times.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Additional duties may be assigned with or without prior notice.

Develops, tests, and maintains complex Microsoft SQL queries, stored procedures, triggers, and other database objects for reporting and analytics.

Creates and updates documentation for new and existing processes and Microsoft SQL scripts.

Helps design relational databases to store and process business data

Collaborates with the Informatics team to identify areas for improvement and implement solutions

Maintains expertise in athenaOne and NextGen database architecture, clinical workflows, and modules.

Generates routine and ad hoc reports for internal and external customers.

Monitors and troubleshoots CHC Helpdesk tickets as applicable to the use of software systems and issues.

Demonstrates professionalism when calling patients and provides quality customer service using AIDET Standards.

Ability to work with high volume of patients, internal/external customers, and deal with frequent changes, delays or unexpected events.

Demonstrates adherence to and observes all safety policies and procedures, including infection control rules and regulations

Demonstrates the knowledge of domestic violence, child and dependent abuse protocols.

Demonstrates cultural sensitivity and competence.

Maintains and adheres to HIPAA, employee confidentiality, and privileged communications (patient, employee, and corporation).

Supervisory Responsibilities

This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

EDUCATION And/or EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or related field or 5 years of professional experience in Microsoft SQL Server database design and programming. Prior experience working in IT at a Federally Qualified Health Center is preferred. Prior experience with data warehouses and importing and cleansing data from different sources is preferred. Prior experience working with NextGen or athenaOne EHR systems is a plus. Some understanding of medical terminology and ICD-10 and CPT4 coding is a plus. Must demonstrate strong analytical and problem solving skills.

Language Skills

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of organization. Ability to speak confidently and articulate thoughts clearly and logically when training. Ability to respond effectively to the most sensitive inquires or complaints.

Mathematical Skills

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret bar graphs.

REASONING ABILITY

Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form. Ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations.

Computer Skills

Experience with word processing, spreadsheets, email, and keyboarding is required. Microsoft Office and Google Suite skills are required.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

None

Other Requirements

Required to pass a criminal history background check and drug screen upon hire. Annual health examination; annual Tuberculosis skin test clearance or chest x-ray; proof of immunity to MMR, Varicella, and Hepatitis B; proof of Tdap vaccine; during current flu season, must provide proof of influenza vaccine or a signed declination form. If declined, a flu mask is mandatory during flu season. Health screening requirements are subject to change based on CDC recommendations and federal, state, and/or local public health ordinances.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear. The employee occasionally is required to sit. The employee is frequently required to stand and walk for extended periods of time. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is occasionally exposed to risk of electrical shock. The noise level in the work environment is moderate. Must be willing to work in a clinical environment to provide onsite support to employees as needed.

Must be willing to have a flexible work schedule that may include evenings/weekends.

companyDescription: We are thinkers and doers. We combine strategy and execution to help organizations accelerate growth and realize a brighter future. We take complex technology solutions and make them practical and actionable. Then we deliver them globally.
companySlogan: Combining strategy and execution to help organizations accelerate growth. Together, let's Make a New World Happen.
descriptionHtml:
World Wide Technology (WWT) strives to make a new world happen. WWT's work benefits clients and partners as much as it does its people and community across the globe.

Founded in 1990, WWT brings together strategy, deep technical expertise and world-class partnerships to help public and private sector organizations design, build and scale intelligent AI, digital, cybersecurity, cloud and infrastructure solutions. Through its Advanced Technology Center (ATC)—a collaborative ecosystem featuring state-of-the-art hardware and software—WWT enables clients and partners to conceptualize, test and validate innovative technology and then deploy solutions at scale using its global integration and distribution capabilities.

With more than 14,000 team members and over 60 locations globally, WWT's culture—grounded in core values and leadership philosophies—has been recognized by Fortune® and Great Place to Work for its commitment to innovation, trust and creating a great place to work for all. WWT provides products and services to large enterprise, global service provider and public sector clients in up to 130 countries across six continents. Softchoice, a World Wide Technology company, supports commercial and SMB markets in the U.S. and Canada.

Want to work with highly motivated individuals on high-performance teams? Join WWT today!

What is the IT Shipping Execution Team?

The IT Shipping Execution team uses a broad range of functional and technical skills toward the continued build-out of solutions to support our Shipping Operations teams. As an Oracle Developer, you will be responsible for participating in the on-going maintenance and enhancements of our existing code base, and general project related deliverables all within an Agile development framework. You will be expected to become an advocate for code quality and standards of development while also taking a hand in mentoring and guiding the more junior members of our team. You will also be expected to contribute to the technical designing of solutions of our complex business problems. When you are successful in this role, you will have a distinct impact on teams, products, and individuals outside of your own team.

What will you be doing?

The individual we are looking to hire will work with a team of analysts and developers to support and enhance the on-prem and cloud Oracle Systems. You will be learning and expected to know our business processes including custom processes within our Oracle Suite. There will be a strong SQL and PL/SQL need for this role.

Responsibilities:

As a member of our IT Shipping Execution team, you will:

  • Live and Breathe the WWT Core Values and best practices
  • Participate in the on-going development and support of existing IT Shipping Execution efforts
  • Guide and drive technical solutions to complex business problems
  • Participate in strategic projects that improve operational efficiency across WWT’s Global Supply Chain organization
  • Create and maintain Oracle PL/SQL objects
  • Learn and provide technical expertise to Warehouse Management System (WMS) Oracle Module and Oracle Shipping Execution
  • Exposure and opportunity for full stack web development on team owned applications
  • Opportunity to create and maintain Service Oriented Architecture (SOACS) services for Oracle EBS and Oracle Cloud
  • Testing the end-to-end solution to ensure complete satisfaction of internal and external users
  • Develop simple to complex programs on supported database and ETL technologies
  • Mentor and guide junior members of the team
  • Completing projects based on Agile SDLC methodology

,

Qualifications:

  • Experience implementing and configuring WMS Oracle (I.e Oracle reports/forms/labels)
  • Five plus years of development experience to include PL/SQL.
  • Have strong SQL, PL/SQL, relational database, and ETL knowledge and hands on experience
  • Knowledge of Supply Chain services, strategy and processes will be preferred
  • Oracle EBS experience is a plus
  • Knowledge of other supply chain modules like OM, Finance etc.
  • MWA experience and JAVA skills for any MWA development or debugging
  • Experience with AI code assist tools
  • Web DEV experience or willingness to learn is a plus
  • Ability to use Tools for virtual work and collaboration such as MS Teams and Webex
  • Ability to be self-directed and self-motivated
  • Ability to thrive in a very agile environment with evolving requirements
  • Ability to be innovative, have outside-the-box creativity, and present alternative ideas
  • To be a good active listener and communicator

Certain states and localities require employers to post a reasonable estimate of salary range. A reasonable estimate of the current base pay range for this position is $82,000.00 to $123,000.00 annually. Actual salary will be based on a variety of factors, including shift, location, experience, skill set, performance, licensure and certification, and business needs. The range for this position in other geographic locations may differ. Certain positions may also be eligible for variable incentive compensation, such as bonuses or commissions, that is not included in the base pay.

The well-being of WWT employees is essential. So, when it comes to our benefits package, WWT has one of the best. We offer the following benefits to all full-time employees:

  • Health and Wellbeing: Heath, Dental, and Vision Care, Onsite Health Centers, Employee Assistance Program, Wellness program
  • Financial Benefits: Competitive pay, Profit Sharing, 401k Plan with Company Matching, Life and Disability Insurance, Tuition Reimbursement
  • Paid Time Off: PTO and Sick Leave (starting at 20 days per year) & Holidays (10 per year), Parental Leave, Military Leave, Bereavement
  • Additional Perks: Nursing Mothers Benefits, Voluntary Legal, Pet Insurance, Employee Discount Program

We strive to create an environment where all employees are empowered to succeed based on their skills, performance, and dedication. Our goal is to cultivate a culture of belonging that encourages innovation, collaboration, and respect for all team members, ensuring that WWT remains a great place to work for All!

Team members never stop striving to make Maverik a great place to work, a great operator for our customers and a great growth company.
descriptionHtml:
At Maverik, we don’t just offer jobs, we offer adventures.

As a Senior Data Engineer, you’ll help shape how data moves, connects, and supports decisions across Maverik. You’ll build and maintain data pipelines, integrations, and data models while working hands-on with complex SQL/T-SQL, data warehousing, and enterprise data. This is an opportunity to take ownership of meaningful data engineering work, solve complex problems, and work independently across data models and architecture while partnering with teams throughout the business.

Why this role matters

The work you do will help ensure teams across Maverik have reliable, accurate, and accessible data to support reporting and business decisions. Your work behind the scenes helps create scalable, dependable data solutions that can continue supporting Maverik as our technology and business needs evolve.

Location/Schedule

This role is based at Maverik’s Salt Lake City headquarters. Company policy requires employees in this role to work on-site at least four days each week, with the option to work remotely one day per week. The four-day on-site requirement is non-negotiable.

What You’ll Do In This Role

  • Develop and maintain efficient and scalable data infrastructures that can integrate new technologies
  • Collaborate with data analysts, BI analysts, application developers, PMO, and business users to develop and implement complex data integration requirements
  • Perform complex database programming by writing SQL stored procedures on large-scale databases
  • Develop API processes to pull third-party data using Python
  • Assist with the optimization of the data warehouse environment to support efficient access and reporting on enterprise data
  • Proactively analyze and address query/job performance bottlenecks
  • Implement security measures to protect sensitive data and ensure compliance with data privacy regulations
  • Troubleshoot production issues during and after business hours to ensure SLAs are properly met

Duties and responsibilities, as required by business necessity may be added, deleted, or changed at any time at the discretion of management, formally or informally, either verbally or in writing. Scheduling and shift assignments and work location may be changed at any time, as required by business necessity.

You’ll be a great fit for this adventure if you have:

  • 7+ years experience working as a Data Engineer
  • Experience with tools and technologies we use:
  • Expert level in SQL (MS SLQL/TSQL, MySQL) and stored procedures
  • Ability to anticipate customer needs and gives high priority to customer satisfaction and customer service
  • Ability to adapt to changing circumstances, tasks, responsibilities and people to achieve optimum results
  • A record of looking beyond the obvious to identify the root cause and simplify complicated processes and find ways to improve work processes and select the best possible option

Bonus Points If You Also Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related degree, preferred
  • Experience with Python
  • Experience with Java a plus
  • Experience working in a scrum environment a plus

Compensation & Benefits

Pay Range: $110,000-$120,000/year + DOE and Bonus Opportunities

The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Maverik considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers, such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidates experience, education, skills, and current market conditions.

Benefits Include

  • Full Health, Dental, and Vision Package with company contribution to cost
  • In-Store and Fuel Discounts
  • Retirement plan with company match (401K)
  • Eligible for the annual incentive bonus program
  • Profit Sharing: When Maverik succeeds, so do you. Team Members are eligible for annual profit sharing—our way of recognizing the important role you play in our success
  • Comprehensive Paid Time-Off Policy, along with additional perks and benefits

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

We are currently looking for a SQL Developer / Data Analyst for a 100% remote position supporting a large federal government healthcare modernization project. This role will support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) by providing SQL development, data analysis, reporting, and data quality monitoring for ongoing electronic health record (EHR) modernization initiatives. The developer will work with large clinical and operational datasets, supporting data migration, integration, validation, and business intelligence reporting using SQL Server, Power BI, and related technologies.

The position operates within a remote, multidisciplinary Agile team, collaborating with software developers, data engineers, quality assurance personnel, and federal stakeholders. The developer will participate in data analysis, reporting, validation, and continuous improvement activities to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of healthcare data throughout modernization and migration efforts.

The candidate must reside within the continental US.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize advanced SQL queries, scripts, and transformation logic to support data extraction, validation, reconciliation, and analysis across large clinical and operational datasets within SQL Server environments.
  • Analyze and interpret healthcare data from multiple systems, identify trends and anomalies, and develop reports, dashboards, and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, Excel, and related business intelligence tools to support program reporting and decision-making.
  • Collaborate with developers, data engineers, and program stakeholders to evaluate data flows, source-to-target mappings, transformation requirements, and conceptual and physical data models supporting federal healthcare data warehouses and integration initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain data quality monitoring processes, validation routines, and reconciliation reports to assess data completeness, accuracy, consistency, and timeliness throughout migration and EHR modernization activities.
  • Investigate data discrepancies, perform exploratory data analysis and root cause investigations, document findings, and maintain technical documentation, including data dictionaries, mapping specifications, runbooks, and validation protocols.
  • Support recurring reporting deliverables and evaluate AI-assisted tools for SQL optimization, automated data quality checks, anomaly detection, and technical documentation while validating generated outputs and maintaining data security and quality standards.
  • Take on additional tasks and responsibilities as needed to support team objectives and ensure the success of the project.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field from an accredited college or university recognized by the U.S. Department of Education or eight (8) years of additional relevant experience in lieu of a degree, with a minimum of five (5) years of relevant professional experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience developing advanced SQL queries, scripts, and data extraction processes using Microsoft SQL Server, including working with large, complex datasets and optimizing query performance.
  • Experience analyzing healthcare or clinical datasets, including familiarity with healthcare data standards and systems such as HL7, FHIR, or VistA, and supporting data validation, transformation, and integration activities.
  • Strong understanding of relational database structures, data modeling, indexing, normalization, and performance tuning, with experience developing reports and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, or Microsoft Excel.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail and the ability to identify data discrepancies, investigate root causes, and ensure data accuracy and integrity.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, documentation, and collaboration skills with the ability to present technical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and work effectively within multidisciplinary teams.

Additional Qualifications

  • Previous experience supporting Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) healthcare data systems, including VX130, Oracle Health Millennium, or the Corporate Data Warehouse (CDW), and familiarity with InterSystems IRIS, Caché, mirrored database architectures, or EHR data migration and cutover verification activities.
  • Experience working within Agile development environments using JIRA, Azure DevOps, or similar tools, with knowledge of healthcare data governance, metadata management, source-to-target mapping, data quality monitoring, and technical documentation practices.
  • Experience using AI-assisted tools such as GitHub Copilot to develop and optimize SQL queries, generate data validation and reconciliation scripts, identify anomalies, analyze trends, and produce technical documentation, with an understanding of AI output validation, PHI/PII protection, and responsible AI practices within federal healthcare environments.

Security Clearance Requirements

  • U.S. Citizenship is required.
  • All selected candidates must successfully complete a background check.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Government/Public Trust clearance, including required fingerprinting, when required for the position.

Benefits

  • Medical/Dental/Vision
  • 401k with Employer Match
  • PTO + Federal Holidays
  • Corporate Laptop
  • Training Opportunities
  • Remote Opportunity

VetsEZ is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status.

Description

Columbia Technology Partners is seeking a Senior Oracle Database Engineer to support the development, troubleshooting, optimization, and sustainment of enterprise-scale Oracle database applications and data integration solutions. This role is heavily focused on hands-on Oracle SQL and PL/SQL development, production issue resolution, script remediation, ad hoc data analysis, and the maintenance of critical data feeds and integration endpoints. The ideal candidate combines deep Oracle development expertise with strong database troubleshooting and performance tuning experience, along with working knowledge of Oracle administration technologies that support high-availability production environments. In this role, you will work closely with developers, DBAs, infrastructure teams, application owners, and business stakeholders to resolve complex production issues, optimize database performance, support application releases, and maintain data integrations leveraging Oracle, Apache NiFi, AWS services, APIs, and file-based interfaces.

Key Responsibilities

  • Debug, analyze, and resolve complex Oracle SQL, PL/SQL, data-processing, and production-support issues across development, test, and production environments.
  • Review, refactor, optimize, and maintain SQL and PL/SQL code, including packages, procedures, functions, triggers, batch jobs, and database interfaces.
  • Develop ad hoc queries and scripts to support investigations, reporting, reconciliation efforts, data validation, operational requests, and issue resolution activities.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain enterprise data feeds and integrations involving Oracle databases, Apache NiFi, AWS services, APIs, file-based transfers, and dependent applications.
  • Investigate failed data flows, perform root-cause analysis, reconcile source and target system discrepancies, and coordinate remediation efforts across technical teams.
  • Tune SQL and PL/SQL workloads using execution-plan analysis, indexing strategies, partitioning, optimizer statistics, and Oracle performance diagnostic tools.
  • Support production deployments, database releases, post-deployment validation activities, and operational readiness processes.
  • Partner with Oracle DBAs to support RAC environments, backup and recovery operations, Data Guard configurations, security controls, monitoring activities, and incident response efforts.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, deployment procedures, troubleshooting guides, support runbooks, and operational process documentation.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience developing and supporting Oracle Database solutions, including advanced SQL and PL/SQL development.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; four years of additional experience may be substituted for a degree.
  • Experience troubleshooting production issues, tuning database performance, and supporting high-volume data processing environments.
  • Familiarity with enterprise integrations utilizing Apache NiFi, AWS services, APIs, and file-based data exchanges.
  • Working knowledge of Oracle RAC, RMAN, Data Guard, database security, and software release management practices.

descriptionHtml:
About the Role

We're looking for a developer with equal strength in C# / .NET application development and hands-on SQL Server development, who thinks in data and system design and uses AI daily. You'll own web applications, REST APIs, and services alongside database development: writing and tuning stored procedures, building vendor data-load pipelines, managing table partitions, maintaining the stored-procedure API our web applications call, and shipping versioned release scripts.

You'll build new application features and modernize legacy systems, including migrating Visual FoxPro business logic into C# / .NET and T-SQL. This is a hands-on role spanning application and database design, with room to influence architecture and set the standard for AI-augmented development across the team.

About Star Media

For 38 years, Star Media has built the software and data services national TV networks use to analyze ratings from Nielsen, VideoAmp, iSpot and Comscore: a trusted, widely used platform networks rely on to inform their research, sales, and programming decisions. We are part of Banyan Software, so you get the stability of a larger company with the feel of a small team in Dunedin, on the Tampa Bay coast. You will work directly with leadership, and your work will be seen.

What You'll Do

•     Own C# / .NET features from design through testing and release: build web applications, REST APIs, and services across our four-layer ASP.NET Core solution (API, data, core domain, and data-services layers)

•     Design, write, and maintain complex T-SQL stored procedures that efficiently compute and return audience metrics over large, partitioned tables: multi-step set-based logic, CTEs, window functions, PIVOT, table-valued parameters, and dynamic SQL where it's justified

•     Tune queries and indexes on tables with tens of millions of rows: read execution plans, fix parameter-sniffing and cardinality problems, and choose clustered and covering indexes

•     Modernize legacy Visual FoxPro code by reverse-engineering business logic and reimplementing it cleanly in C# / .NET and T-SQL

•     Write high-performance data access against SQL Server using stored procedures and ORMs, including JSON streaming for large result sets

•     Build and maintain Windows desktop tooling (WinForms/WPF) and application business logic alongside our web services

•     Use AI tooling (Claude Code, Claude, and similar) daily to accelerate development, code review, design, and legacy-code archaeology, and help raise the whole team's bar for doing so

•     Manage work through Azure DevOps: repos, pipelines, boards, and pull requests

•     Take part in a weekly cadence of code review, planning, and continuous improvement

What We're Looking ForRequired

•     4+ years building production C# / .NET applications, with strong modern C# and ASP.NET Core (Web and Web API), plus ADO.NET and ORM data access (such as Entity Framework). You can own application features end to end, from business logic and interfaces to database integration, testing, and release.

•     3+ years of hands-on T-SQL development on SQL Server. You've written stored procedures measured in hundreds of lines, and you can explain what each part does and why.

•     Demonstrated heavy use of AI development tools. You use AI daily and can show us concretely how it's changed the way you build. This is central to how our team operates.

•     Proficiency with Git-based version control with agentic AI tools, including independently managing branches, commits, pull requests, and merge conflicts.

•     Solid software design in practice: layered architecture, separation of concerns, clean interfaces, and SOLID; ability to build maintainable application logic and test it

•     Proven query and index tuning on large datasets: you read execution plans fluently and know when to use WITH RECOMPILE, covering indexes, and page compression

•     Working experience with table partitioning (partition functions and schemes, filegroups, sliding windows), or a strong desire to learn it fast

•     Strong relational modeling and database object design: normalized schemas, keys and constraints, and designing large historical tables so they load, index, and query well

•     Comfortable working in a long-lived codebase with many authors: reading old code, honoring conventions, and leaving change notes

•     Real passion for the craft: you care about clean code and good design, and you're always getting better

Nice to Have

•     Experience with media measurement or ratings data (Nielsen, comScore, VideoAmp, iSpot): dayparts, quarter-hours, demos, telecasts, currencies, commercial minutes

•     Experience with TV ad sales or traffic systems (WideOrbit, DealMaker) and post-buy or stewardship reporting

•     SQL Server operations: SQL Agent, log shipping, Extended Events, Resource Governor, tempdb and memory configuration

•     Blazor or experience with streaming / high-throughput data APIs

•     Visual FoxPro experience, or a track record of modernizing legacy codebases into .NET

•     WinForms, WPF, or other Windows desktop development

•     Azure (App Service, B2C, storage) and building CI/CD pipelines

Who Thrives Here

You'll thrive if you use AI to move faster while owning every line, can untangle decades-old FoxPro logic, and enjoy building clean C# applications as much as well-designed queries. You should be ready to own both application features and database work. If your SQL experience is mostly through an ORM, or AI tools are still something you've been meaning to try, this probably isn't the right fit yet.

You'll also need to be a real team player who thrives with autonomy. We hire people we can trust to own their work and run with it. We don't micromanage, and we expect you to collaborate openly, share what you're learning, and lift the people around you.

Why You'll Like it Here

•     Room to grow into a technical lead over time: architecture ownership, mentoring other developers, and helping shape technical direction as the team grows

•     Influence over architecture and the standard for AI-augmented development across the team

•     Become an expert in a niche few people master: the data behind how TV advertising is bought and sold

•     A direct line to leadership, no layers

•     A long-lived, real-world codebase where your work ships to clients who rely on it

Pay and Benefits

•     Competitive base salary, based on experience

•     50% of health insurance premiums covered, plus a 401(k) with up to 4% match

•     No Florida state income tax

How to Apply

Full-time and on-site in Dunedin, FL. Send your resume and a few lines on the most interesting application or data problem you have solved to careers@star-research.net

Headquartered in King of Prussia, PA, Universal Health Services, Inc. (NYSE: UHS) is one of the nation’s largest and most respected providers of hospital and healthcare services. Since our founding in 1979, UHS has grown steadily into a premier Fortune 500® corporation perennially recognized by multiple esteemed national rating entities. The Corporate Information Services Department is seeking a dynamic and talented Sr. Software Engineer – Epic BI Developer.

The Sr. Software Engineer – Epic BI Developer designs and develops reports and dashboards utilizing Epic reporting tools such as Clarity, Cogito, Caboodle, Slicer Dicer, Radar, and business intelligence tools. Works with SSIS and the development of ETL processes in order to provide consistent, reliable, and automated delivery to the end user. Coordinates the transmission of custom reports to vendors, regulatory agencies, and other reporting applications such as power BI. Responsible for conducting data discovery, analysis, and profiling of data to validate business requirements and provide inputs into functional design while serving as domain expert in Clinical and/or Revenue Cycle business area. Works closely with EMR and Revenue Cycle Analysts to understand operational workflows and data structure. Identifies and manages data quality or integrity issues within the domain and collaborate with business units to design the structure of data solutions, as well as plan their implementation within the team. Troubleshoots and fixes data loads and other issues within Epic and data warehouse and explore new ways to present data insights to end users within a project. Responsible for managing large scale solution commitments to business stakeholders and help develop and maintain the structure of the reporting environment. Fosters informed growth by providing users with the ability to rapidly obtain the data they need. Performs SQL queries and script writing. Works on data flows from source systems to one central EDW platform and creates data models using Integration Services. Utilizes strong skills to create Epic and Tableau dashboards/reports to communicate business metrics, as well as assisting business users with creating their own reports.

Works closely with the Clinical and/or Revenue Cycle teams throughout project life-cycles, ensuring that high-quality, timely and relevant data is available to decision makers across the organization.

Key Responsibilities Include

Solution Development and Design:

  • Designs, develops, implements, and maintains data models to be used by various reporting and data discovery tools. Performance and accuracy are key.
  • Follows established SDLC, change control, release management and incident management processes while developing and deploying standard reports and dashboards.
  • Utilizes established BI data models in order to drive reporting standards, re-use, quality and reporting simplification. Suggests improvements to the data model where applicable.
  • Works collaboratively with the team manager and architects of the team and Project Managers to perform required project tasks with minimal supervision.
  • Completes change requests for new reports and enhancements in a timely manner with high quality.
  • Serves as Technical Lead for medium to large sized projects. Provides guidance to less experienced staff.

Solution Maintenance And Support

  • Ensures that data is available to decision makers through the created reports and dashboards, as well as self-service methods.
  • Interfaces with the user community regarding data model design and support. Treats every person requesting services from the team as a valued customer, both internal and external.
  • Provides technical guidance to business ad-hoc report developers on appropriate usage of the data models and BI tools.
  • Stays current with the needs and operations of the enterprise; provides recommendations on the availability of existing reports and suggests opportunities to improve reporting solutions.
  • Remains technically fluent with new and existing BI tools, process and development techniques.
  • Provides support as needed for software installations and upgrades.
  • Monitors the resolution of maintenance or enhancement issues assigned by the UHS Customer Support Center.
  • Participates in user group forums and knowledge transfer sessions.

Administration And Oversight

  • Provides technical support, assistance and guidance to other team members as required.
  • Keeps management well informed of activities, needs, problems.
  • Tracks on-going work items using work management tools.

Qualifications

Position Requirements:

Knowledge

  • Bachelor’s degree required. Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Data Analytics or related field of study preferred.
  • Epic certification or Accreditation required in Cogito and Clarity Data Model
  • 5+ years of SQL programming and working with relational database experience including:
    • Stored procedure development to support reporting or data warehouse initiatives
    • Database design and administration
    • Performance tuning (SQL code and database architecture)

descriptionHtml:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

The Data Platform team builds and owns highly available, scalable data infrastructure for TRM's products and services. As a Senior Software Engineer on Data Infrastructure (RDBMS), you will develop, operate, and scale the relational database systems that serve data at petabyte scale, helping build a safer financial system for billions of people. This role is uniquely broad at TRM: you own the serving layer end to end, from query performance to cost to availability, on infrastructure that product teams depend on every day.

The Impact You Will Have

  • Keep customer-facing APIs fast and available at five-nines by owning query tuning, index design, and schema optimization on petabyte-scale Postgres/Citus, directly determining whether product teams can serve data in real time
  • Cut storage and compute costs materially by using AI-assisted analysis (pganalyze paired with Claude) to detect compression and data-model opportunities, then shipping validated changes to production
  • Remove team toil by building agentic automation for routine database operations, such as self-serve pgbouncer provisioning, disk scaling, and blue-green deployments, so any engineer can run them safely
  • Protect data integrity and latency by driving agentic validation of database changes before they reach production
  • Keep real-time data flowing by managing CDC pipelines (PeerDB, Fivetran, Debezium) and using AI tooling to debug replication failures faster
  • Shape the next-generation platform by migrating workloads off first-gen infrastructure and prototyping new data stores with AI-accelerated spikes
  • Raise the whole team's leverage by codifying your workflows into AI-native runbooks and internal tooling that teammates reuse

What We're Looking For

  • 5–8 years building and operating production PostgreSQL (Citus, Aurora, AlloyDB, or equivalent distributed Postgres)
  • Deep SQL optimization skills (Explain Plans, CTEs, window functions, partitioning, index design, query-planner behavior in distributed environments), increasingly paired with AI-assisted query analysis
  • Hands-on experience with CDC tools (PeerDB, Fivetran, Debezium, Datastream, Airbyte) and comfort using AI tooling to debug replication failure modes
  • Fluency with database profiling (pganalyze or equivalent) to interpret metrics and logs, including using LLMs to summarize performance findings
  • Production automation experience in Python or Go, including agentic automation of routine database tasks; Postgres extension development is a plus
  • Daily use of AI coding tools (Claude, Copilot) to accelerate development and produce higher-quality output faster, with the judgment to know when to trust or reject AI output
  • A track record of using AI-assisted analysis to drive measurable cost or performance improvements in production database systems

About The Team

  • The Data Platform team is distributed, not distant. We operate async-first across US and Canada working hours with intentional synchronous touchpoints when speed demands it
  • We own the petabyte-scale data infrastructure that powers TRM's products. The scope is large, the mission is real, and the work is technically demanding
  • Team culture is product-focused, customer-focused, coaching-oriented, scrappy when needed, and process-oriented when executing against OKRs
  • You will work alongside senior engineers who care deeply about their craft and hold high standards for code quality, operational excellence, and cross-team communication

Team Operating Rhythms

  • Distributed, not distant: most collaboration happens async in Slack, Notion, and GitHub, and meetings are purposeful and minimal
  • Primary timezone overlap across US and Canada working hours; our north star is no IC spending more than 3–4 hours per week in meetings
  • Written-first culture: technical specs and decision docs drive alignment before code

On Call Requirements

  • ⚠️ On Call Requirements — Pending Regional Compliance Review. This role carries an on-call rotation (approximately once every 15 days; each shift is a 24-hour window across 2 days). On-call is clear to proceed for United States; the Canada portion requires People Ops / Deel provincial confirmation before this section is finalized and posted. See the On-Call Compliance note in the Post-Fill Summary.

Learn About TRM Speed In This Position

  • Within 30 days, eliminate a single point of failure by shipping self-serve scaling automation (pgbouncer provisioning, disk resizing) that any teammate can run, freeing senior engineering time
  • Within the first quarter, identify a compression opportunity with AI-assisted analysis, validate it with a proof of concept, and ship it to production for a measurable storage-cost reduction with zero availability impact
  • Within 90 days, coordinate a schema change across three product-engineering teams in parallel and deliver the platform changes ahead of a product deadline so a customer feature ships on time

The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role:

  • Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only.
  • The estimated base salary range for this role is $200,000 - $220,000
  • Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.
  • Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States.

Work Week Travel: This role requires participation in in-person R&D work weeks, typically 1–2 times per quarter, at a TRM hub or other designated location. Work weeks may be scheduled with as little as 14 days’ notice, and some roles may require additional travel based on team and cross-functional needs. TRM coordinates and covers approved travel, lodging, and workspace. Accommodations are available for legitimate caregiving, health, immigration, and similar constraints.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.
  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.
  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.
  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.
  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.
  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.
  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI Fluency Means You Are Among The Top 10 Percent Of Operators In Your Function In How You Apply AI To

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows
  • Structure and solve problems
  • Improve output quality
  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, You Should Expect

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly
  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity
  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability
  • Close collaboration across teams and functions
  • Frequent, high-touch communication
  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking
  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.
  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.
  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy And Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI Fluency Means You Are Among The Top 10 Percent Of Operators In Your Function In How You Apply AI To



- Accelerate repeatable workflows
- Structure and solve problems
- Improve output quality
- Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, You Should Expect



- Priorities and targets to change quickly
- Operating with a high degree of ambiguity
- A high level of personal ownership and accountability
- Close collaboration across teams and functions
- Frequent, high-touch communication
- Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking
- A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.



- Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.
- Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.
- Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: Yes

CLEARANCE TYPE: Top Secret

TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

About our organization: You'll be joining our growing Aurora Software department which has 200+ Software Engineer, DevOps Engineer, Systems Administrator, Database Administrator, and Network Engineer peers from entry-level to the most senior chief engineers and architects. We have plenty of opportunities for career advancement into higher level technical roles or leadership positions. Our Software Department is part of a larger organization that includes Systems Engineering, Integration, and Test staff as well as a Hardware Engineering unit. This larger organization influences cross-program collaboration, professional development and training, as well as engagement and inclusion activities such as lunch-n-learns, campus events, and leadership mixers.

We are seeking a level 2 or 3 Database Administrator / Software Engineer with strong Postgres database experience to design, implement, and maintain our backend databases and multiple Stored Procedures. In this role, you will make key technical decisions and collaborate closely with the Program Product Owner and Software development team in an Agile environment, using GitLab for version control and CI/CD.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, development, and maintenance of Production and Test PostgreSQL databases.
  • Architect and maintain DB instances in multiple runtime environments.
  • Guide and support deployments of Databases using Docker Swarm and related tooling.
  • Operations support, handling incidents, investigating production issues, and carrying out follow-up actions.
  • Proficient in Python, with Rust experience as a nice-to-have.
  • Able to design and implement database access layers and automation tooling in close collaboration with the development team.
  • Define and promote engineering best practices (coding/procedure standards, testing, code review).
  • Participate in and often facilitate Agile ceremonies (planning, stand‑ups, reviews, retrospectives).
  • Use Jira for backlog and sprint management, and Confluence for technical documentation.
  • Collaborate via GitLab for source control, code reviews, and integration with CI/CD.
  • Partner with product owners, QA, and DevOps to deliver high‑quality, reliable features.
  • Mentor junior and mid‑level engineers; provide technical guidance and constructive feedback.
  • Communicate clearly with both technical and non‑technical stakeholders and influence technical direction.

Basic Qualifications

  • Level 2: Bachelor’s degree in Science with 2+ years of relative experience; 0+ years with a Master's; An additional 4 years of experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Level 3: Bachelor’s degree in Science with 5+ years of relative experience; 3+ years with a Master's; An additional 4 years of experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Candidate must have active Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility at time of application.
  • Professional experience as a Database Engineer, Database Admin, or Database Architect.
  • Experience with relational databases (schema design, SQL, indexing, performance tuning).
  • Experience with PostgreSQL (advanced querying, optimization, migrations, ORMs).
  • Experience with Python, GitLab, and Linux environments.
  • Solid understanding and experience using modern software development lifecycle, including Agile practices, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps collaboration, and automated testing.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Familiarity with Docker (Dockerfiles, image builds, local development, best practices).
  • Familiarity with Rust for performance‑critical components.
  • Exposure to Docker Swarm or similar container orchestration platforms.
  • Experience or certification as a Scrum Master (facilitating Agile ceremonies, coaching teams).and practical experience with Atlassian Tools (Jira and Confluence) in a team setting.

#SPEnhancedERAP

Primary Level Salary Range: $83,400.00 - $125,200.00

Secondary Level Salary Range: $103,600.00 - $155,400.00

The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.

Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.

The application period for the job is estimated to be 20 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.

For our complete EEO and pay transparency statement, please visit http://www.northropgrumman.com/EEO. U.S. Citizenship is required for all positions with a government clearance and certain other restricted positions.

descriptionHtml:
Attain Partners is an innovative consulting firm dedicated to disrupting the status quo to change the world and improve the lives of those we touch. From strategy to technology and everywhere in between, our experts use their unique skills to advance the important missions of education, nonprofit, healthcare, and state and local government clients.

People are at the center of all we do, and that’s why we empower career growth, provide industry-leading benefits packages, encourage a flexible work environment, and foster a culture of inclusion to support the needs of our team. We share a collective passion for our mission and our people. Guided by our seven core values, The Attain Way, our vision is the foundation of our culture—to be and attain the best.

Attain Partners is seeking an experienced Migration & Integration Developer to support data migration and integration initiatives for Higher Education clients, with a strong emphasis on Advancement and fundraising systems. This role is responsible for designing, developing, testing, and executing SQL-based data migrations and integrations between legacy Advancement platforms, institutional databases, and Salesforce environments. The ideal candidate has deep SQL development expertise, hands-on Salesforce configuration experience, and a strong understanding of Higher Education Advancement data, business processes, and system architecture. All migration and integration development will be performed primarily using SQL and database-native technologies, rather than integration platforms such as MuleSoft or Boomi. Candidates must be comfortable building and maintaining data pipelines, transformation logic, staging tables, stored procedures, and integration processes directly within database environments. The developer will collaborate with technical architects, functional consultants, and client stakeholders to ensure data accuracy, integrity, and successful delivery of migration and integration solutions.

Required Skills

  • Advanced SQL Development: Strong hands-on experience writing complex SQL queries, stored procedures, views, functions, joins, transformations, and data validation scripts.
  • Higher Education Experience: Previous experience working with colleges, universities, or university foundations on enterprise data initiatives.
  • Advancement Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of fundraising, donor management, gift processing, alumni relations, constituent management, and Advancement business processes.
  • Salesforce Configuration: Hands-on experience navigating and configuring Salesforce, including standard and custom objects, fields, relationships, validation rules, flows, and data models.
  • SQL-Based Data Migration: Experience developing extract, transform, and load (ETL) processes using SQL, including staging tables, source-to-target mappings, data transformations, reconciliation, and incremental data loads.
  • SQL-Based Data Integration: Experience building and supporting database-driven integrations, including scheduled data exchanges, incremental updates, error handling, and monitoring.
  • Data Mapping & Transformation: Ability to interpret source-to-target mapping specifications and translate business requirements into executable SQL transformation logic.
  • Data Quality & Validation: Experience developing reconciliation queries, duplicate identification logic, record-count validation, and exception reporting.
  • Database Expertise: Strong working knowledge of relational database technologies, including Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, or PostgreSQL.
  • Troubleshooting: Ability to independently diagnose and resolve data, SQL performance, transformation, and integration issues.
  • Client Collaboration: Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with client technical and functional teams.

Desired Skills

  • Experience with Higher Education Advancement platforms, such as Ellucian Advance, Kindsight ascend, Blackbaud CRM/Raiser's Edge, Banner Advancement, or Salesforce Education Cloud.
  • Familiarity with Advancement data structures, including constituents, households, relationships, gifts, pledges, payments, designations, campaigns, and recognition credits.
  • Experience migrating legacy Advancement platforms to Salesforce or Kindsight ascend.
  • Experience with Salesforce Data Loader, Bulk API, and Salesforce data import/export processes.
  • Experience with Salesforce SOQL and Salesforce object relationships.
  • Experience with Microsoft SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), SQL Server Agent, or equivalent database scheduling technologies.
  • Experience developing reusable SQL scripts, data migration frameworks, and automated validation processes.
  • Understanding of data governance, data stewardship, data quality, and master data management principles.
  • Experience supporting mock migrations, user acceptance testing (UAT), cutover, and production deployments.
  • Familiarity with Git or other source control solutions for managing SQL development.

Years of Experience

  • 5+ years of professional experience in SQL development, database development, data migration, or data integration.
  • 3+ years of experience supporting Higher Education institutions, preferably within Advancement, fundraising, or alumni relations.
  • 2+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience, including data model configuration, data loading, and troubleshooting.
  • Demonstrated experience completing at least one enterprise data migration or integration initiative involving a Higher Education Advancement system.

Certifications (Preferred but not required)

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate or Azure Data Engineer Associate
  • Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator
  • Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder
  • Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant
  • Oracle Database SQL Certified Associate or equivalent database certification

Additional Requirements

  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted advisor relationships with clients
  • Experience supporting sales and business development
  • Position requires flexibility to travel periodically based on business and client needs

Additional Information

Attain Partners values your mental, emotional, and physical health and wellbeing. Our comprehensive benefits package starts on your first day of employment and includes benefits such as:

  • Competitive health, dental, and vision coverage, HSA and FSA accounts, life and disability insurance, fertility and family planning benefits, and employee assistance and discount programs
  • 11 paid federal holidays and flexible unlimited time off (UTO)
  • Generous 401(k) matching with immediate vesting
  • Flexible career paths – our career tracks provide advancement, mobility, and flexibility as you continue to grow with us
  • A healthy environment where we value unique experiences, and care about everything that makes you, you.

Attain Partners is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The individual base salary for this position is unique to each candidate and will be commensurate with experience, education, and skills. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for an annual discretionary bonus.Interested in this position but the compensation isn’t quite right? Let us know your expectations, and we’ll see if we can make it happen based on your qualifications.

Salary Range: $120,000 USD - $130,000 USD

Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws. For more Information visit EEO, EEO Poster Supplement, Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA), and Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA).

descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about human space exploration, understanding the origins of the universe, and working with a passionate and diverse team to make a difference? If you are, we need you!

We need your talent, teamwork, and energy to help us achieve great things that inspire people all over the globe. We need you to bring creative ideas and diverse backgrounds to help us envision, shape, and deliver systems that will enable the exploration of space while benefiting people here on Earth. Description

About Peregrine

Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA.

Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership.

We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people.

As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become.

People first. Ownership always.

We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else.

At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk.

At Peregrine Advisors, you will design and build the data layer for a federal enterprise platform. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are.

This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination.

Your first project

Your First Project Will Likely Have You Taking Responsibility For The Accuracy And Performance Of Your Assigned Components. Depending On The Assignment, You May

  • Design database schemas, and write the views, stored procedures, functions, and Structured Query Language (SQL) queries that run on them.
  • Build and maintain data pipelines and extract, transform, and load (ETL) and extract, load, and transform (ELT) processes, including loads from Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3).
  • Make queries and databases fast enough for high-volume workloads.
  • Help model data across Amazon Web Services (AWS) stores such as Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL-compatible), Amazon DynamoDB, and S3.
  • Keep data accurate and secure, with governed access and changes that can be audited.
  • Work out data access patterns and integrations with developers, architects, and data engineers.
  • Where the work allows, use artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted tools for query, pipeline, and troubleshooting work, and review and validate what they produce.

You deliver database components accurate and fast enough that analysts and systems trust them. You automate the loads and checks that used to be run by hand, and you build models that keep working as the platform grows.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of data engineering, database development, database engineering, software development, or comparable practical experience
  • Bachelor's degree
  • SQL skills across complex queries, views, stored procedures, and functions, together with relational design, normalization, and data modeling
  • Working expertise in Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL-compatible), covering schema design, stored procedures and functions, and indexing
  • Experience with Amazon DynamoDB, covering data modeling and Global and Local Secondary Indexes (GSIs and LSIs)
  • Performance and query tuning that addresses slow queries through indexing and execution-plan work
  • Experience making logical data modeling and database-design decisions for assigned components within an established platform architecture
  • ETL and ELT development and data integration across AWS data services such as Aurora, DynamoDB, and S3
  • Experience working within data security controls such as encryption, access management, and auditing
  • Experience loading data from S3 into the platform stores and connecting through Open Database Connectivity (ODBC) and Java Database Connectivity (JDBC)
  • Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel

Preferred

  • An AWS certification at the associate level, such as Developer Associate or Solutions Architect Associate
  • Experience tuning queries that involve locking and deadlocks
  • Familiarity with supporting cloud-native applications in AWS through continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) and development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) practices
  • Ownership of physical design for Aurora and DynamoDB schemas and indexes, or the drive to grow into it
  • Experience in federal information technology or high-volume transaction environments
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted developer tools

Who You Are

You enjoy building with SQL and take responsibility for getting data right. You can take a database problem from design through delivery and stand behind how your work performs. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task.

What You Bring

  • Solid SQL on a modern relational platform, Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL-compatible), with stored procedures, functions, and views that hold up in use.
  • Practical skill in query tuning against slow queries, indexing, and execution plans, together with data loading, connectivity, version control, and clean delivery.
  • Practical experience developing logical data models and database schemas, and making database-design decisions for assigned components within the established platform architecture.
  • The ability to own assigned database work from design through maintenance, working within data security controls, with sound judgment where accuracy and auditability are not optional.

When we talk

Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned.

Benefits

This is a full-time W-2 position with a salary of $120,000 to $140,000 per year.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer-paid life, accidental death, and short-term and long-term disability insurance; a 401(k) with an employer match of up to 4% of salary; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.

What We Offer

You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship.

What We Commit To

As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better.

We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.

Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer.
