Description

Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides companies of all sizes with an infrastructure web services platform in the cloud. Amazon Redshift is a rapidly growing, fast, fully managed, petabyte-scale data warehouse service in the cloud. It enables customers to dramatically increase their query performance when analyzing virtually any size data set using the same SQL-based business intelligence tools they use today. No other data warehouse makes it as easy to gain new insights. With Redshift customers can query petabytes of structured and semi-structured data across their data warehouse and data lake using standard SQL.

Amazon Redshift is the most popular and fastest cloud data warehouse. It is integrated with customers data lake, offers up to 3x faster performance than any other data warehouse, and costs up to 75% less than any other cloud data warehouse.

Joining the Amazon Redshift team gives you the opportunity to:

  • Work on a disruptive product that’s still in its early stages
  • Solve challenging problems that will revolutionize database computing in the cloud
  • Build a product that will leverage the scale of resources available in the cloud
  • Work for a company that’s a recognized leader in the cloud computing space
  • Be involved in the fast growing, big data space

We are looking for senior database engineers that are passionate about data warehousing, and love to work with customers to help them with database design, usage patterns and performance.

We Expect Candidates To Be Able To

  • Demonstrate in-depth knowledge of database or data warehouse systems internals including relational database design and distributed databases/MPP architectures
  • Lead strategic data architecture & database design discussions with customers
  • Drive and oversee workload analysis, performance benchmarking and troubleshooting efforts with customers in their environments
  • Clearly communicate deep technical topics to customers
  • Influence the engineering team roadmap towards building a product that is scalable, easy to use and build on, and addresses customer needs
  • Conduct POC’s with customers in competitive situations
  • Leverage good coding/scripting skills to automate tasks and improve workload analysis mechanisms

ABOUT AWS:

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field or equivalent
  • 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
  • Experience in writing complex, highly-optimized SQL queries across large datasets
  • Knowledge of overall system architecture, scalability, reliability, and performance in a database environment
  • Experience with large-scale data analytics and data warehousing

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in software development, or experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or experience in external enterprise customer-facing role as a technical lead, with strong oral and written communication skills, presenting to both large and small audiences

descriptionHtml:
ASRC Federal is a leading government contractor furthering missions in space, public health and defense. As an Alaska Native owned corporation, our work helps secure an enduring future for our shareholders. Join our team and discover why we are a top veteran employer and Certified Great Place to Work™

ASRC Federal is seeking a Senior Backend Software Engineer with strong experience in ETL development and relational database performance for a remote, full-time position

This role will design, develop, and optimize data pipelines and the database backend supporting our applications. Primary responsibilities include implementing data ingestion and transformation workflows, developing ORM-based data access using Java persistence frameworks, and optimizing SQL and database operations.

The ideal candidate is passionate about building robust, scalable systems. They bring strong software engineering fundamentals and can troubleshoot performance across Java application code, ORM-generated queries, and relational databases. Backend services and API development will support data integration, processing, and retrieval.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain Java-based ETL workflows that extract, transform, validate, and load data from databases, APIs, files, and other source systems.
  • Implement data cleansing, transformation, deduplication, and reconciliation to ensure accurate and consistent downstream data.
  • Develop incremental loading, batching, retry, and recovery processes that support reliable execution and safe reprocessing without duplicate records
  • Build and maintain ORM-based data access layers using Java persistence frameworks such as JPA/Hibernate, including entity mappings, relationships, and transaction management.
  • Develop and optimize SQL queries supporting application functionality and data processing.
  • Inspect SQL generated by JPA/Hibernate in Spring applications and analyze database execution plans to identify inefficient joins, excessive database calls, unnecessary data retrieval, and other performance bottlenecks.
  • Improve database performance through appropriate indexing, query restructuring, batching, pagination, and relationship-loading strategies.
  • Design and maintain relational schemas, constraints, indexes, and versioned database migrations.
  • Select ORM operations, parameterized SQL, or database-native bulk operations according to workload, maintainability, and performance requirements.
  • Implement and optimize OpenSearch or Elasticsearch queries, filters, and aggregations; troubleshoot search performance and maintain consistency between source data and search indexes.
  • Monitor pipeline reliability, data quality, processing throughput, and query response times; troubleshoot production issues and demonstrate measurable improvements.
  • Create automated tests for transformation logic, database interactions, data integrity, and recovery behavior
  • Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to define requirements, document data mappings, and review database and pipeline designs.
  • Design, develop, and maintain GraphQL APIs and resolvers to support efficient data retrieval and integration with backend services and relational databases.
  • Develop and optimize database integrations using Amazon Aurora within Amazon RDS in AWS, including connection management, schema migrations, ETL workflows, and query performance tuning,

Required Technical Qualifications

  • Strong Java development experience building and supporting production backend applications.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, developing, and maintaining ETL pipelines and data integration workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Java Spring ORM and persistence frameworks such as JPA/Hibernate.
  • Experience writing and optimizing JPQL and SQL queries, including troubleshooting ORM-generated SQL.
  • Strong SQL proficiency, including complex joins, common table expressions, window functions, aggregations, and set-based processing.
  • Experience analyzing database execution plans and improving query performance through indexing and query changes.
  • Experience with relational data modeling, schema migrations, entity relationships, and transaction management.
  • Understanding of database isolation levels, locking, and concurrency.
  • Experience implementing data validation, incremental processing, error handling, and recoverable data workflows.
  • Experience with version control, code review, automated testing, and software deployment practices.
  • Ability to explain production performance improvements using measured results.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with workflow orchestration, job scheduling, change data capture, and pipeline monitoring.
  • Experience diagnosing ORM performance issues such as N+1 queries, inefficient relationship loading, and excessive entity loading.
  • Experience processing large datasets within defined delivery windows while managing database resource utilization.
  • Familiarity with Apache Spark for ETL and distributed data processing.

Education

BS/BA degree (or equivalent) plus 8-10 years experience in related field.

We invest in the lives of our employees, both in and out of the workplace, by providing competitive pay and benefits packages. Benefits offered may include health care, dental, vision, life insurance; 401(k); education assistance; paid time off including PTO, holidays, and any other paid leave required by law. The salary offered will depend on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, education, geographic location, internal equity, business needs, and other factors permitted by law. Posted pay ranges are a general guideline only and are not a guarantee of compensation or salary.

descriptionHtml:

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As an Application Developer specializing in RDBMS, you will create and maintain database applications for various platforms, including Linux, Unix, and Windows. You will utilize your expertise in writing code in PL/SQL, T-SQL, and DB2 application development for LUW to design, develop, and test database applications.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

  • Design Database Applications: Design efficient, secure, and reliable database applications that meet the required specifications, utilizing your knowledge of database concepts, data modeling, and SQL programming.
  • Develop Database Code: Write high-quality code in PL/SQL, T-SQL, and DB2 for LUW, ensuring database applications are functional and meet performance expectations.

  • Ensure Data Security: Ensure database applications are secure, adhering to best practices and guidelines to protect sensitive data and prevent unauthorized access.

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • RDBMS Application Development: Exposure to designing, developing, and testing database applications for various platforms, including Linux, Unix, and Windows.
  • Database Programming: Experience working with PL/SQL, T-SQL, and DB2 application development for LUW, with a strong understanding of database concepts, data modeling, and SQL programming.
  • Database Security: Exposure to ensuring database applications are secure, adhering to best practices and guidelines to protect sensitive data and prevent unauthorized access.
  • Database Performance Optimization: Experience working with testing and optimizing database applications to ensure they are running efficiently and effectively.
  • Database Design Principles: Exposure to designing efficient, secure, and reliable database applications that meet the required specifications.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

  • Multi-Platform Development: Exposure to developing database applications for multiple platforms, including Linux, Unix, and Windows.
  • Preferred Skills: Unix, Sybase, SQL server, Snowflake, Python, Snowspark, Pyspark, Java, .NET, Informatica.

descriptionHtml:
EXCO Resources, Inc. is a private independent oil and natural gas company engaged in the acquisition, development and exploitation of onshore North American properties. Our principal operations are conducted in certain key U.S. oil and natural gas areas including Texas, Louisiana and the Appalachia region. Our headquarters are in Dallas, TX.


We are currently looking for a Database Engineer in the IT Department, to be based in our Dallas office.



Primary Objective: Seeking a detail-oriented and motivated Database Engineer to support, design, maintain, and help modernize the Microsoft SQL Server databases, data integrations, and reporting data behind our E&P business applications. The role combines hands-on database administration with data modeling and integration work, and works directly with land, accounting, production, engineering, and geoscience teams to make sure data is accurate, consistent, and available for reporting and decision-making. This hands-on position reports to the IT Director and works closely with our Enterprise Data Platform Architect.


Major Functions and Scope:

▪     Support and maintain SQL Server databases for E&P business applications, including installation, configuration, patching, and backups

▪     Implement, maintain, and test high availability and disaster recovery for SQL Server, including regular failover and restore testing

▪     Help modernize the data platform, including SQL Server version upgrades and retiring legacy components

▪     Monitor database performance and handle query tuning, indexing, maintenance jobs, and capacity planning

▪     Administer database security, including logins, roles, and permissions, and work with IT security on auditing and SOX-related data controls

▪     Design and maintain logical and physical data models, including staging, integration, and reporting layers

▪     Build, upgrade, and support data integrations and ETL processes between the ERP, production accounting, well data, field measurement, SCADA, and reserves systems

▪     Keep database code, ETL packages, and reports in source control (Git), and automate routine administration and deployments with PowerShell or Python

▪     Maintain a single trusted source for core business entities such as wells, completions, leases, properties, and cost centers, and help enforce data standards, data quality rules, and the data dictionary, including documentation of data flows and lineage

▪     Develop and maintain SSRS reports, stored procedures, views, and datasets used by TIBCO Spotfire and business applications for drilling, operations, and financial reporting.

▪     Load, validate, and manage third-party data feeds, including commercial well, production, and commodity pricing data

▪     Review new and replacement systems for data impact, and support implementations, data migration, and archival

▪     Assist our Enterprise Data Platform Architect with projects, troubleshooting, production changes, and occasional after-hours maintenance and month-end support.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS


Education and Knowledge:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.

 

Experience:

3+ years of experience working with Microsoft SQL Server in a production environment, including database administration and development.

 

Competencies:

  • Advanced T-SQL skills, including writing and tuning complex queries and stored procedures.
  • Experience with SSIS or a comparable ETL tool and SSRS, including integrating data across business applications with different data models.
  • Working knowledge of backup and recovery, index maintenance, and database security.
  • Experience with relational and dimensional data modeling (star schema).
  • Understanding of data quality, master data management, and data governance practices.

Job Description

This position supports the Center for Educational Performance and Information (CEPI) database environment primary for the Statewide Longitudinal Data System (SLDS) modernization with the Common Education Data Standards (CEDS).

The Database Environment Includes

  • Multiple SQL Server instances
  • Multiple Collection Environments (Development, Quality Assurance/Testing, Pre-Release, and Production)
  • Numerous SQL Reporting Services Servers
  • 35+ collection databases
  • 100+ analysis databases

This position is the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the CEPI SLDS data warehouse and requires considerable independent judgment directing and coordinating the appropriate data administration and management methods, practices, procedures and tools, to complete the required assignments. Expertise is required in Microsoft SQL Server database support, and professional knowledge on CEDS standard.

This position is heavily involved with strategic and tactical information design, the analysis of business areas, security, and data modeling to meet data collection needs and the transition of ETL process from on premise to cloud servers. Responsibility includes the identification, analysis, categorizing, synthesis, design, and productive use of business information. In addition, this position is responsible for enforcing/ensuring that the architectural frameworks are properly implemented and enforced, monitoring and upgrading the server infrastructure that supports the database environment.

Roles And Responsibilities

  • Designs, implements, and continuously expands/maintains data pipelines by performing extraction, transformation, and loading activities. Responsible for data preparation jobs, data analysis and data reporting. Performs technical troubleshooting, root cause analysis and provides technical expertise for ETL jobs. Collaborates with developers. business and other team members to design and deliver correct high-quality data and to provide advice and support.
  • Responsible for data analysis and database management. Involved in maintenance, enhancement, designing of data dictionaries, physical and logical database models, and performance tuning. Knowledge of the utilities and production tools used for data storage management to support the Application Team. Coordinates physical changes to computer databases; codes, tests, and implements physical database, applying knowledge of data base management system.
  • Establishes physical database parameters. Uses structured query language (SQL) to define database objects using database definition language (DDL) and control access to database objects using data control language (DCL). Tests and corrects errors and refines changes to database.
  • Enters SQL to create production data base. Uses database utility programs and 3rd party utilities to monitor database performance, such as distribution of records and amount of available memory. Directs programmers and analysts to make changes to data base management system. Reviews and corrects programs. Answers user questions. Confers with coworkers to determine impact of data base changes on other systems.
  • Evaluates users' requests for new data elements and systems, incorporates them into the existing shared data environment, and provides technical assistance. Coordinates the use of data to ensure data integrity and control redundancy, loads databases, and reorganizes as needed. Performs data modeling and prototyping. Responsible for the development of ETLs. Performs logical and physical data modeling, designs relational database models, and creates physical data models from logical data models. Performs security recovery procedures.
  • Executes the procedures necessary to save, retrieve, and recover databases from hardware and software failures within established procedures. Assists with determining, implementing, and enhancing standards on database security and with monitoring agency disaster recovery procedures and systems.

Top 3 skills needed: Azure Database services, SQL Data Modeling/structure, Extensive ETL development experience.

Minimum Years of experience in the field required: 12 years

Required / Must Have

TSQL: 8-10 years

ETL development: 6-8 years

PowerShell: 5 years

Azure DevOps: 5 years

Scrum: 5 years

Contact

DTS offers excellent compensation package.

Ajay Bharbutta

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Engineer – Database based in United States .

Join a globally distributed engineering team developing critical financial infrastructure for a regulated digital asset derivatives exchange, clearinghouse, and brokerage platform. In this role, you will build and maintain database-driven services that accurately record orders, trades, and settlements. You will contribute to the design of robust data models, PostgreSQL schemas, queries, and migrations, ensuring financial information remains consistent, auditable, and reliable. Working primarily with Haskell-based services, you will collaborate across engineering and operational teams to improve performance and support high-volume financial workflows. This is an opportunity to apply strong software engineering and database expertise to systems where data integrity, precision, and resilience are essential.

Accountabilities

  • Design, develop, test, and deliver well-structured, well-reviewed features and fixes across exchange, clearinghouse, and brokerage services, primarily using Haskell.
  • Understand end-to-end order, trade, clearing, and settlement workflows to ensure reliable data handling across systems.
  • Design database schemas, constraints, and indexes for new features, using precise numeric types and audit trails to preserve financial data integrity.
  • Develop safe, reversible database migrations for large tables, minimizing locking and operational disruption.
  • Review database migrations proposed by other engineers to ensure quality, reliability, and consistency.
  • Analyze query execution plans and production performance metrics to identify bottlenecks and optimize queries, indexes, and data access patterns.
  • Monitor production systems, respond to alerts, and support operational activities such as daily settlement cycles.
  • Investigate production incidents, resolve root causes, and document findings and lessons learned.

Requirements

  • At least 3 years of professional software engineering experience with a functional or strongly typed programming language such as Haskell, Rust, or C++.
  • Strong SQL and PostgreSQL expertise, including a solid understanding of transactions and isolation levels.
  • Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, concurrency, and distributed systems concepts.
  • Understanding of replication, consistency, retries, idempotency, and techniques for maintaining data correctness when distributed services experience failures.
  • Willingness to participate in on-call rotations and operational shifts.
  • High attention to detail and a rigorous approach to developing software and managing data involved in financial transactions.
  • A measurement-driven approach to performance optimization, with the ability to investigate issues before making changes.
  • Good judgment when using AI-assisted development tools, including the ability to review, test, and understand generated code before deployment.
  • Analytical thinking, curiosity, and a habit of understanding the reasons behind technical decisions and problems.
  • Calm, methodical judgment when handling production issues under pressure.
  • Strong collaboration and documentation skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, operations, risk, and compliance teams.

Nice To Have

  • Knowledge of financial services, trading, or financial markets.
  • A bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience with Haskell, particularly in PostgreSQL-backed services.
  • Production experience with AWS Aurora PostgreSQL.
  • Experience handling high-volume time-series or market data, such as tick data, order books, or event streams.
  • Familiarity with Atlas or other declarative database schema management tools.

Benefits

  • Annual target salary range of $96,000–$192,000, depending on skills, experience, and role scope.
  • Equity participation.
  • Eligibility for a bonus program.
  • Additional compensation and benefits may include a wellness allowance and, for eligible US-based employees, medical, dental, vision, and 401(k) benefits.
  • Fully remote, full-time working arrangement.
  • Ongoing application acceptance unless a specific deadline is announced.

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

descriptionHtml:
WEX is looking for a highly experienced Database Engineer to help modernize and scale critical data platforms while supporting the next generation of AI-enabled applications.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who brings deep expertise in SQL Server and T-SQL, combined with the ability to solve complex database performance, scalability, and modernization challenges at enterprise scale.

You will work across large, business-critical data environments, partnering closely with application engineering, SRE, operations, and architecture teams. The role is highly technical and execution-oriented—you will be expected to independently identify problems, drive solutions, and take ownership from design through implementation and production.

The team is also applying modern AI capabilities to database engineering, including AI-assisted development, automation, semantic search, embeddings, and vector-based data infrastructure.

What You'll Do

Database Engineering & Modernization

  • Design, develop, optimize, and modernize large-scale SQL Server databases and data platforms.
  • Analyze and refactor complex T-SQL, stored procedures, functions, and database logic.
  • Identify and resolve database performance bottlenecks through execution-plan analysis, indexing, query optimization, and database tuning.
  • Drive schema improvements and database modernization initiatives that improve scalability, maintainability, and reliability.
  • Develop migration strategies and automation that maintain data integrity and minimize disruption to business-critical systems.
  • Implement and improve data replication and synchronization patterns across transactional and analytical environments.
  • Apply event-driven database patterns such as Change Data Capture (CDC), outbox patterns, and event publishing.

Enterprise-Scale Data Platforms

  • Engineer solutions for large, high-volume databases supporting critical business applications and partners.
  • Work with databases containing terabytes of data and complex data relationships.
  • Develop data pipelines and integration patterns across SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, and cloud data services.
  • Support both OLTP and OLAP environments and optimize data movement between systems.
  • Apply strong understanding of database internals, including indexing, locking, transactions, isolation levels, concurrency, and query optimization

AI-Enabled Database Engineering

  • Use modern AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar tools to accelerate development, analysis, debugging, and modernization.
  • Explore and implement AI-powered approaches for analyzing stored procedures, documenting schemas, and automating database engineering workflows.
  • Contribute to AI-native data infrastructure, including embedding pipelines, vector databases, semantic search, and retrieval systems.
  • Develop data and retrieval capabilities that support AI applications and agentic workflows.
  • Evaluate emerging AI tools and determine where they can improve engineering productivity and data platform capabilities.

Technical Leadership & Ownership

  • Independently lead complex database engineering initiatives from problem definition through production implementation.
  • Serve as a technical resource for complex database and performance challenges.
  • Partner effectively with application engineering, SRE, operations, architecture, and AI/ML teams.
  • Provide technical guidance through code reviews, design discussions, and engineering standards.
  • Mentor other engineers and contribute to the development of database engineering practices.
  • Take ownership of outcomes rather than simply completing assigned tasks.

Production & Problem Solving

  • Participate in resolving high-impact production issues involving critical database systems.
  • Diagnose complex problems using logs, database metrics, CPU/memory utilization, execution plans, and other observability data.
  • Quickly determine root cause, coordinate with the appropriate technical teams, and drive issues through resolution.
  • Balance immediate incident resolution with longer-term improvements that prevent recurrence.

What You'll Bring

Required Experience

  • 15+ years of experience in database engineering, data platform engineering, software engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Deep hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL, including complex stored procedures, query optimization, execution-plan analysis, indexing, and performance tuning.
  • Demonstrated experience modernizing or refactoring legacy database systems, not simply maintaining existing environments.
  • Experience working with large-scale, business-critical databases and high-volume data environments.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, C#, or a similar language for automation, tooling, and data processing.
  • Experience with data pipelines, ETL/ELT, data integration, batch processing, and/or event-driven architectures.
  • Strong understanding of database internals, transaction management, concurrency, locking, and performance optimization.
  • Experience working across engineering teams and independently driving complex technical initiatives.

AI & Modern Data Technologies

  • Experience using AI coding assistants such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Augment, or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, or RAG concepts.
  • Experience with or willingness to build AI-enabled data tooling and automation.
  • Exposure to technologies such as PostgreSQL, Snowflake, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, AWS data services, or similar platforms.

Cloud & Engineering Practices

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code such as Terraform, ARM/Bicep, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with CI/CD, source control, database migrations, schema versioning, and deployment automation.
  • Experience with event streaming technologies such as Kafka is a plus.
  • Familiarity with NoSQL and document databases is a plus.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in payments, financial services, healthcare, benefits, or other highly regulated environments.
  • Experience supporting highly available, customer-facing or business-critical systems.
  • Experience with Oracle PL/SQL in addition to SQL Server.
  • Hands-on experience with RAG, semantic search, vector databases, or AI-agent data infrastructure.
  • Experience building internal engineering tools or automation using AI.

Why This Role Matters

WEX operates at a significant enterprise scale, and our database platforms are foundational to critical customer and business experiences. This role sits at the intersection of deep database engineering, large-scale modernization, cloud data platforms, and emerging AI technologies.

You will have the opportunity to apply proven database engineering expertise to some of the industry's most challenging data problems while helping shape how AI can transform the way modern engineering teams build, operate, and evolve data platforms.

This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to remain deeply technical while operating with the ownership and influence expected at the Senior Staff level.

The base pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the pay range for this position. Actual pay rates will vary and will be based on various factors, such as your qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Base pay is one component of WEX's total compensation package. Most sales positions are eligible for commission under the terms of an applicable plan. Non-sales roles are typically eligible for a quarterly or annual bonus based on their role and applicable plan. WEX's comprehensive and market competitive benefits are designed to support your personal and professional well-being. Benefits include health, dental and vision insurances, retirement savings plan, paid time off, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability insurance, tuition reimbursement, and more. For more information, check out the "About Us" section.

Pay Range: $165,800.00 - $204,400.00

The RoleWe are seeking a Lead Backend Engineer who is passionate about database modernization, performance optimization, and strategic refactoring of mission-critical systems. You will be a key member of the DPS Core & Data Engine Squad, working on the system-of-record platform that powers both internal (DPS) and external (IES) claims management experiences supporting millions of transactions and billions of dollars in claims.

This is a modernization engineering role for someone who gets excited about:

  • Refactoring complex stored procedures and carving out domain logic into maintainable services
  • Optimizing SQL performance and improving system efficiency
  • Creating safe migration patterns that enable continuous modernization while maintaining business continuity
  • Working in .NET codebases and evolving them into clean, testable, domain-aligned modules

If you love the challenge of strategic system evolution and want to participate in evolving the technical architecture of a multi-year transformation from monolithic database logic to service-oriented architecture—this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities:

Database Engineering & Modernization (60%)

Stored procedure refactoring: Analyze, optimize, and decompose complex stored procedures into smaller, testable, well-documented units

  • Performance engineering: Query tuning, indexing strategy, execution plan analysis, optimizing data access patterns
  • Schema evolution: Design backward-compatible schema changes with safe rollout/rollback patterns
  • Migration seams: Create facades, wrappers, and anti-corruption layers around stored procedures to enable gradual extraction of business logic into services

Legacy .NET Modernization (30%)

  • Refactor .NET Framework code supporting DPS workflows into maintainable, testable modules
  • Implement strangler fig patterns to incrementally move logic from database service layer while maintaining production stability
  • Build domain-aligned modules/services with clear contracts that enable the Domain & Services Squad to extract capabilities
  • Establish patterns for dependency injection, observability, and error handling in established .NET codebases

Operational Excellence (10%)

  • Implement performance baselines, regression detection, and alerting for data-intensive workflows
  • Participate in incident response for data/performance-related production issues
  • Create diagnostic tooling and runbooks to reduce time-to-resolution
  • Collaborate with SRE/DevOps on deployment safety (blue/green, feature flags, canary releases for schema changes)

Requirements:

Technical Skills

  • 8+ years of professional software development experience in object-oriented languages (C#/.NET required)
  • Expert-level SQL Server knowledge (SQL Server 2019):
  • Advanced query optimization (execution plans, index tuning, query hints)
  • Stored procedure, function, and trigger development/refactoring
  • Database design and normalization
  • Performance tuning at scale (multi-million row tables, complex joins, aggregations)
  • Understanding of indexing strategies (clustered, non-clustered, filtered, columnstore)
  • SQL Agent jobs and automated workflow patterns
  • Transaction isolation levels, locking, and concurrency management
  • C# and .NET Framework/.NET Core (legacy and modern)
  • Experience refactoring established systems while maintaining production stability
  • SQL source control (migrations, version control for schema/stored procedures)

Highly Desired:

  • Experience with strangler fig, anti-corruption layer, and facade patterns in practice
  • Hands-on experience migrating logic from stored procedures → service layer in production systems
  • Familiarity with domain-driven design (DDD) concepts (bounded contexts, aggregates, repositories)
  • Azure SQL Database, Azure DevOps experience
  • Observability tools (Application Insights, SQL Profiler)
  • API design and versioning (REST, OpenAPI/Swagger)
  • Unit testing frameworks (xUnit, NUnit) and test data builder patterns
  • PowerShell for database scripting/automation
  • Experience with microservices architecture and event-driven patterns
  • Familiarity with Entity Framework Core, Dapper, or other ORMs (and knowing when to use native SQL)

A video interview is required for this position. Video interviews are transcribed. Transcriptions are retained and may be reviewed by CCC and our recruiters. About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Program Overview

Provides, protects, and defends enterprise information services to approximately 45,000 Army, joint and DoD customers across the European theater on a 24 x 7 x 365 days per year basis on classified, unclassified, and coalition networks.

About The Role

Peraton is looking to add a SQL Developer to our ongoing development, maintenance, and data engineering team. We support the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) Data Engineering and Processing (DEAP) project by providing analyses, solutions and maintenance of many processes that ingest financial market data used across multiple CFTC regulatory and analytical systems, including high volume, mission critical data ingest pipelines. These processes and the data ingested are critical to the mission of the CFTC.

This position requires up to three (3) specific days onsite in the Washington DC facility and two (2) teleworking days per week.

What You Will Do:

  • Serve as a member of an Agile team to provide engineering support and maintenance of services and processes that migrate and promote data and algorithms to the AWS cloud environment and supporting cloud databases.
  • Design, code, test and implement AWS cloud-based solutions in SQL.
  • Work with the customer and Peraton team on requirements gathering and task estimation.
  • Perform routine data checks, code development and quality checks.
  • Support database planning, design and implementation.
  • Support systems analysis, design and implementation.
  • Support code reviews and cloud deployments.
  • Provide regular status updates on progress both within the Agile framework and via weekly status reporting.

  • Work with the customer and Peraton team on requirements gathering and task estimation.
  • Perform routine data checks, code development and quality checks.
  • Support database planning, design and implementation.
  • Support systems analysis, design and implementation.
  • Support code reviews and cloud deployments.
  • Provide regular status updates on progress both within the Agile framework and via weekly status reporting.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree and 5 years professional experience; or AS/AA degree and 7 years professional experience; or high school diploma/equivalent and 9 years of professional experience.
  • Familiar with tools such as AWS Cloud databases using SQL Server.
  • Experience with processing XML, CSV and other delimited data files.
  • Knowledge and experience working with Agile team member to provide engineer support and maintenance.
  • Must be US Citizen; must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance and cannot start before cleared.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Active Public Trust or other active clearance.
  • AWS developer experience.
  • Experience in ETL processing.
  • Experience working in an Agile software development environment.
  • Master's degree in business, finance, computer science, statistics or related field and 2 years of experience.

Details

Target Salary Range: $80,000 - $128,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

Application Statements: The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate's own.

Standard Job Description

Delivers full-stack data solutions across the entire data processing pipeline. This relies on systems engineering principles to design and implement solutions that span the data lifecycle to: collect, ingest, process, store, persist, access, and deliver data at scale and at speed. It includes knowledge of local, distributed, and cloud-based technologies; data virtualization and smart caching; and all security and authentication mechanisms required to protect the data.Build data pipelines that clean, transform, and aggregate unorganized data into databases or data sources that are ready for analysis; Design and implement data solutions by defining functional capabilities, security, back-up, and recovery specifications; Work through all stages of a data solution lifecycle, e.g., analyze / profile data, create conceptual, logical and physical data model designs, architect and design ETL, reporting and analytics; Maintain data systems performance by identifying and resolving production and application development problems; calculating optimum values for parameters; evaluating, integrating, and installing new releases; Define standards, best practices, and certification processes for data objects

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of demonstrated experience working with SAP, SAP HANA, Oracle, or SQL Server (example: relational database principles, SQL, SQL Script, PL/SQL, Transact-SQL in support of Procedures, Functions, and Views)
  • Knowledge and experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, and Qlik.
  • Experience with data mining and cleansing, recognizing and correcting errors/discrepancies and ensuring accuracy, consistency, and completeness of data, and/or ETL data warehousing principles
  • Experience with problem-solving and troubleshooting/resolving complex technical issues
  • Background in creating data solutions for Data Analytic products and services at scale and speed
  • Background/working knowledge in multiple languages such as Python, Microsoft (VBA), or others and their various applications and use cases

Desired Skills

  • Experience working with internal and external customers to develop and improve program deliverables, processes, and solutions that solve customer needs
  • Experience in coordinating changes to existing data products with minimal disruption to end-user
  • Knowledge of ERP system functionality
  • Relational database principles and strong SQL
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work with technical and non-technical stakeholders

Our challenge:

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Oracle Developer to design, develop, maintain, and optimize Oracle database solutions that support critical business applications. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Oracle PL/SQL, SQL performance tuning, database development, data modeling, and system integrations. The role requires close collaboration with business stakeholders, architects, and application teams to deliver scalable and high-performing solutions.


Additional Information*

The base salary for this position will vary based on geography and other factors. In accordance with law, the base salary for this role if filled within Charlotte, NC is $110k - $120k/year & benefits (see below).


The Role

Responsibilities:

Design, develop, test, and maintain Oracle database applications and solutions.

Develop complex PL/SQL packages, procedures, functions, triggers, and views.

Create and optimize SQL queries for performance, scalability, and reliability.

Perform database performance tuning and query optimization.

Design and maintain logical and physical data models.

Develop ETL processes and data migration scripts.

Support database deployments, releases, and change management activities.

Troubleshoot production issues and provide timely resolution.

Build and maintain interfaces with external systems using APIs, Web Services, and integration tools.

Collaborate with business analysts, architects, and development teams to gather and translate requirements into technical solutions.

Ensure adherence to coding standards, security policies, and database best practices.

Participate in code reviews and technical design discussions.


Required Skills:

Strong experience with Oracle Database 12c/19c/21c.

Advanced proficiency in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL.

Hands-on experience with Oracle performance tuning and query optimization.

Experience developing packages, procedures, functions, triggers, and materialized views.

Knowledge of data modeling and database design principles.

Experience with Oracle Data Integrator (ODI), ETL, or data migration projects.

Familiarity with Unix/Linux shell scripting.

Experience with source control tools such as Git, SVN, or Bitbucket.

Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.


Preferred, but not required:

Experience with Oracle APEX, Oracle Forms, or Oracle Reports.

Knowledge of Oracle SOA Suite, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), or middleware technologies.

Experience with cloud platforms such as Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), AWS, or Azure.

Familiarity with DevOps and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps.

Experience in Agile/Scrum environments.

Oracle certifications are preferred.


We offer:

A highly competitive compensation and benefits package.

A multinational organization with 60 offices in 20 countries and the possibility to work abroad.

10 days of paid annual leave (plus sick leave and national holidays).

Maternity & paternity leave plans.

A comprehensive insurance plan including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and long-/short-term disability (plans vary by region).

Retirement savings plans.

A higher education certification policy.

Commuter benefits (varies by region).

Extensive training opportunities, focused on skills, substantive knowledge, and personal development.

On-demand Udemy for Business for all Synechron employees with free access to more than 5000 curated courses.

Coaching opportunities with experienced colleagues from our Financial Innovation Labs (FinLabs) and Center of Excellences (CoE) groups.

Cutting edge projects at the world’s leading tier-one banks, financial institutions and insurance firms.

A flat and approachable organization.

A truly diverse, fun-loving, and global work culture.


SYNECHRON’S DIVERSITY & INCLUSION STATEMENT

Diversity & Inclusion are fundamental to our culture, and Synechron is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) initiative ‘Same Difference’ is committed to fostering an inclusive culture – promoting equality, diversity and an environment that is respectful to all. We strongly believe that a diverse workforce helps build stronger, successful businesses as a global company. We encourage applicants from across diverse backgrounds, race, ethnicities, religion, age, marital status, gender, sexual orientations, or disabilities to apply. We empower our global workforce by offering flexible workplace arrangements, mentoring, internal mobility, learning and development programs, and more.

All employment decisions at Synechron are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to the applicant’s gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

descriptionHtml:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

We're looking for experienced engineers to build and scale the database infrastructure that powers Claude's products and Anthropic's research. As a Software Engineer on the Databases team, you'll architect and operate the systems that let millions of users interact with Claude while also supporting frontier AI research workloads.

You'll help set the database strategy for Anthropic: designing systems that handle billions of API requests, building storage that runs cleanly across GCP, AWS, and a range of deployment models, and creating the reliable data layer that lets research move fast.

The Databases team spans three areas: the core database platform (data plane and control plane), data movement (migrations, backfill, and change data capture), and caching. We're hiring across all three.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive the technical direction for database solutions used across Product and Research
  • Design and implement database solutions that scale to support millions of users across Claude's product ecosystem
  • Build and scale database systems through 100x+ growth while maintaining reliability and performance
  • Build the database platform that lets Anthropic engineers ship without thinking about databases or scaling.
  • Architect data storage solutions that operate across GCP, AWS, first-party deployments, third-party deployments, and other environments
  • Develop database infrastructure that serves both product and research workloads with different performance characteristics
  • Build data movement infrastructure (migration tooling, backfill, and change data capture pipelines) that safely consolidates and moves data across the organization
  • Design and operate caching infrastructure, including CDC-driven cache invalidation, that keeps Anthropic's hottest paths fast and correct
  • Partner with product and research teams to understand data requirements and build infrastructure that accelerates their work
  • Optimize database performance, reliability, and cost efficiency at scale
  • Make build-vs-buy decisions for database technologies

Minimum Qualifications

  • Significant experience as a software engineer building and operating production database or storage systems
  • Deep knowledge of distributed database architectures and OLTP systems at scale
  • Proficiency with SQL and at least one major relational or distributed database engine (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, Spanner, CockroachDB, DynamoDB)
  • Track record of leading large, complex infrastructure projects as an engineer or tech lead
  • Ability to balance moving quickly with the reliability needs of production systems
  • Strong technical leadership and cross-functional collaboration skills

descriptionHtml:
At Jack Henry, we’re more than a technology company, we’re a force for good in financial services. We’re redefining how community banks and credit unions connect with the people they serve. Our mission is rooted in people inspired innovation, empowering financial institutions to deliver seamless, secure, and human centered experiences. We deliver cutting-edge solutions that are paving the way for the next generation of digital banking and payments, but our true impact begins with our associates. If you're ready to help transform an industry and grow with a company that values purpose, collaboration, and excellence then we’d love to meet you.

The Senior Database Engineer works independently to evaluate, design, code, optimize, and modify databases and database applications. This role models databases and develops tables, stored procedures, views, triggers, and other database objects. The Senior Engineer, Database, tunes databases for optimum performance and works closely with other developers to integrate databases with other applications. This position may involve interface development to access databases and may require a limited amount of database administration.

This is a remote position and candidates must live within approximately a 70-mile radius of our office locations in Allen, TX; Overland Park, KS; Springfield, MO; Birmingham, AL; Charlotte, NC; Louisville, KY; or Monett, MO.

This position is ineligible for immigration sponsorship and support. Please do not apply if at any time you will need immigration support now or in the future (i.e., H-1B, PERM). All positions, regardless of location, may require an onsite interview or in-person onboarding requirement to verify your identity.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Writes and reviews stored procedures, functions, and other programmable objects for high-volume transaction processing systems.
  • Participates on scrum teams as the SQL expert, helping to move features through the software development lifecycle.
  • Tunes queries for optimal performance by closely examining execution plan and ensuring appropriate indexing.
  • Participates in design meetings and recommend optimal performing database designs.
  • Writes and maintains unit tests.
  • Writes and maintains library of query performance tests (baselines).
  • Ensures accurate history in version control systems (git/TFS) and writes documentation, as necessary.
  • Monitors and maintains database CI/CD devops tooling and ensures accuracy of update/rollback scripts for database deployments.
  • Writes and reviews application code in the data access layer to ensure performance and security of database calls.
  • Performs advanced troubleshooting across all application components, debug, fix code, deploy, and test the fixes
  • Diagnoses and troubleshoots complex application problems and leverage tools and resources appropriately to identify solutions.
  • Resolves challenging problems in collaboration with others.
  • Helps team members with questions and troubleshooting related to their SQL Server setups.
  • Trains and mentors junior team members.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

What You’ll Need To Have

  • A minimum of 6 years of experience in database administration.
  • Experience writing SQL queries.
  • Must be familiar with object-oriented programming.

What Would Be Nice For You To Have

  • Experience writing and optimizing complex queries.
  • Experience with performance tuning.
  • Knowledge of payment systems and solutions.
  • Strong communication, writing, and diagramming skills.
  • Experience with GoLang

If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this opportunity. Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement on this posting, we still encourage you to apply. We’re looking for passionate, driven individuals who align with our mission and can bring unique perspectives to our team.

Why Jack Henry?

At Jack Henry, we live by the motto: “Do the right thing, do whatever it takes, and have fun.” It’s more than a tagline, it’s the foundation of our culture. We recognize that our associates are the key to our success, and we’re deeply committed to their wellbeing. That’s why we offer comprehensive benefits designed to support your physical, mental, and financial health so you can thrive both personally and professionally.

We’re also leading the way in technology modernization, helping financial institutions evolve with speed, security, and flexibility. Our strategy focuses on delivering secure data access, mitigating fraud, and enabling seamless integration. Empowering our teams to build innovative solutions that meet the evolving needs of accountholders.

Culture of Commitment

Ask our associates why they love Jack Henry, and many will tell you it is because our culture is exceptional. We do great things together. Our culture empowers us to rise to challenges, seek new opportunities, and support one another through change. It’s this shared commitment that drives our success. We’re proud to foster an environment where inclusion, sustainability, and community impact are more than values, they’re how we operate. Visit our Corporate Sustainability site to learn more about our culture and commitment to our people, customers, community, environment, and shareholders.

Equal Employment Opportunity

At Jack Henry, we know we are better together. We value, respect, and protect the uniqueness each of us brings. Innovation flourishes by including all voices and makes our business - and our society - stronger. Jack Henry is an equal opportunity employer and we are committed to providing equal opportunity in all of our employment practices, including selection, hiring, performance management, promotion, transfer, compensation, benefits, education, training, social, and recreational activities to all persons regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, genetic information, pregnancy, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, and military and veteran status, or any other protected status protected by local, state or federal law.

No one will be subject to, and Jack Henry prohibits, any form of discipline, reprisal, intimidation, or retaliation for good faith reports or complaints of discrimination of any kind, pursuing any discrimination claim, or cooperating in related investigations.

Requests for full corporate job descriptions may be requested through the interview process at any time.

descriptionHtml:
Overview

Design the data foundation behind mission-critical geospatial systems.

Join Esri`s Professional Services organization and partner with Defense and Intelligence customers to design, implement, secure, and optimize enterprise database environments supporting geospatial applications.

You`ll bring deep database engineering expertise to complex customer environments, working across database architecture, performance, automation, security, high availability, disaster recovery, cloud database technologies, and spatial data. You`ll also advise customers on database design, migration, and integration approaches throughout the engagement lifecycle.

Esri has a Relocation Assistance Program and can provide support with relocating to the Redlands, CA area for this position.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable, secure, enterprise database environments
  • Configure and maintain database platforms
  • Develop high availability, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery strategies
  • Monitor and optimize database performance
  • Implement database security and access controls
  • Automate database loading, maintenance, and monitoring
  • Support database migration and integration initiatives
  • Apply geospatial concepts including spatial data types and spatial indexing
  • Advise customers on enterprise database best practices

Requirements

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in database design, administration, and optimization for Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or SAP HANA
  • Demonstrated experience with database design principles, data loading techniques, backup and recovery solutions, performance monitoring and tuning, database maintenance, and security
  • Scripting skills in SQL and Python for automation and data workflows
  • Experience with cloud-based database solutions (such as AWS RDS, Azure SQL Database)
  • Understanding of geospatial concepts such as spatial data types, coordinate systems, and spatial indexing
  • Ability to clearly communicate complex technical concepts to technical peers and non-technical project managers or customers
  • US citizenship with Active or Current (within 2 years of active) Top Secret Security Clearance with SCI eligibility
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, mathematics, GIS, or related STEM field

Recommended Qualifications

  • Experience with ArcGIS Enterprise geodatabases
  • Knowledge of integrating GIS with other enterprise systems
  • CompTIA Security + certification
  • One or more industry-standard IT certifications (such as Esri, Microsoft, Amazon, PostgreSQL, Oracle)
  • Master's degree in computer science, mathematics, GIS or related STEM field

Total RewardsEsri’s competitive total rewards strategy includes industry-leading health and welfare benefits: medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance for employees (and their families), 401(k) and profit-sharing programs, minimum accrual of 80 hours of vacation leave, twelve paid holidays throughout the calendar year, and opportunities for personal and professional growth. Base salary is one component of our total rewards strategy. Compensation decisions and the base range for this role take into account many factors including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs.

descriptionHtml:
Overview

Help power mission-critical systems through enterprise data. As a Technical Consultant, Enterprise Data Engineer, you will design and implement scalable geospatial data platforms that support Defense and Intelligence operations.

You will work directly with customers to architect data solutions that integrate, manage, and optimize complex datasets across secure environments. From database design and performance tuning to high availability and data security, your work will ensure that critical geospatial information is delivered reliably to the people who depend on it most.

This role combines enterprise data engineering, geospatial technology, and mission impact, giving you the opportunity to solve complex data challenges in environments where performance, scale, and reliability are essential.

Esri has a Relocation Assistance Program and can provide support with relocating to the Washington DC area for this position.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement robust, scalable, and secure database solutions to support mission-critical applications
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams during all phases of implementation including requirements, analysis, design, build/configuration, and deployment
  • Configure and maintain database environments, including backup, restore, high-availability, and disaster recovery strategies
  • Monitor and tune database performance using industry-standard tools and methodologies (such as query optimization, indexing strategies)
  • Implement data security measures, access controls, and compliance standards across environments
  • Automate routine database loading, maintenance, and monitoring tasks to improve efficiency
  • Provide technical guidance and best practices for database design, migration, and integration projects

Requirements

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in database design, administration, and optimization for Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or SAP HANA
  • Familiarity with database design principles, data loading techniques, backup and recovery solutions, performance monitoring and tuning, database maintenance, and security
  • Scripting skills in SQL and Python for automation and data workflows
  • Exposure to geospatial concepts such as spatial data types, coordinate systems, and spatial indexing
  • Ability to clearly communicate complex technical concepts to technical peers and non-technical project managers or customers
  • US citizenship with Active or Current (within 2 years of active) Top Secret Security Clearance with SCI eligibility
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, mathematics, GIS, or related STEM field

Recommended Qualifications

  • Experience with ArcGIS Enterprise geodatabases
  • Knowledge of integrating GIS with other enterprise systems
  • CompTIA Security + certification
  • One or more industry-standard IT certifications (such as Esri, Microsoft, Amazon, PostgreSQL, Oracle)
  • Master`s degree in computer science, mathematics, GIS, or related STEM field

Total RewardsEsri’s competitive total rewards strategy includes industry-leading health and welfare benefits: medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance for employees (and their families), 401(k) and profit-sharing programs, minimum accrual of 80 hours of vacation leave, twelve paid holidays throughout the calendar year, and opportunities for personal and professional growth. Base salary is one component of our total rewards strategy. Compensation decisions and the base range for this role take into account many factors including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs.

A reasonable estimate of the base salary range is: $84,240 USD - $142,480 USD

companyDescription:
Oracle is a global leader in AI, delivering the cloud infrastructure, data, and applications that organizations across the world trust to successfully achieve business outcomes at scale.

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) provides fast, flexible, scalable AI infrastructure. With superior compute performance and network design, a comprehensive choice of AI services for developing and orchestrating agentic AI workflows at scale, and unrivaled data control, security, privacy, and governance, OCI is designed for AI workloads. It also gives customers the flexibility to run their workloads wherever they need by supporting public cloud, multicloud, hybrid cloud, sovereign, and on-premises deployments.

The Oracle AI Database is the only database with AI natively built in everywhere. By bringing AI to where data lives, the Oracle AI Database delivers enterprise-grade AI securely, cost-effectively, and at scale. In-database machine learning and vector search enable AI models to run where data resides. Support for multi-modal data (structured, unstructured, graph, vector) enables richer AI use cases. 

The Oracle AI Data Platform enables organizations to build, deploy, and govern AI agents and applications on top of private, secure, and distributed enterprise data. This enables organizations to operationalize AI without compromising data security or control. 

Oracle Applications embed AI directly into business workflows and industry processes to ensure AI is delivered in context, where work happens. They include the only applications suite that brings AI to every aspect of a business, with AI-powered ERP, HCM, and CX applications, and the Oracle Health Suite which provides applications for managing the entire healthcare ecosystem. Oracle also provides industry-specific cloud application suites for more than two dozen industries and NetSuite, the world’s first cloud computing company.

At Oracle, we empower government organizations to unlock innovation, drive efficiency, and deliver breakthrough outcomes with the power of cloud technology. As a global leader in cloud solutions and professional services, we help clients harness Oracle technology to achieve strategic objectives.

Oracle Government, Defense & Intelligence Consulting Group is seeking a highly experienced, motivated and security-cleared Consulting Senior Principal - AI Database Developer to join our team support our IC programs in Northern Virginia. In this hands-on technical role, you will design, develop, and optimize Oracle database solutions, data pipelines, and AI-enabled data platforms for enterprise-scale mission systems.

You will work with customer stakeholders, architects, data scientists, and database administrators to translate complex requirements into secure, reliable, and high-performing solutions. This role demands technical expertise, strategic thinking, and hands-on experience with Oracle-based systems in high-volume environments.

If you thrive in a fast-paced, data-driven organization and enjoy solving complex data engineering challenges, we want to hear from you.

Most possess or have the ability to obtain and maintain TS/SCI Security Clearance with Poly

This full-time, in-person role is based at our Reston, Virginia, office, with occasional visits to client sites. We are seeking candidates who live within commuting distance of Reston.

Responsibilities

Required Skills:

  • MUST possess or have the ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI with Poly.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • At least 6 years of relevant experience in database development, data engineering, or ETL/ELT development for enterprise-scale systems.
  • Strong hands-on experience designing, developing, and implementing Oracle Database solutions.
  • Advanced SQL and PL/SQL skills, including stored procedures, packages, complex queries, and performance optimization.
  • Experience designing and implementing scalable data pipelines, including data transformation, validation, error handling, and operational monitoring.
  • Experience working with geospatial data, including vector and raster formats.
  • Experience working with different data formats, such as relational, spatial, JSON, and graph data.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Experience working with containers and Kubernetes.
  • Proficiency in Python, shell scripting, or comparable tools for automation and data processing.
  • Working knowledge of data governance, metadata management, data lineage, and secure data handling.
  • Ability to collaborate with data scientists, database administrators, application developers, analysts, and customer stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and written and verbal communication skills.


Desired Skills:

  • Experience supporting Intelligence Community (IC) or other federal mission systems.
  • Experience with Oracle Spatial, including spatial indexing, coordinate systems, spatial queries, and raster data management.
  • Hands-on experience with vector embeddings, vector data types, similarity search, and RAG workflows.
  • Familiarity with MCP and its use in connecting AI applications to approved data sources and tools.
  • Experience developing RESTful APIs.
  • Experience with Git, automated deployments, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience applying database security controls, auditing, and customer-specific compliance requirements.
  • Relevant Oracle certifications, such as Oracle Database or OCI architecture certifications.

The Senior Database Engineer works independently to evaluate, design, code, optimize, and modify databases and database applications. This role models databases and develops tables, stored procedures, views, triggers, and other database objects. The Senior Engineer, Database, tunes databases for optimum performance and works closely with other developers to integrate databases with other applications. This position may involve interface development to access databases and may require a limited amount of database administration.

This is a remote position and candidates must live within approximately a 70-mile radius of our office locations in Allen, TX; Overland Park, KS; Springfield, MO; Birmingham, AL; Charlotte, NC; Louisville, KY; or Monett, MO.

This position is ineligible for immigration sponsorship and support. Please do not apply if at any time you will need immigration support now or in the future (i.e., H-1B, PERM). All positions, regardless of location, may require an onsite interview or in-person onboarding requirement to verify your identity.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Writes and reviews stored procedures, functions, and other programmable objects for high-volume transaction processing systems.
  • Participates on scrum teams as the SQL expert, helping to move features through the software development lifecycle.
  • Tunes queries for optimal performance by closely examining execution plan and ensuring appropriate indexing.
  • Participates in design meetings and recommend optimal performing database designs.
  • Writes and maintains unit tests.
  • Writes and maintains library of query performance tests (baselines).

  • BA or BS degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Finance, or a related discipline.

  • Knowledge of bond fundamentals and capital markets execution processes is mandatory.
  • Ability to document workflows, create knowledge repositories, and provide effective training.
