Founded in 1960 in North Carolina, Harris Teeter has been enriching the lives of our customers and our communities for decades. Today, Harris Teeter employs 36,000 valued associates and operates more than 250 stores and 70 fuel centers in seven states and the District of Columbia. In addition to our retail stores, we operate grocery, frozen food and perishable distribution centers in Greensboro and Indian Trail, North Carolina.  

From fresh, high-quality products to innovative offerings, Harris Teeter delivers an exceptional shopping experience at a great value, which is why Harris Teeter is proud to be ‘your neighborhood market.’ 

Harris Teeter is committed to not only supporting its communities by donating millions in food and funds to non-profits each year, but we also support our valued associates by offering comprehensive benefits, career growth opportunities and an incredible work culture. This commitment demonstrates Harris Teeter’s purpose to Enrich Lives: One Meal, One Family, One Associate and One Community at a time. 

Harris Teeter’s History: 
In 1936, W.T. Harris borrowed $1,500 to open the first Harris Food Store in Charlotte, North Carolina. The store was founded on three principles: high-quality products, clean stores and superior customer service. Harris was considered a pioneer of the grocery industry and opened the first supermarket that featured air-conditioning and stayed open until 9 p.m. on Friday nights. 

Just a few years later, Willis L. Teeter and his brother, Paul, opened their first Teeter’s Food Mart in Mooresville, North Carolina. On February 1, 1960, Harris Super Markets and Teeter’s Food Marts merged to form Harris Teeter Super Markets, Inc. with 15 stores in operation. 

Now with more than 250 stores and 36,000 valued associates, Harris Teeter is proud to provide an exceptional shopping experience to millions of customers each year.

descriptionHtml:
The Senior Software Engineer will solve complex data and performance challenges in Gridline's SQL Server environment. This role is primarily focused on SQL Server, data warehousing, stored procedures, database performance, SQL jobs, and the data access layer. The successful candidate will also be able to follow data up the stack and occasionally make targeted changes in the C#/.NET and React applications that consume that data.

This role requires someone who can take ownership of ambiguous data problems, investigate independently, ask focused questions when blocked, and drive work to completion without heavy day-to-day direction.

What You Will Do

  • Maintain and improve the complex stored procedures that build the warehouse tables.
  • Optimize database performance for large datasets exceeding 300 million rows using indexing, query tuning, execution plan analysis, partitioning strategies, and other SQL Server performance techniques.
  • Maintain, troubleshoot, and optimize SQL Server Agent jobs, including job scheduling, failure analysis, retry behavior, dependency review, and performance impact.
  • Understand how the data is used throughout Gridline products and be able to identify upstream impacts.
  • Ability to understand, analyze, and summarize complex telematics data using SQL.
  • Maintain source control of SQL code using Git.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies in 2 week sprints.
  • Use Azure Dev Ops for workflow.
  • User Claude or Cursor to assist in writing code, solving problems, and reviewing work.
  • SQL Server administration - roles, users, schema management, backups, recovery.
  • Minimal SSIS/SSRS work.
  • Analyze telematics and safety data to provide actionable insights to customers.
  • Maintain and help improve web, console, and API based solutions using appropriate languages while helping to drive the improvement of internal coding standards and best practices.
  • Write software to integrate complex data from external APIs/sources.
  • Ensure the robustness, performance, and failure characteristics of the system.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

  • Exceptional Microsoft SQL Server skills, including table design, advanced stored procedure development, data warehousing, SQL Server Agent jobs, database tuning, and performance management for large datasets exceeding 300 million rows across multiple database servers and databases.
  • Must be able to solve complex SQL and data analysis problems by working from raw data to identify meaning, patterns, metrics, summary information, and data-quality issues, while also being able to debug stored procedures, analyze execution plans, and communicate findings clearly.
  • Must be knowledgeable about Database Projects and Data-tier Application Packages (DACPACs) for SQL source control and deployment.
  • Must be a self-starter who can independently investigate unfamiliar systems, prioritize the next useful step, document findings, and communicate blockers clearly without requiring step-by-step direction.
  • Exceptional problem solving & debugging skills.
  • Good object-oriented programming skills
  • Familiarity with the consumption and presentation of API data
  • Strong analytical and documentation skills
  • N-tier design and programming
  • Exposure to big data/large language models a plus
  • React experience a plus

What Are We Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in CS, MIS or CIS or related field or equivalent job-related experience.
  • 7+ years of primarily T-SQL focused experience in production SQL Server environments.
  • 3+ years of C# experience, with the ability to make targeted changes in applications, services, APIs, or console processes that interact with SQL Server data.
  • 1+ years .NET 6+ or later.
  • 1+ years in an Agile environment
  • 1+ years Azure Dev Ops using Git.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or similar tools to assist with coding, troubleshooting, documentation, or code review is preferred.
  • SQL Server administration experience, including roles, users, schema management, backups, and recovery.
  • Experience working with telematics, CAN bus, or other complex data
  • Experience supporting SQL Server production environments with large datasets exceeding 300 million rows, multiple database servers/databases, and SQL Server Agent jobs.
  • Experience designing, maintaining, debugging, analyzing, and improving complex SQL and data solutions for production systems.
  • Experience with Database Projects and Data-tier Application Packages (DACPACs) for SQL source control and deployment.
  • Experience building or supporting data integration applications that move, transform, or reconcile data from external APIs or source systems.
  • Limited SSRS and SSIS experience preferred.

Reasonable Accommodation

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Supervisory Responsibility

None

Work Environment

This job operates in a clerical, office setting. Noise level is typically moderate. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, filing cabinets, copiers, scanners and fax machines.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to sit; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. The employee must frequently lift and move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work

This is a full-time position which will typically involve 40 hours a week Monday through Friday but are subject to change at the company's discretion.

Travel

Two trips annually to the corporate office in Scottsdale, AZ of approximately 5 days each may be required along with quarterly 1-day events. Otherwise, little to no travel is expected for this position.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Compensation Details

The potential salary range for this role is $125,000 to $150,000 per year, with eligibility for bonus or merit program. Final compensation will be based on experience, skills, market conditions, and internal equity. We offer a competitive Total Rewards program including health benefits, RRSP matching, stock option, and career development opportunities.

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Data Engineer specializing in Microsoft SQL Server. The ideal candidate will design, develop, and maintain enterprise data warehouses, and SSIS Packages, ensuring data reliability, performance, quality, and security. The Senior Data Engineer will collaborate closely with software developers, data analysts, and other stakeholders to deliver trusted data for reporting, analytics, and business processes.

Database Design And Development

  • Design, implement, and maintain database structures and dimensional data models, including tables, views, indexes, and schemas using Microsoft SQL Server.
  • Develop complex SQL queries, stored procedures, functions, and triggers to support application development and data processing.
  • Optimize database performance through indexing, query optimization, and other performance tuning techniques.

Data Integration And ETL Processes

  • Design and develop ETL and ELT processes using SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) to ingest and transform data from multiple sources.
  • Parameterize SSIS packages and create environment variables for SSIS Catalog package deployment
  • Use expressions in concert with package parameters to make connections dynamic and streamline package deployment/promotion across environments
  • Ensure data quality, consistency, and integrity across different systems and environments.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines, implement logging and error handling, and ensure timely and accurate data processing.

Query Optimization

  • Analyze and optimize SQL queries to improve execution times and reduce resource consumption.
  • Implement indexing strategies to speed up data retrieval operations.
  • Rewrite complex queries to make them more efficient and easier to maintain.
  • Collaborate with developers to optimize queries embedded within applications.

Collaboration And Support

  • Work closely with software developers, data analysts, and other IT team members to understand requirements and provide database solutions.
  • Provide technical support and troubleshooting for database-related issues.
  • Mentor and guide junior data engineers and other team members.

Documentation And Compliance

  • Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for database designs, processes, and procedures.
  • Ensure compliance with data governance, security policies, and industry regulations.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 9 years of experience in data engineering and database development with a focus on Microsoft technologies.
  • Proven experience with Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL, SSIS, Azure data services, and Microsoft Fabric, with familiarity with SSRS and Power BI.
  • Proficiency in SQL Server, T-SQL programming, and dimensional data modeling.
  • Experience developing ETL and ELT pipelines using SSIS.
  • Hands-on experience with SSIS Catalog deployments, including SSIS package parameterization, environment variables, and Package and Project Deployment models.
  • Experience with database performance tuning and optimization techniques.
  • Knowledge of data security, access management, backup, and recovery practices across SQL Server.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on quality and accuracy.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Strong SSIS development skills, including package parameters, environment variables, catalog deployments and expressions.
  • Knowledge of data modeling and database design principles, including strong understanding of dimensional data models (star schemas, facts and dimensions, slowly changing dimensions, and data denormalization)

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.

Role Description

Data Warehouse Developer

The Role

UST is seeking a Data Warehouse Developer to design, maintain, and enhance the organization’s data warehouse, ETL processes, and reporting solutions. The role develops SQL-based data integrations, creates and modifies SSRS and Power BI reports, optimizes data flows, and works closely with business stakeholders to meet analytical and reporting needs.

What You’ll Do

  • Maintain and enhance the data warehouse environment, including merge scripts, loads, extracts, and transformations using SSMS, and ETL processes using SSIS.
  • Develop, optimize, and troubleshoot ETL workflows to support reliable data ingestion and transformation.
  • Perform root cause analysis and resolve issues related to data pipeline failures, data quality, and performance bottlenecks.
  • Plan and implement future enhancements, upgrades, and optimizations for the data warehouse environment.
  • Create, modify, and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, functions, and scripts for data processing, analytics, and reporting.
  • Use SSMS and Visual Studio for database development, debugging, and deployment.
  • Leverage C# and .NET when needed for custom scripts, application logic, or integrations.
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance SSRS reports, including creating and modifying RDLC files based on business needs.
  • Build, update, and optimize reports and dashboards in Power BI and the SSRS Report Manager.
  • Create and manage SSRS subscriptions to automatically deliver reports via email or shared folders on daily, weekly, or monthly schedules.
  • Ensure reports meet business requirements while maintaining accuracy, usability, and performance.
  • Work closely with business analysts, subject matter experts (SMEs), and management stakeholders across multiple departments to gather, clarify, and translate business requirements.
  • Support ad hoc reporting needs by quickly developing or updating reports, queries, or datasets.
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

This position description identifies the responsibilities and tasks typically associated with the performance of the position. Other relevant essential functions may be required.

Required

What You Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, data engineering, or a related field.
  • Strong proficiency with SQL, SSMS, SSIS, SSRS, and Visual Studio.
  • Experience with data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, and ETL processes.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills for data pipelines, report issues, and SQL performance tuning.
  • Familiarity with C#, .NET, and scripting for automation or integrations.

Preferred

  • Experience with Power BI report and dashboard development.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, version control (Git), and deployment best practices.
  • Understanding of database performance tuning and optimization.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Job Description

Supports the UT System by designing, maintaining, and optimizing data systems, processes, and business intelligence solutions. This position develops and refines SQL and Python based data workflows; maintains data quality, consistency, and performance across multiple SQL Server environments; and produces reliable data assets for institutional reporting and analysis. The role also develops, enhances, and updates Power BI dashboards, semantic models, and visualizations that provide leadership and campus stakeholders with clear, actionable insights. The position collaborates closely with Institutional Research departments and technology partners to improve reporting processes, troubleshoot existing tools, and support evolving data and decision-support needs.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities include but not limited to:

Develop, maintain, and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, tables, views, and data pipelines supporting institutional reporting and analytics. Maintain data and schema consistency across SQL Server environments. Refactor complex scripts and processes to improve performance, reliability, and processing time. Develop ad hoc queries and reusable data assets to meet operational and reporting needs.

Develop, maintain, and enhance Power BI dashboards, reports, datasets, and semantic models. Translate institutional data into clear, accurate, and polished visualization tools for leadership and campus stakeholders. Improve report usability, performance, accessibility, consistency, and documentation. Support analysis and reporting using Power BI, Tableau, and related tools as needed.

Implement and modify systematic data validation, error-checking, reconciliation, and troubleshooting processes to support reliable reporting. Develop and maintain Python scripts and automated workflows used in data extraction, transformation, loading, and reporting processes. Maintain and enhance existing web-based applications, scripts, and legacy platforms that support institutional data and reporting functions.

Collaborate with System staff, campus partners, and technology teams to define data requirements and deliver effective reporting solutions. Document data sources, business rules, workflows, and technical processes. Identify opportunities to improve data governance, reporting processes, system integration, and the overall reliability and efficiency of analytics operations.

Other Duties As Required.

 QUALIFICATIONS

SPONSORSHIP IS NOT AVAILABLE AT THIS TIME

Successful candidate will hold a Bachelor's degree in a related field and four to six years of programming and database experience.

Additional Requirements Include

  • Knowledge of data management, analytics, business intelligence, visualization, relational data modeling, and dimensional data modeling principles.
  • Advanced knowledge of SQL query development, stored procedures, performance optimization, and ETL/ELT processes using SQL Server data-integration tools, including SSIS.
  • Skill in developing and maintaining automated data processes using Python.
  • Skill in developing Power BI reports, semantic models, DAX measures, and visualizations that translate reporting needs into effective technical data solutions.
  • Skill in analyzing data, validating results, resolving discrepancies, and applying data-quality, security, privacy, and appropriate institutional data-use practices.
  • Ability to manage analytics work from requirements gathering through implementation, documentation, user support, and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to collaborate with stakeholders, technical teams, and institutional partners and communicate data concepts and findings to technical and nontechnical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Masters degree in a related field or equivalent related experience.
  • One to three or more years of higher education experience.
  • Knowledge of higher education data, reporting requirements, business processes, and institutional systems sufficient to support effective analytics and decision-making.
  • Knowledge of Oracle, Banner, or comparable enterprise data systems.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric, cloud analytics platforms, or modern data architecture.
  • Embedded analytics and integration: Embedding Power BI reports in web applications or portals and integrating with APIs, Power Automate, Excel, Teams, and SharePoint.
  • Experience with business intelligence performance optimization such as Power BI Performance Analyzer, DAX Studio, or VertiPaq Analyzer to optimize models, measures, visuals, refreshes, and query performance.

Application Process

For full consideration, applications should be accompanied by a letter of interest, a resume, and three professional references. Review of applications will begin immediately.

Benefits And Compensation

Compensation for the position is budgeted for $75,000 - $85,000.

The University offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes excellent healthcare and tuition benefits for employees and their families, generous retirement benefits, a wide variety of professional development opportunities, supportive work and family benefits and much more. Additionally, Tennessee residents do not pay a state income tax. For more information on the University of Tennessee’s benefits, visit https://hr.tennessee.edu/benefits/

About Us

The University of Tennessee System is the state’s oldest higher education institution and preeminent public university. The UT System is comprised of campuses at Knoxville, Chattanooga, Pulaski and Martin; the Health Science Center at Memphis; and the statewide Institute of Agriculture and Institute for Public Service. With a presence in each of Tennessee’s 95 counties and through the combined force of education, research and outreach, the University serves students, business and industry, schools, governments, organizations and residents statewide.

Help power mission-critical systems through enterprise data. As a Technical Consultant, Enterprise Data Engineer, you will design and implement scalable geospatial data platforms that support Defense and Intelligence operations.

You will work directly with customers to architect data solutions that integrate, manage, and optimize complex datasets across secure environments. From database design and performance tuning to high availability and data security, your work will ensure that critical geospatial information is delivered reliably to the people who depend on it most.

descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

IDMe is the next-generation digital identity wallet that simplifies how individuals securely prove their identity online. Consumers can verify their identity with IDMe once and seamlessly login across websites without having to create a new login and verify their identity again. Over 175 million users experience streamlined login and identity verification with IDMe at 22 federal agencies, 50 state government agencies, and more than 100 healthcare organizations. Over 600 consumer brands use IDMe to verify communities and user segments to honor service and build more authentic relationships. IDMe’s technology meets the federal standards for consumer authentication set by the Commerce Department and is approved as a NIST 800-63-3 IAL2 / AAL2 credential service provider by the Kantara Initiative. IDMe is committed to “No Identity Left Behind” to enable all people to have a secure digital identity. To learn more, visit https://network.id.me/.

IDMe is a full-time, in-office culture. Unless a specific job description explicitly states otherwise, all roles are on-site five days per week at one of our offices in McLean, VA; Mountain View, CA; New York City, NY; or Tampa, FL. Certain roles — such as field-based sales or other remote-by-design positions — may have different work arrangements as noted in their individual postings.

At IDMe, we embrace the thoughtful use of AI tools in our daily work and there are even occasions where we leverage AI in our hiring process. However, during the interview process, we want to understand your individual skills and experiences. Therefore, we have guidelines on how AI can be appropriately used during your application and interviews which can be found here.

Role Overview

IDMe is seeking a Staff Software Engineer (SDE5), PostgreSQL Specialist to lead the engineering, evolution, and operational excellence of our PostgreSQL-based data platform. This role sits at the intersection of deep database internals and platform software engineering—focused on scaling our core relational databases (across CloudSQL, AlloyDB, and AWS RDS) and building the developer tooling, safe change deployment pipelines, and automated guardrails that protect IDMe’s mission-critical identity systems.

As a Staff Engineer on the Core Platform Data team, you will serve as the organization’s foremost technical authority on PostgreSQL internals, performance engineering, and safe database evolution at scale. Beyond tuning queries and managing high-scale database infrastructure, you will act as a force multiplier for the entire engineering organization by designing and maintaining automated schema change pipelines, migration linters, and self-service guardrails that enable product engineers to ship database changes safely, rapidly, and without production disruption. You will also lead high-stakes database engine upgrades, large-scale data migrations, and Change Data Capture (CDC) initiatives in partnership with Product Engineering, SRE, Security, and Compliance teams. This is a highly technical, hands-on role that combines deep mastery of PostgreSQL internals with strong software engineering skills to build resilient systems and developer-facing database automation.

This role is based out of our Mountain View, CA or McLean, VA offices and requires full-time in-office attendance.

Responsibilities


  • Master & Optimize PostgreSQL Internals at Scale: Serve as the primary technical escalation point and subject-matter expert on PostgreSQL internals—including MVCC, vacuum/autovacuum tuning, transaction ID wraparound prevention, lock management, WAL/checkpoint behavior, buffer management, query planner/optimizer internals, and table/index bloat remediation.
  • Build Safe Change Deployment Pipelines & Developer Guardrails: Design, build, and maintain automated database schema change management pipelines (e.g., Liquibase/CI-CD workflows, automated DDL validation, lock/timeout guardrails, and pre-flight migration checks) that empower engineers across IDMe to deploy schema and data changes safely with zero downtime.
  • Lead Zero-Downtime Migrations & Engine Upgrades: Architect and execute complex, large-scale data migrations (accounting for data skew, batching, and index performance) as well as major version upgrades and platform transitions across PostgreSQL, GCP CloudSQL, AlloyDB, and AWS RDS.
  • Drive Query Performance & Schema Hygiene: Partner with engineering teams to review and optimize high-throughput queries, indexing strategies, partitioning/sharding designs, connection management, and role/permission models across operational and graph-adjacent relational workloads.
  • Engineer Database Observability & Diagnostics Tooling: Build and enhance custom PostgreSQL telemetry, statistics collection, query performance monitoring, and alerting to proactively detect lock contention, replication lag, slow queries, and capacity bottlenecks before they impact production SLAs.
  • Enable Event-Driven & CDC Architectures: Design and maintain reliable Change Data Capture (CDC), logical replication, and outbox/streaming integrations that bridge transactional PostgreSQL databases with IDMe’s broader event-driven and analytical data ecosystem.
  • Automate Governance, Security & Compliance: Build automated workflows and enforcement mechanisms for database access controls, cross-schema permissions, secret rotation, data retention/pruning, and regulatory compliance (e.g., FedRAMP, NIST 800-63, GDPR).
  • Act as Production Stability Guardian & Multiplier: Establish and codify PostgreSQL best practices, conduct architectural and high-risk migration reviews, and mentor engineers across the company to decentralize database expertise and elevate the organization’s database engineering bar.

Minimum Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s or Graduate degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 8+ years of professional software development and data infrastructure experience, including 5+ years working deeply with PostgreSQL in high-volume production environments.
  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of PostgreSQL internals (e.g., MVCC, vacuuming, locking semantics, query execution plans, indexing structures, WAL, and replication).
  • Strong programming proficiency in one or more backend languages such as Go, Python, Ruby, or Java, alongside expert-level SQL and PL/pgSQL.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Proven track record of building software, automation, and CI/CD pipelines for safe database schema changes, migrations, and developer guardrails.Demonstrated experience designing and operating automated database change management and schema migration frameworks (e.g., Liquibase, Flyway, custom DDL linters, or zero-downtime migration tooling) across a large engineering organization.
  • Extensive hands-on experience managing and upgrading managed cloud PostgreSQL platforms at scale, particularly GCP CloudSQL, Google AlloyDB, AWS RDS, or Aurora PostgreSQL.
  • Proven success planning and executing near-zero-downtime major PostgreSQL version upgrades and multi-terabyte table migrations or normalizations under strict availability SLAs.
  • Deep experience with PostgreSQL extensions, custom statistics/diagnostics tooling, logical replication, and Change Data Capture (CDC) pipelines (e.g., Debezium, pglogical, Airbyte, or Pub/Sub/Kafka integrations).
  • Experience automating database infrastructure and lifecycle management using Terraform, Kubernetes, or Helm.
  • Strong understanding of data security, encryption, role-based access control, and compliance requirements in regulated environments (e.g., FedRAMP, NIST, GDPR).
  • Fluency with AI-assisted engineering tools and workflows to accelerate tooling development, query analysis, and migration validation.
  • Track record of acting as a force multiplier—turning tribal database knowledge into self-service tools, documentation, and paved paths for other engineers.

The annual base salary listed does not include a company bonus, incentive for sales roles, equity and benefits which will be determined based on experience, skills, education, relevant training, geographic location and role.

IDMe offers comprehensive medical, dental, vision, health savings account, flexible spending accounts (medical, limited purpose, dependent care, commuter benefit accounts), basic and voluntary life and AD&D insurance, 401(k) with company match, parental leave, ability to participate in unlimited paid time off subject to the terms and conditions of the PTO policy, including 8 company wide holidays, short and long-term disability insurance, accident and critical illness insurance, referral bonus policy, employee assistance program, pet insurance, travel assistant program, wellbeing and childcare discounts, benefit advocates, and a learning and development benefit.

Final offers may vary from the amount listed based on qualifications, professional experiences, skills, education, relevant training, geographic location, and other job related factors.

$174,000—$229,000 USD

Mountain View, CA Pay Range

$194,000—$253,000 USD

Job Description

WORK LOCATION DETAILS

Work Location: Home Office - Coppell, TX

Work Schedule: Hybrid

  • Onsite: Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays
  • Work from Home: Mondays and Fridays

Job Summary

The Data Warehouse & ETL Developer designs, develops, maintains, and supports enterprise data warehouse solutions and data integration processes, primarily using Microsoft SQL Server and SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS). This mid-level role transforms data from multiple business systems into reliable, well-structured data models that support reporting, analytics, and business decision-making. The developer partners with technical teams and business stakeholders to deliver accurate, scalable, and maintainable data solutions.

Essential Functions

  • Design, develop, and maintain ETL pipelines that load and transform data in Microsoft SQL Server data warehouse environments.
  • Translate business and source-system requirements into source-to-target mappings, transformation rules, and technical designs.
  • Write and optimize complex T-SQL, stored procedures, and reusable transformations for data extraction, cleansing, integration, and validation.
  • Develop, deploy, schedule, monitor, and support SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) packages and workflows.
  • Develop and maintain dimensional data models, including fact and dimension tables, to support reporting and analytics.
  • Create and execute unit tests, data reconciliations, and validation routines to ensure data accuracy and completeness.
  • Monitor production SSIS packages and data pipelines, troubleshoot failures and data issues, and perform root-cause analysis.
  • Optimize SQL Server queries, stored procedures, SSIS packages, and data-loading performance.
  • Follow source-control, code-review, deployment, and change-management standards.
  • Document data flows, technical designs, transformation logic, dependencies, and operational support procedures.
  • Collaborate with data architects, analysts, application teams, and business stakeholders to deliver and support dependable data solutions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field preferred; equivalent practical experience will be considered.
  • 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience developing and supporting data warehouse and ETL/ELT solutions.
  • Strong T-SQL skills, including complex queries, stored procedures, performance tuning, data validation, and troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on experience developing and supporting Microsoft SQL Server data warehouse solutions.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), including package development, deployment, scheduling, monitoring, and error handling.
  • Experience designing and supporting ETL workflows, dependencies, restartability, logging, and production support processes.
  • Experience developing stored procedures and reusable data-transformation logic.
  • Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, and ETL/ELT best practices.
  • Experience with testing, reconciliation, production support, and root-cause analysis for data pipelines.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and business partners.

Preferred

  • Experience in a retail environment or with retail data such as sales, inventory, merchandising, customer, loyalty, or supply chain data.
  • Experience with Snowflake, Snowpipe, or a comparable cloud data warehouse platform.
  • Experience supporting reporting and analytics tools such as Power BI or SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS).
  • Experience with data governance, data quality tools, or cloud-based data integration patterns.
  • Experience with Azure data services or other cloud data platforms and migration initiatives.

descriptionHtml:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

DX is headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah and is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. We help engineering leaders build high-performing, productive teams. DX collects millions of data points daily, powering insights into developer productivity and experience at companies like Pinterest, GitHub, BNY, Xero, and many more .

Our business has scaled profitably and grown rapidly—tripling annual recurring revenue in the last several years.

DX recently closed on its acquisition by Atlassian . By joining Atlassian, we will expand our resources, accelerate growth and R&D, and ultimately deliver greater impact to our customers.

What We Value At DX

Companies have all kinds of culture slides. At DX, we want to be very clear about what we care about and how we judge performance. For us, it all boils down to individual mastery, becoming the best at your craft. Those who exhibit this quality will thrive here and be unduly rewarded. We can’t control outcomes due to competitors, the economy, decision-makers, etc., but what we can control is doing our jobs at the highest level possible

Responsibilities

What you’ll do

  • Build and maintain data pipelines that extract, transform, and load live product data into research-ready formats (Postgres, data lake, or analytics warehouse)
  • Design and optimize data models tailored to the recurring analyses behind our AI Impact Reports, DX Core 4 benchmarks, and industry-facing publications
  • Collaborate closely with the research and engineering teams to understand analytical requirements and translate them into scalable, reproducible data infrastructure
  • Ensure data quality and consistency: you care about definitions, edge cases, and making sure the same question gets the same answer every time
  • Support ad hoc data pulls for time-sensitive research and cross-functional requests from Sales, Customer Success, and product teams
  • Document everything - schemas, transformation logic, data dictionaries, and pipeline dependencies so that analysts and researchers can self-serve confidently


Compensation

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.

Please visit go.atlassian.com/payzones for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

Pay Ranges

Role

In The United States, we have three geographic pay zones. For this role, our current base pay ranges for new hires in each zone are:

Zone A: $167,400 - $218,550

Zone B: $150,660 - $196,695

Zone C: $138,942 - $181,397

Qualifications

What we’re looking for

  • Strong SQL skills: you can write complex queries, optimize performance, and model data for analytical workloads
  • Hands-on experience with Postgres or similar relational databases, including working with semi-structured data (JSONB, nested fields)
  • Experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines that move data from production systems into analytics-ready formats
  • Comfort working with large, messy, real-world datasets: you know how to clean, normalize, and validate data at scale
  • Strong documentation habits: you write clear schema docs, data dictionaries, and pipeline runbooks without being asked
  • Self-motivated and reliable: you can manage recurring deadlines (e.g., quarterly reporting cycles) with minimal oversight


Nice To Have

  • Experience working with SaaS product data, telemetry, or event-driven data
  • Familiarity with developer tooling data: Git/GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket activity, CI/CD pipeline metrics, Jira issue data
  • Exposure to survey data, time-series analysis, or benchmarking methodologies


Why this role

  • High visibility: The data you shape will underpin reports cited by engineering leaders at the world's largest software organizations
  • High ownership: You'll own the full data pipeline from raw product data to research-ready datasets.
  • Meaningful domain: You'll work at the intersection of developer experience, AI measurement, and engineering productivity, a space that's defining how the industry thinks about software development
  • Research-backed environment: Our team includes the researchers behind the DORA, SPACE, and DevEx frameworks. You'll be building the data infrastructure that makes their work possible


Benefits & Perks

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits .

About Atlassian

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.

To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go.atlassian.com/crh .

Description

Columbia Technology Partners is seeking a Database Engineer 3 to provide technical expertise in database architecture, design, development, implementation, and administration for mission-critical systems. This role is responsible for developing and maintaining database solutions that support complex data storage, retrieval, analysis, and processing requirements while ensuring performance, scalability, security, and reliability. The Database Engineer will work throughout the system lifecycle, from requirements analysis and design through testing, deployment, and operational support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, implement, and maintain relational and object-oriented database solutions that support mission and business requirements.
  • Install, configure, patch, and administer Oracle Database, Oracle Enterprise Manager, and Oracle Data Guard environments.
  • Develop database structures and schemas that align with overall system architecture while balancing performance, scalability, security, retention, and distribution requirements.
  • Create and maintain database parser software, database loading software, ad hoc queries, scripts, macros, and automation solutions.
  • Analyze and evaluate database performance, system improvements, optimization opportunities, and maintenance activities.
  • Develop and recommend short- and long-term database administration and design strategies.
  • Build and support complex database solutions utilizing Open Database Connectivity (ODBC), cloud-based storage and retrieval methodologies, and data integration technologies.
  • Translate customer requirements and data needs into effective database architectures and technical solutions.
  • Lead database development efforts and provide technical direction for database design, implementation, and modernization activities.

Qualifications

  • Ten (10) years of experience as a Database Engineer supporting programs of similar scope, type, and complexity.
  • Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline from an accredited college or university. Five (5) additional years of Database Engineer experience may be substituted for a bachelor's degree.
  • Extensive experience installing, configuring, and patching Oracle Database, Oracle Enterprise Manager, and Oracle Data Guard.
  • Strong experience with Linux operating systems, Linux command-line administration, and Bash scripting.
  • DoD 8570.01-M Information Assurance Technical (IAT) Level II certification compliance required.

Desired Skills

  • Experience supporting MongoDB environments.
  • Experience with cloud-based database storage, retrieval, and management solutions.
  • Experience developing complex database queries, automation scripts, and data transformation processes.
  • Familiarity with enterprise-scale database architecture, performance tuning, and high-availability solutions.

Requirements

  • U.S. Citizenship is required for all applicants. CTP is an equal opportunity employer and abides by applicable employment laws and regulations. All applicants and employees are subject to random drug testing in accordance with Executive Order 12564. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a security background investigation and polygraph.

    • DoD 8570 IAT Level II certification compliance required
This position requires an active Security Clearance with appropriate Polygraph.

Founded in 2007, Columbia Technology Partners is a Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business with a specialization in technology and management consulting committed to solving intricate and sensitive technology issues facing corporations and federal agencies. Since its inception, CTP has been instrumental in the technical design, engineering development, operational deployment, and support of key systems. represent what matters most to CTP: Our People.

Our salary ranges are based on the following key factors:

descriptionHtml:
About the Organization Now is a great time to join Redhorse Corporation. We are a solution-driven company delivering data insights and technology solutions to customers with missions critical to U.S. national interests. We’re looking for thoughtful, skilled professionals who thrive as trusted partners building technology-agnostic solutions and want to apply their talents supporting customers with difficult and important mission sets. About the Role Redhorse is transforming how the government utilizes data and technology. We are looking for an experienced Database Engineer to join the team designing, building, and maintaining a new AWS-hosted, web-based internal tool used by non-technical end users to submit, review, approve, and track sensitive, highly regulated data requests on classified systems. The tool replaces a legacy web application and manual email- and spreadsheet-driven review with automated workflows, structured data capture, and AI-assisted review. As the Database Engineer, you will own the data layer of the application: modeling the request, review, and audit data; designing the relational and NoSQL stores that back the application; migrating data out of the legacy system; and making sure the database is secure, performant, auditable, and compliant with data-handling policies. You will work closely with application developers, cloud engineers, systems engineers, and policy experts across a multi-company team, and with stakeholders, to translate data-access policy into enforceable database design. This role works under general direction and is expected to independently determine the approach to difficult data problems. Required Qualifications * Active TS/SCI with Polygraph. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field and 5+ years of relevant experience; or a Master's degree and 3+ years of relevant experience. Job Description

We have an opportunity to impact your career and provide an adventure where you can push the limits of what's possible.

As a Software Engineer III SQL Server Database Engineer at JPMorgan Chase within the Consumer & Community Banking, you serve as a seasoned member of an agile team to design and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. You are responsible for carrying out critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives.

Job Responsibilities

  • Executes software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or breakdown technical problems
  • Creates secure and high-quality production code and maintains algorithms that run synchronously with appropriate systems
  • Leverages enterprise-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness.
  • Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.
  • Produces architecture and design artifacts for complex applications while being accountable for ensuring design constraints are met by software code development
  • Gathers, analyzes, synthesizes, and develops visualizations and reporting from large, diverse data sets in service of continuous improvement of software applications and systems
  • Proactively identifies hidden problems and patterns in data and uses these insights to drive improvements to coding hygiene and system architecture
  • Partner with PaaS, DBaaS, and Cloud Delivery teams to resolve issues and influence implementation of self service capabilities to support the AD teams.
  • Participate in tactical and strategic database modernization planning and development of database modernization patterns.
  • Provide direct support for development teams performing database modernization activities.
  • Support AD teams in DB design activities; Support AD teams in troubleshooting and resolution of production database issues and contribute to root cause analysis supporting problem management workstreams.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience
  • Hands-on practical experience in system design, application development, testing, and operational stability
  • Experience in developing, debugging, and maintaining code in a large corporate environment with one or more modern programming languages and database querying languages
  • Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
  • Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices.
  • Overall knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle
  • Solid understanding of agile methodologies such as CI/CD, Application Resiliency, and Security
  • Experience working as database engineering for SQL Server, Aurora Postgres, CockroachDB and experience with AWS and/or Azure and associated database services.
  • Experience supporting databases in DevOps and proficient in automation and continuous delivery methods.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in software applications and technical processes within a technical discipline (e.g., cloud, artificial intelligence, machine learning, mobile, etc.)
  • Demonstrable experience performing database upgrades and migrations.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Strong desire to master emerging technologies and share experience with other team members.
  • Ability to adjust and adapt role to support team success.
  • In-depth knowledge of the financial services industry and their IT systems.
  • Direct experience with NoSQL databases.

ABOUT US

Chase is a leading financial services firm, helping nearly half of America's households and small businesses achieve their financial goals through a broad range of financial products. Our mission is to create engaged, lifelong relationships and put our customers at the heart of everything we do. We also help small businesses, nonprofits and cities grow, delivering solutions to solve all their financial needs.

We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. Those in eligible roles may receive commission-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. We also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs, based on eligibility. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage, on-site health and wellness centers, a retirement savings plan, backup childcare, tuition reimbursement, mental health support, financial coaching and more. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Disability/Veterans

About The Team

Our Consumer & Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.

Job Title: SQL Server Data Engineer

Location: Dallas, TX

Need only US Citizens


Job Overview

We are hiring a Mid-Level Data Engineer to design and build OLTP (Online Transaction Processing) systems and pipelines. This role focuses on transactional system design, API-driven data flows, and building reliable, high-performance data services. The ideal candidate thinks in terms of system architecture, transactional integrity, and low-latency data handling rather than scheduled data warehouse loads.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain OLTP pipelines for real-time or near-real-time transactional data processing.
  • Build and consume APIs to handle data ingestion, updates, and retrieval from operational systems.
  • Design SQL Server database schemas optimized for transactional workloads — normalization, indexing, concurrency control, and locking behavior.
  • Write and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, and transaction logic for high-throughput, low-latency operations.
  • Ensure data consistency, atomicity, and integrity (ACID compliance) across services.
  • Develop ETL processes as needed to support data migration, system integration, or occasional batch sync between transactional systems.
  • Handle API request/response cycles: validation, error handling, retries, and rate limiting on data-write operations.
  • Monitor system performance, diagnose issues (deadlocks, query latency, contention), and tune for scale.
  • Deploy and manage data services using Azure (Azure SQL Database, API Management, Azure Blob).
  • Use SSIS (SQL Server Integration Services) for occasional data migration or integration tasks.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to integrate data layers into application services.
  • Implement validation, idempotency checks, and integrity constraints at the transactional level.
  • Create and maintain documentation for system architecture, API contracts, and database schemas.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 7–10 years of experience in SQL Server and relational database design for OLTP systems — normalization, indexing, transactions, isolation levels.
  • Solid experience building or consuming APIs (REST) for data read/write operations.
  • Working knowledge of Azure services: Azure SQL Database, API Management,, Azure Blob Storage.
  • Experience working with transactional data in high-concurrency, production environments.
  • Experience writing and optimizing SQL stored procedures for transactional systems.
  • Hands-on experience with SSIS or similar tools for data migration/integration tasks.
  • Working knowledge of ETL development for occasional batch sync or migration needs.
  • Understanding of system design fundamentals: concurrency, caching, request handling, and service scalability.
  • Experience collaborating with backend/application engineers to integrate data layers into services.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

Description

Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides companies of all sizes with an infrastructure web services platform in the cloud. Amazon Redshift is a rapidly growing, fast, fully managed, petabyte-scale data warehouse service in the cloud. It enables customers to dramatically increase their query performance when analyzing virtually any size data set using the same SQL-based business intelligence tools they use today. No other data warehouse makes it as easy to gain new insights. With Redshift customers can query petabytes of structured and semi-structured data across their data warehouse and data lake using standard SQL.

Amazon Redshift is the most popular and fastest cloud data warehouse. It is integrated with customers data lake, offers up to 3x faster performance than any other data warehouse, and costs up to 75% less than any other cloud data warehouse.

Joining the Amazon Redshift team gives you the opportunity to:

  • Work on a disruptive product that’s still in its early stages
  • Solve challenging problems that will revolutionize database computing in the cloud
  • Build a product that will leverage the scale of resources available in the cloud
  • Work for a company that’s a recognized leader in the cloud computing space
  • Be involved in the fast growing, big data space

We are looking for senior database engineers that are passionate about data warehousing, and love to work with customers to help them with database design, usage patterns and performance.

We Expect Candidates To Be Able To

  • Demonstrate in-depth knowledge of database or data warehouse systems internals including relational database design and distributed databases/MPP architectures
  • Lead strategic data architecture & database design discussions with customers
  • Drive and oversee workload analysis, performance benchmarking and troubleshooting efforts with customers in their environments
  • Clearly communicate deep technical topics to customers
  • Influence the engineering team roadmap towards building a product that is scalable, easy to use and build on, and addresses customer needs
  • Conduct POC’s with customers in competitive situations
  • Leverage good coding/scripting skills to automate tasks and improve workload analysis mechanisms

About The Team

ABOUT AWS:

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field or equivalent
  • 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
  • Experience in writing complex, highly-optimized SQL queries across large datasets
  • Knowledge of overall system architecture, scalability, reliability, and performance in a database environment
  • Experience with large-scale data analytics and data warehousing

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in software development, or experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or experience in external enterprise customer-facing role as a technical lead, with strong oral and written communication skills, presenting to both large and small audiences

Title: Oracle and PostgreSQL Database Administrator (DBA)

Location: Remote

Terms: Full-time

Salary: $120-140k DoE

Clearance: Qualified candidates must be US citizens AND have an active DHS Public Trust clearance

Travel: 0%

Position Description

We are seeking an Oracle and PostgreSQL Database Administrator (DBA) who will be responsible for the design, development, implementation, and maintenance of database solutions using both Oracle and PostgreSQL platforms. The role involves working closely with application developers, business analysts, and system administrators to ensure data integrity, performance, and security across multiple database environments.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain database objects (tables, views, indexes, stored procedures, functions, triggers) in both Oracle and PostgreSQL environments.
  • Write efficient, well-documented SQL and PL/SQL (Oracle) and PL/pgSQL (PostgreSQL) code to support application requirements.
  • Perform data modeling, database normalization, and schema design for new and existing applications.
  • Optimize and tune database queries and overall database performance.
  • Develop and maintain ETL processes for data extraction, transformation, and loading.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve database-related issues, ensuring high availability and reliability.
  • Collaborate with application developers and business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Document database structures, processes, and procedures.
  • Monitor database health, usage, and capacity, and recommend improvements as needed.
  • Stay current with industry best practices and emerging technologies related to Oracle and PostgreSQL.

Requirements

  • U.S. Citizenship is required with an active DHS Public Trust clearance.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Oracle database development (SQL, PL/SQL).
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with PostgreSQL development (SQL, PL/pgSQL).
  • Strong understanding of relational database concepts, data modeling, and normalization.
  • Familiarity with database administration tasks, including installation, configuration, backup, recovery, and security.
  • Proficiency with database development tools (e.g., Oracle SQL Developer, TOAD, pgAdmin, psql).
  • Experience with performance tuning and query optimization in both Oracle and PostgreSQL.
  • Familiarity with database migration and integration techniques between Oracle and PostgreSQL.
  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git).

Desired

  • Experience with cloud-based database solutions (e.g., AWS RDS Oracle and PostgreSQL).
  • Knowledge of additional programming languages (e.g., Java, Python).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices for database deployments.
  • Familiarity with data warehousing concepts and tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively

Work Authorization/Clearance: Must be a US Citizen and have an active DHS Public Trust Clearance.

Job Description:

General Dynamics Information Technology (GDIT) is seeking a Senior PostgreSQL Database Engineer to support the operation, design, and continuous improvement of database capabilities for a mission-critical system.

This position combines hands-on PostgreSQL administration with database engineering and architecture. You will serve as the team's primary database subject matter expert, partnering with software developers and systems engineers to maintain reliable database operations while improving database performance, design, security, and maintainability.

Our environment uses PostgreSQL for both transactional and analytical data workloads and leverages OpenShift for application deployment. The ideal candidate enjoys solving practical database challenges, can independently troubleshoot operational issues, and can recommend and implement improvements to how databases are designed, deployed, monitored, and maintained.

What You'll Do

  • Administer PostgreSQL databases: Manage database configuration, user accounts, roles, permissions, routine maintenance, patching, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
  • Design and improve database architectures: Develop and refine schemas, data models, indexing strategies, and data access patterns to support application functionality, performance, and evolving system requirements.
  • Optimize database performance: Analyze SQL queries and execution plans, identify performance bottlenecks, and implement improvements to queries, indexes, database configuration, and resource utilization.
  • Support database operations in OpenShift environments: Collaborate with platform and application teams to support PostgreSQL deployment, connectivity, configuration, monitoring, and operational integration with OpenShift-based systems.
  • Maintain database reliability and recoverability: Implement and maintain backup and restore procedures, validate recovery processes, and support existing high-availability, replication, and disaster recovery capabilities.
  • Monitor database health: Configure and maintain database monitoring, logging, alerting, capacity tracking, and operational reporting to identify and resolve issues proactively.
  • Collaborate with software developers: Advise on schema design, SQL development, transaction management, data access patterns, and database integration to ensure efficient and reliable application behavior.
  • Drive continuous improvement: Identify database performance, reliability, scalability, and maintainability improvements; evaluate appropriate tools and approaches; and implement practical solutions.
  • Support database lifecycle management: Plan and execute database upgrades, migrations, configuration changes, and modernization efforts while minimizing operational risk and service disruption.
  • Establish and maintain standards: Document database architecture, configurations, security controls, operational procedures, and recommended engineering practices.
  • Maintain database security: Apply appropriate access controls, least-privilege permissions, auditing, and security practices in accordance with applicable customer and system requirements.
  • Provide technical guidance: Serve as the primary database technical resource for the engineering team, helping troubleshoot issues and make informed decisions about database design and operational practices.

Required Qualifications

WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO SUCCEED

  • Active TS/SCI security clearance and ability to obtain and maintain a polygraph. Polygraph sponsorship may be available.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent education, training, certifications, and experience.
  • Five or more years of experience in database administration, database engineering, database architecture, or a related technical discipline.
  • Hands-on experience administering and supporting PostgreSQL databases.
  • Experience with relational database design, data modeling, SQL, schema development, indexing, and query optimization.
  • Experience troubleshooting database issues and managing database users, roles, permissions, and configurations.
  • Experience with database backups, restores, upgrades, and routine maintenance.
  • Working knowledge of database high availability, replication, and disaster recovery concepts.
  • Ability to collaborate with developers and infrastructure engineers to resolve technical issues and improve system performance.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting PostgreSQL in OpenShift, Kubernetes, containerized, or Linux-based environments.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL replication, failover, connection pooling, or high-availability technologies.
  • Experience with database monitoring, logging, alerting, and performance diagnostics.
  • Experience supporting both transactional and analytical data workloads.
  • Experience with database automation, scripting, infrastructure as code, or repeatable deployment practices.
  • Experience planning and executing database migrations, upgrades, and modernization initiatives.
  • Familiarity with database security practices in regulated or classified environments.
  • Experience with Oracle database administration or Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration.
  • CompTIA Security+ certification or equivalent, as required by the applicable customer environment.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

  • Location: On-site at the customer location.
  • Security Clearance: Active TS/SCI required; ability to obtain and maintain a polygraph. Sponsorship may be available.
  • Primary Database Technology: PostgreSQL.
  • Application Platform: OpenShift.
  • Other Technologies: Oracle experience is beneficial but not required.

We are seeking an exceptionally skilled and motivated Lead Data Platform Engineer, to guide our team in building robust, scalable, and high-performance data solutions primarily within the Microsoft SQL Server ecosystem. The ideal candidate will combine deep technical expertise in SQL Server development and database administration, with significant proven experience in managing Very Large Databases (VLDBs), along with leadership abilities to drive innovation, mentor junior talent, and ensure the delivery of high-quality data products that drive critical business insights.

Responsibilities:

  • Very Large Database (VLDB) Management: Managing, developing, and optimizing solutions for very large databases, specifically within SQL Server version 19 and above, ensuring high performance and reliability.
  • Performance Optimization: Leading performance tuning efforts for SQL Server databases, including comprehensive query optimization, advanced indexing strategies, and overall database performance.
  • Collaboration with DBA Team: Working closely with the dedicated DBA team to ensure adherence to best practices and operational excellence for VLDB environments.
  • Data Loading & ETL Leadership: Overseeing and guiding robust data loading processes and ETL development, primarily utilizing Microsoft BI tools, to establish efficient data pipelines for large datasets. Mentoring other ETL developers in best practices.
  • Data Architecture & Modeling: Applying advanced data modeling principles and driving data architecture decisions for data warehouses, ensuring data integrity, scalability, security, and optimal performance for VLDBs.
  • Code Quality & Best Practices: Conducting rigorous code reviews for SQL (including stored procedures) to ensure quality, performance, and adherence to DBA best practices, particularly for large-scale operations.
  • Database Security & Access Management: Maintaining and enhancing existing entitlement and permission models to ensure robust database security, including the implementation of database encryption methods such as Transparent Data Encryption (TDE).
  • AI-Enhanced Development & Optimization: Leveraging AI tools to assist in SQL code refactoring, identifying performance bottlenecks, suggesting optimization strategies, and enhancing overall developer productivity.
  • Mentorship: Serving as an advisor and coach to mid-level developers and analysts, including work allocation.
  • Risk Assessment: Appropriately assessing risk in business decisions, ensuring compliance with laws, rules, and regulations, adhering to policy, applying ethical judgment, and escalating/managing control issues with transparency.

Recommended Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in Apps Development or systems analysis with extensive SQL Server expertise.
  • Very Large Database (VLDB) Expertise: Proven and extensive experience in developing, maintaining, and optimizing solutions for very large databases (VLDBs) in SQL Server version 2019 and above.
  • Performance Tuning Expertise: Demonstrated ability in performance tuning for SQL Server, including expert-level skills in query optimization, indexing strategies, and overall database performance enhancements.
  • Data Modeling & Architecture: Deep understanding and practical experience in advanced data modeling principles, data architecture, and data warehouse concepts and design, ensuring data integrity, scalability, security, and optimal performance for VLDBs.
  • Data Loading & Microsoft BI & ETL Architecture: Extensive experience with data loading processes and ETL development, primarily utilizing Microsoft BI tools (SSIS, SSAS). Proven ability to architect, design, and implement highly scalable and robust ETL pipelines for large data volumes.
  • SQL Development Best Practices: Strong experience in SQL code reviews, fine-tuning stored procedures, and inculcating DBA best practices within development teams.
  • Experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB or CouchDB.
  • Database Security: Proven experience in managing database security, including maintaining and enhancing existing entitlement and permission models. Familiarity with database encryption technologies, specifically Transparent Data Encryption (TDE).
  • AI-Powered Development: Ability to leverage AI tools for efficient SQL code refactoring, optimization, and identifying potential code improvements, thereby enhancing code quality and developer productivity within a SQL Server context.
  • Project Management & Leadership: Experience in managing and implementing successful projects, with demonstrated leadership and project management skills.
  • Communication: Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication.
  • Nice to have: Python/Pyspark skills for data processing and analytics.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
  • Master’s degree preferred
